chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 335: Divine Level Venom and "Needle"!_2
paragraphs: This potion was something Han Xing obtained from Wu Ling’Er.
Last time, it was the Gale Wings Secret Elixir and Four Symbols Power Secret Elixir.
Which made Han Xing realize that the Witch Race had such secret elixirs to enhance attributes.
So, he paid extra attention and went to Wu Ling’Er to get a few bottles.
However, due to being quite busy recently.
Han Xing had forgotten to bring them out.
At this moment, Han Xing took out a small bottle of potion with a faint golden sheen from his backpack.
He handed it to Shen Yun.
Upon receiving it, Shen Yun tilted his head back and drank it directly.
Then, he activated some special effect of his equipment.
The momentum on his body suddenly surged.
At this time.
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer again.
An even stronger Holy Light gathered within.
He then cast the Purification Technique on everyone again.
Holy Light entered their bodies.
The next moment.
Everyone simultaneously felt their bodies lighten.
The icy feeling all over their bodies disappeared.
Even the signs of body corrosion stopped.
This indicated that Shen Yun’s Purification Technique had taken effect!
Everyone showed a pleased expression simultaneously.
"Well done." Han Xing praised.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also looked at Shen Yun with a smile, saying.
"Thank you."
Shen Yun felt a bit embarrassed by the praise from everyone, rubbing his head.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with some lingering fear, "Damn, this Giant Beast Poison is truly terrifying!"
"If we encounter this toxic mist again, it’s better to keep our distance!"
Everyone expressed their agreement.
However, Han Xing had a different idea.
He whispered, "This Giant Beast Poison can actually inflict lethal damage on Legends and Demigod level beings."
"With just three layers, that Legend would be dead for sure."
"If I can get my hands on this toxin and combine it with my bow and arrow."
"Ordinary Legends would almost certainly die upon touch."
"Even those Demigod level powerhouses would drink regret if I hit them with a few arrows."
Han Xing hadn’t forgotten.
In the early stages of the game.
He had used the tactic of applying poison on arrows to eliminate several Elite Monsters.
Now, he had unexpectedly encountered Divine-Level Giant Beast Toxin.
Han Xing wanted to acquire it for himself.
Listening to Han Xing’s somewhat sinister idea.
Everyone felt a chill run down their spine simultaneously.
No one expected Han Xing to be so cunning and sinister.
However, they liked it.
"Hehehe... Truly worthy of Brother Xing."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun showed knowing smiles on their faces.
However, now there was a problem facing everyone.
Which was, they first had to confirm what was at the center of the toxic mist.
How to get there.
Was the most troublesome issue.
Previously, they had already personally experienced it.
This toxic mist was extremely terrifying.
Getting even slightly closer.
Caused even these Legendary Powerhouses to feel extremely uncomfortable.
Let alone entering the central area against the mist’s corrosion.
Han Xing was also contemplating methods.
’Should I send out the Bear God’s Spirit to explore the toxic mist for a while?’
However, Han Xing quickly shook his head.
Although the Bear God’s Spirit was a Legendary level creature, it was uncertain it could withstand the toxicity to reach the depths.
It might perish halfway.
After considering for a while, the group still hadn’t found a suitable plan.
Just as Han Xing was about to give up.
Coal Ball suddenly jumped out at this moment.
As a Void Royal Family member with intelligence no less than a human.
Coal Ball could naturally understand Han Xing’s words.
It also knew the problem he was facing now.
Coal Ball’s tall figure slowly walked up to Han Xing.
"Coal Ball, what’s wrong?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
Coal Ball nudged him, then looked at the mist ahead.
Han Xing seemed to understand something.
"Uh, are you saying you can take me into the mist?"
Coal Ball gently nodded.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was taken aback.
It should be known that although Coal Ball had impressive strength.
It was currently only a Fourth-Turn Dominator Level creature.
Compared to them, it was still far behind.
However, considering Coal Ball’s Void Royal Family bloodline.
This special creature might indeed have some extraordinary means beyond common sense.
Even before Han Xing could react.
Coal Ball crouched down directly.
Signaling Han Xing to jump onto its back.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
This was the first time Coal Ball allowed him to jump onto its back.
Han Xing leaped up, landing directly on Coal Ball’s broad back.
Coal Ball slowly stood upright.
Han Xing felt his field of view begin to elevate.
He patted Coal Ball’s back, excitedly saying, "Great, great, Coal Ball has shown potential."
"It can actually serve as a mount now."
This feeling was quite marvelous.
It felt like the child he had raised with effort was now giving back to the family.
Coal Ball turned its head, nodding to Han Xing.
Then.
It leaped forward, charging directly into the toxic mist.
This scene.
Made the hearts of the four standing on the Sky Island leap into their throats.
Even Han Xing felt a bit nervous.
If he entered the toxic mist and was infected with three layers of Giant Beast Poison, he would be in big trouble!
At that time, even Shen Yun’s Purification Technique would have no effect.
However.
Han Xing believed that Coal Ball wouldn’t set him up.
Since it dared to rush forward, it must be confident.
Which was indeed the case.
As they were about to make contact with the toxic mist.
Coal Ball’s Power of the Void suddenly erupted explosively.
The next moment.
A vast void suddenly descended centered on itself.
It was precisely Coal Ball’s domain skill.
Void Eternal Night!
At this moment, Coal Ball, carrying a great void area, traversed the toxic mist.
As if it had entered another world altogether.
It managed to isolate this toxic mist outside its domain!

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 335: Divine Level Venom and "Stinger"!_3
paragraphs: Han Xing felt immensely shocked.
And then, joy followed.
"Oh my, I never thought Little Coal Ball’s Void Domain would have such an effect, isolating the impact of environmental toxins and allowing movement inside!"
"Amazing!"
Receiving Han Xing’s praise, Coal Ball seemed very happy.
The speed of progress became faster!
The duration of Void Eternal Night is 60 seconds.
Enough time for Coal Ball to take him through the entire toxic fog several times.
The time was more than sufficient!
Meanwhile.
Coal Ball transformed into a streak of black lightning, passing through layers of fog.
A few seconds later, they reached the deepest part directly.
Just as Han Xing expected.
The center of the toxic fog.
Was a vast purple poison pool, emitting thick smoke continuously.
And spreading outward.
The poison pool kept making a sizzling sound, seemingly highly corrosive.
Even the surrounding space became distorted.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He tried using Divine Power to cover it, then directly stored it in the backpack.
The system prompt appeared.
[Acquired Giant Beast Venom (Red) *132 cubic meters...]
In the space backpack,
One compartment stores this purple venom.
There are over a hundred cubic meters in total.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but swallow hard.
"Wow! So much venom!"
"This is a huge gain!"
He was extremely excited, "Damn, with this venom, let’s see which blind demigod dares to mess with me."
"When the time comes, I’ll just splash this venom on their face!
"Heck, it could drown them to death!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but chuckle sinisterly, then burst into a delighted laugh!
As Han Xing put away this pile of venom.
The dense toxic fog in the central area dissipated a bit as well.
However, to be safe.
Han Xing still had Coal Ball take him swiftly out of the toxic fog area.
At this moment.
Seeing Han Xing return safely.
Everyone let out a sincere sigh of relief.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Brother Xing, did you succeed?"
Han Xing nodded with a smile.
Everyone’s breath caught, then came the wild joy!
They had already experienced the potency of this toxin.
Now, Han Xing had actually collected the source of this toxin as a form of attack!
With this, they had another trump card!
With excitement in their hearts.
Everyone continued to explore the entire tail of the giant beast.
The more they progressed, the higher the terrain rose.
It was practically a road to the heavens!
Along the way, they collected quite a few precious stones.
Moreover, they discovered two clusters of toxic fog.
But because Coal Ball’s Void Eternal Night skill had an eight-hour cooldown,
Han Xing could only temporarily memorize the coordinates.
Planning to come back later to collect the giant beast venom.
Five more days passed.
Everyone climbed to a height of hundreds of thousands of kilometers together.
Finally.
They were about to reach the tip of the giant beast’s tail.
A vast, glittering metallic continent appeared before them.
Stretching for countless miles, with no end in sight.
And when they used Divine Power projection to activate God’s Perspective,
They immediately discovered that this metal continent looked like a huge iron rod.
The closer to the tip, the thinner it became.
Shaped like a cone.
At this moment, Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask, "This thing, could it be the beast’s venomous sting?"
Everyone looked at this ’sting’ that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Then, swallowed hard in unison.
Because Shen Yun’s words might actually be true.
This might really be the beast’s venomous sting.
Cheng Jianyong jokingly said at this moment, "Brother Xing, why not go over and see if you can take this venomous sting away?"
This was just said in jest.
But then he saw.
Han Xing actually started thinking seriously.
After a moment.
Han Xing nodded and said, "I think it’s worth a try."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was dumbfounded.
"Brother Xing...are you serious?"
"This thing is over ten thousand kilometers long?"
Han Xing shook his head and didn’t speak.
Instead, he controlled the Sky Island to enter this metal continent.
Cheng Jianyong’s point was valid.
Taking away a venomous sting tens of thousands of kilometers long was unrealistic.
However.
Han Xing could break it from the middle or the end to take it away.
In this way,
The Sky Island continued for over an hour.
Finally, it was approaching the end of this giant beast venomous sting.
Here, they could already see the cold light emanating from the tip.
Its length was roughly thirty kilometers.
Which is about 300,000 meters.
About the same length as a giant beast scale.
It should be able to fit into the backpack.
However.
How to break it off became the problem.
Han Xing attempted an attack.
Boom!
After an earth-shattering explosion,
The surface of the giant venomous sting remained smooth as ever.
But he didn’t give up and continued various attacks, persistently bombing it.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
After a series of amazing blasts,
It was clear.
Han Xing’s attacks still had no effect.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong cautiously said, "Brother Xing...maybe it’s time to stop trying..."
"I was just saying it offhand."
"This thing is truly a Divine Beast, our attacks probably can’t even break its defense."
Everyone also watched Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded, "I know that with our current attack power, it’s impossible to cause any damage."
"But trying doesn’t cost anything."
"And I just have a feeling that this venomous sting isn’t simple."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said no more.
Instead, he joined Han Xing in attacking the giant venomous sting.
Everyone else joined in as well.
"Slash! Slash, slash!"
"Shoo! Shoo, shoo!"
Various sword qi and meteorites rained down.
After half an hour of continuous effort from everyone.
The entire metallic land began to tremble.
Yet their attacks still made no difference.
Not to mention breaking through defenses.
Not even a crack appeared.
This result was within Han Xing’s expectations.
After all, it is a true divine-level creature.
And even more powerful than an ordinary Divine Spirit, the Beast of Calamity.
If they could break its defense, it would be miraculous.
Everyone felt at a loss...

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 336: Impossible Mission and the Transcender!
paragraphs: After everyone attacked the beast’s tail spike to no avail.
Han Xing then said: "Stop it, there’s no need to try again."
Upon hearing this, everyone stopped their attack.
"Let’s advance toward the end of the poison needle and see if we can find anything."
"If there’s nothing, we’ll proceed to explore other parts of the giant beast’s body."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
After saying that.
Han Xing continued to advance along the poison needle.
As they moved closer to the end.
The surface area of the poison needle began to drastically shrink.
Walking on it was akin to walking along a steel corridor.
After advancing more than twenty kilometers.
From afar, they could already see the tip of the poison needle.
It faintly glimmered with a cold light, as if possessing infinite penetrating power.
Here, they were only a few kilometers from the end of the poison needle.
At this position.
Everyone started feeling a piercing pain throughout their bodies!
Even their divine power domains were easily dismantled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong inhaled sharply.
"This poison needle... so terrifying!"
"Just its penetrating power alone could pierce through demigod-level beings."
"This poison needle... could it be a weapon the beast uses against divine spirits?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils simultaneously revealed a shocked expression.
Cheng Jianyong must be telling the truth.
This poison needle is undoubtedly a valuable item.
Also a terrifying weapon of mass destruction.
But unfortunately.
They couldn’t take it down.
Everyone shook their heads in regret.
In the field.
Han Xing remained silent.
He kept releasing divine power, observing every corner of the poison needle.
Although his divine power was repeatedly pierced by the penetrating intent from the needle’s end.
He was persistent nonetheless.
After some observation.
Han Xing indeed discovered some unexpected gains.
Below them.
Which is the other side of the massive steel needle.
Through God’s Perspective.
Han Xing saw a crack about several hundred meters long.
It seems, this giant beast encountered an unimaginable enemy.
During the battle, it suffered trauma.
Even its tail spike seemed about to break!
Seeing this scene.
Hope appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He directly controlled the Sky Island, bringing everyone to the underside of the steel needle.
Meanwhile.
Others also saw the crack above their heads.
Excitement appeared in their eyes.
This sent them a signal.
The giant beast is not invincible, its tail spike can be broken!
He suddenly said: "Attack this crack with full force! Let’s find a way to break its tail spike."
Upon hearing this.
Shen Yun did not hesitate, throwing all sorts of buffs on.
He even used the [Church Secret Technique - Holy Light Shines].
Under multiple amplifications.
The whole party felt their power surge!
Then.
Various attacks were launched.
"Boom boom!"
"Whizz whizz!"
Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill bombarded wave after wave.
Including Zhang Lianmeng’s large fireball, Su Xiaoyang’s elf arrow, and Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi.
All started bursting with full force.
This entire area was directly covered by all sorts of terrifying attacks.
Even a high-tier legend, caught in such attacks, would be killed on the spot.
However.
After the energy wave dissipated.
Everyone was surprised to find that the steel needle on the beast was still bright and new.
The crack hadn’t expanded at all.
In other words.
Still no breach.
Yet, this was expected.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, seeming somewhat at a loss.
At this time, Han Xing gritted his teeth and said: "Damn it, I don’t believe it."
"Everyone, throw your ultimate moves up there for me!"
"Activate the strongest attack mode!"
After speaking.
Han Xing was the first to activate all equipment effects on his body.
His momentum rapidly soared.
Meanwhile.
An arrow shot out, a bright full moon suddenly appearing.
But that was not all.
Han Xing also pulled out that golden mask from his backpack.
Then, directly put it on his face!
At this moment.
Han Xing’s aura reached the strongest point ever!
Demigod!
He re-entered that peculiar perspective.
A line appeared on the heads of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
Moreover, clearer than before.
As if Han Xing could reach out and touch this line.
Han Xing vaguely felt.
If he inflicted damage on this line above Cheng Jianyong’s head.
They themselves would also be severely affected.
This was when Han Xing suddenly gained insight.
"So, is this the method the Shadow Monarch used to crush billions of Witch Race people with one move?"
But now wasn’t the time to study these.
As the flaming arrow in Han Xing’s hand erupted.
He even used [Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow]!
Seeing Han Xing being so decisive.
Everyone else had no hesitation.
Various states crazily activated!
Their aura began to rapidly soar.
Middle-tier legend!
High-tier legend!
Under their collective full-force outburst.
All actually achieved high-tier legend strength!
Then.
They each used newly learned legendary skills.
"Buzz! Buzz buzz!"
Ice crystals fell from the sky, the entire space seemingly frozen.
It was Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary skill: [Ice Age].
Then there was Su Xiaoyang’s [Nature’s Fury].
Cheng Jianyong’s [Divine Demon Swordsmanship - Storm Style].
And Shen Yun’s [Great Angel Judgment].
This outburst from the four was enough to severely injure, even kill demigod-level beings.
Yet.
This wasn’t the end!
Meanwhile
A grand sun and a full moon exploded simultaneously!
"Boom!"
The originally calm void.
Received extremely strong stimulation, seemingly showing signs of agitation!

Han Xing then said: "Stop it, there’s no need to try again."
Upon hearing this, everyone stopped their attack.
"Let’s advance toward the end of the poison needle and see if we can find anything."
"If there’s nothing, we’ll proceed to explore other parts of the giant beast’s body."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
After saying that.
Han Xing continued to advance along the poison needle.
As they moved closer to the end.
The surface area of the poison needle began to drastically shrink.
Walking on it was akin to walking along a steel corridor.
After advancing more than twenty kilometers.
From afar, they could already see the tip of the poison needle.
It faintly glimmered with a cold light, as if possessing infinite penetrating power.
Here, they were only a few kilometers from the end of the poison needle.
At this position.
Everyone started feeling a piercing pain throughout their bodies!
Even their divine power domains were easily dismantled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong inhaled sharply.
"This poison needle... so terrifying!"
"Just its penetrating power alone could pierce through demigod-level beings."
"This poison needle... could it be a weapon the beast uses against divine spirits?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils simultaneously revealed a shocked expression.
Cheng Jianyong must be telling the truth.
This poison needle is undoubtedly a valuable item.
Also a terrifying weapon of mass destruction.
But unfortunately.
They couldn’t take it down.
Everyone shook their heads in regret.
In the field.
Han Xing remained silent.
He kept releasing divine power, observing every corner of the poison needle.
Although his divine power was repeatedly pierced by the penetrating intent from the needle’s end.
He was persistent nonetheless.
After some observation.
Han Xing indeed discovered some unexpected gains.
Below them.
Which is the other side of the massive steel needle.
Through God’s Perspective.
Han Xing saw a crack about several hundred meters long.
It seems, this giant beast encountered an unimaginable enemy.
During the battle, it suffered trauma.
Even its tail spike seemed about to break!
Seeing this scene.
Hope appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He directly controlled the Sky Island, bringing everyone to the underside of the steel needle.
Meanwhile.
Others also saw the crack above their heads.
Excitement appeared in their eyes.
This sent them a signal.
The giant beast is not invincible, its tail spike can be broken!
He suddenly said: "Attack this crack with full force!
Let’s find a way to break its tail spike."
Upon hearing this.
Shen Yun did not hesitate, throwing all sorts of buffs on.
He even used the [Church Secret Technique - Holy Light Shines].
Under multiple amplifications.
The whole party felt their power surge!
Then.
Various attacks were launched.
"Boom boom!"
"Whizz whizz!"
Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill bombarded wave after wave.
Including Zhang Lianmeng’s large fireball, Su Xiaoyang’s elf arrow, and Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi.
All started bursting with full force.
This entire area was directly covered by all sorts of terrifying attacks.
Even a high-tier legend, caught in such attacks, would be killed on the spot.
However.
After the energy wave dissipated.
Everyone was surprised to find that the steel needle on the beast was still bright and new.
The crack hadn’t expanded at all.
In other words.
Still no breach.
Yet, this was expected.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, seeming somewhat at a loss.
At this time, Han Xing gritted his teeth and said: "Damn it, I don’t believe it."
"Everyone, throw your ultimate moves up there for me!"
"Activate the strongest attack mode!"
After speaking.
Han Xing was the first to activate all equipment effects on his body.
His momentum rapidly soared.
Meanwhile.
An arrow shot out, a bright full moon suddenly appearing.
But that was not all.
Han Xing also pulled out that golden mask from his backpack.
Then, directly put it on his face!
At this moment.
Han Xing’s aura reached the strongest point ever!
Demigod!
He re-entered that peculiar perspective.
A line appeared on the heads of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
Moreover, clearer than before.
As if Han Xing could reach out and touch this line.
Han Xing vaguely felt.
If he inflicted damage on this line above Cheng Jianyong’s head.
They themselves would also be severely affected.
This was when Han Xing suddenly gained insight.
"So, is this the method the Shadow Monarch used to crush billions of Witch Race people with one move?"
But now wasn’t the time to study these.
As the flaming arrow in Han Xing’s hand erupted.
He even used [Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow]!
Seeing Han Xing being so decisive.
Everyone else had no hesitation.
Various states crazily activated!
Their aura began to rapidly soar.
Middle-tier legend!
High-tier legend!
Under their collective full-force outburst.
All actually achieved high-tier legend strength!
Then.
They each used newly learned legendary skills.
"Buzz!
Buzz buzz!"
Ice crystals fell from the sky, the entire space seemingly frozen.
It was Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary skill: [Ice Age].
Then there was Su Xiaoyang’s [Nature’s Fury].
Cheng Jianyong’s [Divine Demon Swordsmanship - Storm Style].
And Shen Yun’s [Great Angel Judgment].
This outburst from the four was enough to severely injure, even kill demigod-level beings.
Yet.
This wasn’t the end!
Meanwhile
A grand sun and a full moon exploded simultaneously!
"Boom!"
The originally calm void.
Received extremely strong stimulation, seemingly showing signs of agitation!

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 336: Impossible Mission and the Transcender!
paragraphs: Several seconds later.
When all the energy waves dissipated.
The giant beast’s tail spike still hadn’t broken, nor was there any obvious damage.
However.
Han Xing noticed.
That crack had widened!
From the original length of several hundred meters, it expanded to over a thousand meters!
Although, the effect was small.
But it gave Han Xing hope!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong also exclaimed excitedly, "Brother Xing, it seems our attack is having an effect!"
"It seems we really have hope of breaking off this poisonous spike!"
Surprise appeared on everyone’s faces.
A few legendary ants were actually plotting against a divine beast!
They were actually about to succeed!
How could this not thrill them?
However, Shen Yun spoke with a somewhat serious expression, "Although our full burst can indeed cause damage."
"But there’s a problem: our burst duration is short, and we need at least a day’s cooldown period."
"At this rate."
"I’m afraid we need at least half a year to have hope of snapping this poisonous needle..."
Cheng Jianyong’s excitement disappeared.
Looking at the massive poisonous needle, he glanced at Han Xing with a solemn expression.
Although.
They could afford to spend half a year.
Moreover, trading this time to acquire an important part from the divine beast.
Is an extremely worthwhile deal.
But now.
They also knew the Witch Race Territory was experiencing chaos in the Void outside.
As the Witch Race Saint Master, Han Xing naturally couldn’t be absent for long.
If any unforeseen circumstances arose, he needed to return quickly.
After listening, Han Xing directly said, "Don’t worry, we won’t need half a year."
Everyone’s eyes lit up simultaneously, then they all looked over.
Han Xing continued, "Now, we already know that demigod-level attacks can cause some damage to the tail spike."
"And besides our legendary skills, I have another thing in my possession that can also reach demigod-level attacks!"
Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask at this moment, "Brother Xing, what do you mean?"
The others too looked at him with anticipation.
Han Xing didn’t keep them in suspense and directly replied, "This thing is the blueprint for the high-tier ancient weapon, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!"
"And one wave of damage from the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon is no less than our full bursts!"
"Next, as long as we construct several Spiritual Godslaying Cannons on the Sky Island.
"Even if it’s a grind, we can grind down the beast’s tail spike!"
Upon hearing this.
Everyone’s faces showed a realizing expression.
On their journey, they had gathered a large amount of precious materials.
Even enough to directly build over a hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
If possible, Han Xing indeed wanted to do so.
But besides the Philosopher’s Stone, Terrastone, and Calamity Divine Gold.
The construction of the ’Spiritual Godslaying Cannon’ also requires a material.
That is the Shadow Divine Stone.
This time out, Han Xing didn’t bring much of the Shadow Divine Stone.
Just 120,000 altogether.
Which means only enough to build 12 Godslaying Cannons.
However, it’s completely sufficient.
Keep in mind, the cooldown of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon is much shorter than their various burst skills.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing directly clicked to construct.
[Spend materials... Construct Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?]
"Yes."
[Constructing... Remaining time 34 hours 24 minutes...]
Han Xing silently nodded.
In about a day or two.
Spiritual Godslaying Cannons can all be built.
Then, he can continue taking action against this tail spike.
But before that.
They can use this time to explore other parts of the giant beast’s corpse.
Such as the feet and claw areas.
Time flew by swiftly.
Another four days passed.
This was the fifteenth day Han Xing and the others spent on the giant beast.
Over four days.
They finally explored the giant beast’s feet and that pair of large claws.
On them.
They once again gained over a dozen pieces of [Giant Beast Scales], and other various materials.
It was truly a bountiful harvest.
Today.
Han Xing stopped exploring.
Because he needed to lead the group to take action against the giant beast’s tail spike again.
Beneath their feet.
On this Sky Island with an area of over ten square kilometers.
There were now twelve different buildings.
The nearly five-kilometer-long cannon barrel surface was overall dark red.
With a bit of Five-Colored Divine Gold as decorative effect.
The cannon turret’s base was ten kilometers in diameter, with the cannon muzzle diameter reaching three hundred meters wide!
Containing formidable power of space inside.
These several exaggerated buildings.
Were the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons Han Xing had built.
The intimidating cannon muzzles alone were terrifying to behold.
One can imagine.
The destructive power of a strike from these turrets would be extreme!
The Sky Island continued its straight ascent.
They quickly arrived at the marked spot from days ago.
Above them, there was still a crack over a thousand meters long.
At this moment.
Under the gazes of anticipation from the crew.
Han Xing directly activated the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons to attack.
"Click! Click click!"
The twelve Spiritual Godslaying Cannons began adjusting their cannon muzzles rapidly.
Dazzling white light gathered within them.
Starting the pre-attack energy accumulating action.
Then.
Twelve thick beams of light burst forth instantly.
"Buzz!"
The beams hit the weakened part of the giant beast’s tail spike!
Immediately, it exploded in a dazzling white light.
They, being legendary powerhouses.
Under that white light, couldn’t even open their eyes.
Were it not for the protection of friendly units.
Just the shockwave could directly damage their eyesight.
A moment later.
The white light dissipated.
Also declaring the end of the attack by the ’Spiritual Godslaying Cannons’.
This was the first time they saw the attack scene of the Godslaying Cannons, each one felt incredibly shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 336: Impossible Mission and the Transcender!
paragraphs: "Oh my... this thing is truly terrifying!"
"I feel like just one shot could take me out instantly," Cheng Jianyong said in shock.
At this moment, Han Xing turned his gaze towards the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
Then, he saw the crack on it expand several hundred meters again!
"It works!"
A look of delight appeared on Han Xing’s face.
A moment later.
The attack effect of the first wave of the Spiritual Shock Tower was comparable to one of the previous bursts from the group!
However, the attack cooldown of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon was only one minute.
In other words.
Almost every minute, Han Xing could unleash a destructive attack of the same level!
Han Xing silently counted down in his heart.
After one minute.
The bombardment was carried out again!
"Buzz!"
"Buzz!"
"Buzz!"
Rays of dazzling white light fell down.
The tail of the giant beast trembled uncontrollably.
Three hours later.
Under Han Xing’s tireless efforts!
Finally.
This crack covered more than half the diameter of the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
It was about to break!
Seeing it was about to succeed.
Han Xing became even more excited.
"Buzz!"
The firepower of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon continued to pour out.
Half an hour later.
With a cracking sound.
Everyone watched.
The massive tail spike, like a broken awl.
Began to fall downwards.
Han Xing reacted immediately.
He controlled the Sky Island to chase after it at high speed!
"Whoosh!"
The Sky Island pursued faster than the falling spike.
However.
The closer he got.
The more intense the stinging sensation on his skin became.
In just a moment.
Blood oozed from the surface of Han Xing’s skin!
At this point, Han Xing turned around to look.
And found that the condition of his four teammates was even more serious than his.
They were almost becoming four blood-covered people!
But, seeing victory was near.
Everyone silently endured, not saying a word.
A trace of anxiety appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Continuing like this wasn’t a solution.
Before they could collect the tail spike.
Everyone’s bodies would be destroyed by the divine power, bleeding to death!
At this moment.
Han Xing was also getting anxious.
He immediately summoned the Oracle Throne, and with a flash, left the Sky Island.
"Brother Han Xing!"
"Brother Xing!"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang exclaimed in unison!
However, by this time Han Xing had already rushed forward.
Han Xing knew his attributes were much stronger than the others’.
In other words.
He could withstand the sharp aura of the tail spike for longer!
Gritting his teeth.
Ignoring the needle-like pain all over his body, he continued to approach the tail spike.
Then.
He tried to wrap it with divine power.
But, the moment the Divine Power Domain was released, it was riddled with holes.
The violent backlash made Han Xing’s throat sweet, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
At this moment.
Han Xing suddenly pulled out a vial from his backpack.
It contained an incredibly vast life energy.
It was precisely the Witch Race’s foundation, the [Holy Tree Spirit Secret Elixir].
Moreover, it was a secret elixir capable of healing demigod injuries!
There were less than ten bottles in the entire Witch Race’s treasury.
Han Xing took it out to be prepared for anything.
Unexpectedly, the time to use it had come right now.
Without hesitation, Han Xing swallowed it in one gulp.
The vast power of life instantly swept through his body.
His physical injuries healed almost instantaneously as if nothing had happened.
And within his body remained an even more tremendous power of life.
Seizing this moment.
Han Xing endured the excruciating tearing pain throughout his body.
And approached within less than a kilometer of the tail spike again.
Then.
He took a deep breath.
Suddenly released his entire divine power, enveloping it.
And with a thought, Han Xing stored it directly in his backpack.
The system prompt appeared.
[Acquired Calamity Beast Tail Spike*1...]
[Survivor, please note, your actions exceeded expectations, you have completed an impossible task, recalculating world influence...]
[World Influence +723, Legendary Points +20.]
[Current World Influence reached 5000, unlocked title: Transcender.]
At this moment.
A brilliant smile suddenly appeared on Han Xing’s face.
However, due to being covered in blood, the smile appeared rather eerie.
But, Han Xing didn’t mind.
Because he had succeeded!
Not only did he successfully retrieve the tail spike.
But even the system deemed it impossible.
Yet he had done it.
And also unlocked a new title!
[Transcender]: A special hidden title awarded to those who have made a significant impact on the world line.
[Title Effect]: Your thread of fate will be hidden, making it more difficult for certain powerful beings to predict your future path, nor can they harm you through the thread of fate.
Seeing the effect of this title.
A look of joy appeared on Han Xing’s face.
Then, his body shook.
The blood on his body disappeared instantly.
In the next moment.
Han Xing’s figure flickered.
And he returned directly to the Sky Island.
During the time Han Xing had left.
Shen Yun continually applied healing techniques to everyone.
The healing amount of a Legendary Level Radiant Knight was astonishing.
In just a moment, he had restored their injuries to this point.
The four of them saw Han Xing safely return, and a relieved smile appeared on their faces.
However, this also meant one thing.
Han Xing had successfully collected the tail spike.
At this time, everyone eagerly looked at Han Xing.
Seemingly very curious about this tail spike.
Han Xing didn’t keep them in suspense.
He straightforwardly displayed its attributes.
[Calamity Beast Tail Spike (Unknown Quality)]: A tail spike imbued with divine power, one of the most powerful parts of the Calamity Beast.
[Attached Effect]: God-Breaking Spike, Extreme Giant Beast Poison.

[God-Breaking Spike]: The tail spike contains intense law of divine power with an absolute forbidden break effect, capable of piercing the Divine Power Domain of low-tier divine spirits and below beings.
[Extreme Giant Beast Poison]: The tail spike retains the beast’s deadly toxin, inflicting 100 layers of Giant Beast Poison effect on the target instantly, capable of harming a True God.
[Remaining Toxic Attack Count]: 3.

At this moment, Cheng Jianyong swallowed hard: "100 layers of Giant Beast Poison, it’s truly terrifying..."
"If this thing pricks you even once, perhaps even a true Divine Spirit would die, right?"
No one answered.
Because, what Cheng Jianyong said was true.
The effect on this Giant Beast Tail Spike was clearly marked.
It’s made to deal with Divine Spirits!
And not just any Divine Spirits.
But True Gods!
What realm a True God is, Han Xing didn’t know.
But he believed.
With this thing in hand.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, he could walk sideways.
What Demigods, what Shadow Monarchs.
Could they withstand a single prick from me?
At this moment.
Han Xing just felt, it was worth it!
All the trouble he went through to break this tail spike off was worthwhile!
Even risking his life to put it into his backpack.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong said regretfully: "What a pity, that Extreme Giant Beast Poison can only be used three times."
"If we could use it without limitation, we would truly be invincible!"
The group also felt a bit of regret.
However, Han Xing didn’t feel this way at all, comforting them: "Be content."
"Three times of Giant Beast Poison means we have three chances to threaten or even kill a Divine Spirit."
"And even when the uses of the Giant Beast Poison are finished, the other effect of the tail spike is extremely terrifying."
"Just a light jab, and we could instantly shatter the Divine Power Domain of ordinary Divine Spirits and Demigods!"
"By then, without the Divine Power Domain, their combat strength would drop significantly."
"In this contrast, our advantage is huge!
Upon hearing these words, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Their sense of loss was swept away.
They became more confident once again.
At this time, Shen Yun asked: "Brother Xing, where do we go next?"
Everyone looked eagerly at Han Xing.
As if expecting the next terrifying rewards they might encounter.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and said: "Now, the beast’s whole body has been mostly explored by us."
"Only the head region remains unexplored."
"Let’s go, once we’ve searched the head, we should prepare to return to the Witch Race Territory."
The group nodded together.
Then, they began to move in a straight line on the back of the giant beast.
Their target was the beast’s head region.
Hours later.
The group reached the beast’s skull.
Which was the area of the crown of its head.
In this place.
Han Xing and the others spent another two to three days searching and obtained a large number of High-Level Divine Stones and a full harvest of 400 pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Then.
They reached the area of the beast’s face.
Here, it’s the left eye socket of the giant beast.
However, inside it was empty, with no blood or flesh visible.
It seemed as if during a battle with a powerful being, the beast’s eye had been attacked.
Causing the entire eyeball to vanish.
At the edge of the eye socket, Han Xing collected some Divine Blood.
After spending another two days to finish searching this area.
Han Xing and his team had almost stayed on the beast’s corpse for a month.
Then, they came to the right eye socket.
Compared to the other eye, the beast’s right eye was relatively intact, not having suffered any fatal injuries.
However.
Perhaps due to the beast’s death, its pupil appeared a ghostly white, looking somewhat eerie.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island, and as they flew past the beast’s eye.
It felt as if they were passing by a gigantic white planet.
Causing the team’s fear of enormous objects to almost surface.
Suppressing the discomfort in their hearts, the group quickly finished searching the surface of the beast’s eye.
To their delight.
They found many pieces of colorful metal on it.
These were all Calamity Divine Gold.
A full five hundred pieces!
The enormous harvest quickly washed away their discomfort.
Han Xing was even more excited, leading them in exploring the giant beast’s face.
Then.
They finally arrived at the last area.
Which was the location of the beast’s mouth.
From a distance, the beast’s mouth appeared like a slightly opened gate.
The edge of the gate was filled with sharp teeth.
Through the beast’s slightly opened mouth.
The group saw a faint white light emanating from inside.
"Light?"
Cheng Jianyong said with a hint of confusion.
"Isn’t this beast already dead? How can there be light in its mouth?"
None of those present could answer his question.
It even sent chills through everyone’s heart.
Because prior to this, they had confirmed.
The beast had been dead for many years, and its body surface showed no signs of Life.
When Han Xing first landed on the beast’s corpse, he also harbored such suspicions.
But as they continued to search, his doubts gradually dissipated.
In the end, he was certain that there was no new Life on the beast’s corpse.
Now with this situation... could they have been wrong?
Han Xing thought in his heart.
’Could there indeed be Life that emerged on the beast’s corpse.’
’Just not on the body surface.’
’But inside it?’
Han Xing’s eyes suddenly widened.
Thinking of the beast’s colossal body.
The internal space within it might be tens of thousands of times larger than the former Blue Star!
If conditions were right.
Not to mention Life appearing, even nurturing a vast civilization would be quite possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 337: Godslaying Relic
paragraphs: Han Xing was startled by his own speculation.
However, in the next moment.
He couldn’t help but feel curious!
If his guess was true.
Then.
What kind of life exists inside the beast?
What do they look like?
And do these beings know that there is a much wider world outside the beast’s body?
All of these questions sparked Han Xing’s curiosity.
At this moment.
Shen Yun seemed to understand Han Xing’s thoughts.
So he said, "Brother Xing, should we move in closer to take a look?"
"To be honest, we are also curious about what’s inside the beast’s mouth."
Hearing this, the others also had a sparkle in their eyes.
Han Xing nodded, "Then let’s go take a look."
As soon as he spoke.
Han Xing then controlled the Sky Island to slowly approach the area of the beast’s mouth.
However.
Before they could get close, they felt a terrifying sense of tearing!
This tearing sensation was similar to the feeling from the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
Yet it was even more terrifying!
Everyone quickly discovered the source of these tearing sensations.
It was precisely the countless teeth on the beast’s large mouth!
Being the beast’s mouth, it was also one of its common tools for combat.
These teeth also contained powerful laws of divine power.
Even though the beast had been dead for countless years.
These laws of divine power still lingered.
Fortunately, at this distance, they could barely withstand it.
But as the Sky Island got closer.
The tearing sensation enveloping their entire bodies grew even more intense!
By now, blood had already started to seep from the bodies of the team members!
Shen Yun hurriedly deployed a Great Recovery Array.
On the ground, a massive array with a diameter of thousands of meters suddenly appeared.
Gentle Holy Light flowed into their bodies.
The life force of everyone quickly recovered at an incredible rate.
Seizing the moment while the array was active.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island to advance several hundred kilometers again.
At this point, the oppressive force of the laws of divine power became even more intense.
The healing speed could not keep up with the terrifying tearing sensation.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun felt a stinging pain all over their bodies once again.
Blood was seeping from their pores.
However, at this distance...
Han Xing vaguely saw the light inside the giant beast’s mouth growing stronger and stronger.
Moreover, the light was bright red.
It was as if the light was emanating from the Sun itself.
Han Xing looked at his own state cooldown time.
He also saw the look of pain on his team members’ faces.
At this moment, Han Xing realized they had reached their limit here.
Han Xing turned back and said.
"Wait for me here, I’ll take a quick look and come right back."
There was a trace of reluctance in the eyes of the team members.
But they knew they could not advance any further.
They could only nod helplessly.
Then.
Han Xing directly summoned the Oracle Throne, his figure flashed.
He advanced another ten thousand meters.
Here, the distance to the giant beast’s mouth was still around a hundred kilometers.
Even Han Xing felt the pricking sensation all over his body...
However, as Han Xing activated the Divine Power Shield.
That stinging sensation vanished instantly.
Han Xing’s basic attributes were already significantly higher than Cheng Jianyong and the others.
With the title of [Witch Race Saint Master], it was more than double.
Therefore, he could withstand the laws of divine power of the beast and get closer.
Soon.
Han Xing arrived at a place less than fifty kilometers away from the beast’s mouth.
Here, the pressure doubled sharply.
His divine power domain was shredded in an instant!
At this moment, Han Xing hurriedly activated his equipment effect, relying on his robust constitution to barely stand his ground.
He thought with some fear, "The divine power suppression here is terrifying, any ordinary Legend, even a High-tier Legend, would be severely injured or even killed here."
"To pass through the beast’s mouth, one would need at least a Demigod level existence."
"And not just an ordinary Demigod."
"It would have to be someone at least at the level of a Shadow Monarch!"
Even he, at this distance, was reaching his limit.
But.
He really wanted to know what was inside the beast’s body.
After a moment, Han Xing seemed to make up his mind.
He took a deep breath.
In the next moment, he activated his full body effects.
Han Xing’s momentum soared once again.
Vaguely, he reached the Demigod level again.
At the same time.
Han Xing’s divine power domain expanded by more than tenfold.
It directly covered the beast’s mouth.
At this moment, Han Xing finally saw the scene inside.
Although it was just a quick glance.
It made Han Xing gasp in shock!
Because in his eyes.
He saw countless lines!
These lines, thick or thin, varied in color.
They were the fate lines of those life forms!
And this indirectly confirmed Han Xing’s hypothesis.
Life had indeed emerged inside the beast.
And the number was quite frightening!
Just then.
Han Xing’s actions seemed to trigger some form of taboo!
The intense divine power from the beast’s mouth was already pressing down.
Han Xing suddenly felt as if a massive mountain had descended atop his head.
The divine power domain he had just spread out was instantly riddled with holes.
In the last moment of time.
Han Xing exerted all his strength, wielding divine power to initiate God’s Perspective within the beast’s body.
At this moment.
Han Xing suddenly seemed to be frozen, standing blankly in place.
Then.
His divine power was directly cut off, pulling him out of God’s Perspective.
Han Xing suddenly coughed up a mouthful of blood.
A powerful backlash struck fiercely.
Han Xing even felt a crisis of impending death!
In an instant!
Han Xing directly utilized the teleportation effect of the Oracle Throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 337: Godslaying Relic! (Part 3)
paragraphs: He teleported himself tens of thousands of meters away, directly back to the Sky Island.
At the same time.
The terrifying pressure overhead suddenly disappeared.
Ignoring the shocked and worried eyes of everyone.
Han Xing directly poured a bottle of Holy Tree Spirit Secret Elixir into his mouth.
Then, without looking back, he controlled the Sky Island to flee at full speed!
Along the way.
Han Xing remained in a state of high alert.
Everyone even noticed that his hand holding the Longbow was trembling slightly.
No one spoke.
Nor did they dare to ask Han Xing what he had seen.
Not until the Sky Island re-entered the Space Turbulence.
After moving away from that massive carcass.
Did Han Xing finally put down the weapon in his hand.
"Phew..."
Han Xing let out a long sigh of relief.
Everyone looked at him with worried expressions.
At this moment, Han Xing also realized.
His reaction just now was a bit too intense.
He had even made the others a little frightened.
But there was no way around it.
Because what he saw inside the beast’s body was just too terrifying!
Without needing the team to speak.
Han Xing directly said:
"It’s almost as you imagine, there are things inside the beast’s body."
Hearing this, everyone’s pupils instantly widened.
Han Xing continued: "Inside, I saw quite a vast continent."
"On this continent, life has already been born."
"And not just simple life forms, but an extraordinarily vast civilization!"
"The number of lives on it is countless."
"And more terrifyingly, it seems someone on that continent noticed my probing."
"In an instant, they cut off my divine power sensing!"
The more Han Xing spoke, the more everyone felt the terror inside the beast’s body!
No wonder Han Xing reacted so dramatically.
However, Han Xing’s next words left everyone even more speechless.
"I have a familiarity with that being’s power."
"The same oppressive feeling I experienced when the God of Light’s will descended last time!"
Hearing this, everyone drew in a sharp breath.
Because this sentence implied.
There might be a true Divine Spirit inside the beast!
This is too terrifying!
From understanding the world’s background,
they already knew that the Divine Spirits of this world had all left the Holy Spirit Realm and couldn’t descend easily.
And now, in the endless Void.
There unexpectedly was a Divine Spirit hiding inside the Beast of Calamity’s carcass.
What does this Divine Spirit intend to do?
Is the civilization inside his handiwork?
All this, no one knew.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong swallowed hard and said, "Bro...Brother Xing, you said that Divine Spirit noticed you."
"Did...did it not chase after us?"
Han Xing nodded with difficulty, "It seems it didn’t chase us."
"Just now, I was constantly ready for an ambush, even prepared for a life and death struggle."
"But it doesn’t seem to have any intention of coming out."
"Or perhaps, like other gods, this Divine Spirit also has restrictions, unable to come out from the beast’s body."
Everyone nodded.
In their hearts, they leaned towards the latter explanation.
After all, they had stayed on the beast’s body surface for nearly a month.
The other party showed no signs of coming out.
This indicates, it indeed has some restrictions.
Thinking of this,
everyone simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, Han Xing steered the Sky Island to advance again towards the Holy Spirit Realm territory.
But.
Before leaving,
Han Xing turned back and took a deep look at that area.
That place undeniably hides a great secret.
He currently lacks strength.
When he has an opportunity in the future,
he will definitely return here once more!
To uncover the secrets of this place, as well as the identity and purpose of that Divine Spirit.
At the same time.
Inside the beast.
A continent larger than the Witch Race Continent floated mid-air.
Upon the continent, resembling an entire world.
Countless lives reside here,
And at the sky’s firmament.
A being emanating Holy Light, dazzling like the sun, hovered mid-air.
It seemingly acts as this world’s sun, bringing light to the entire world.
At this moment.
This being murmured softly: "Escaped, did he?"
"How interesting..."
"From that young one’s appearance, it seems he’s from the Human Race?"
At this time, he cast a gentle glance at the continent below.
"A pity, if that young one had delayed by just a moment, I indeed intended to invite him in as a guest."
A moment later.
This being shook his head: "Oh well, that young one harbors secrets."
"Even I on him sense a dangerous aura..."
"I wonder which one of them is behind this."
Within the Space Turbulence.
A Sky Island around four to five square kilometers wide, wrapped in multiple layers of divine power, advanced at high speed.
The Void Beasts encountered along the way, almost upon sensing the Sky Island’s aura.
Fled in panic in no particular direction.
Han Xing and the others moved unimpeded in the Space Turbulence.
Seven days later...
Han Xing, following the coordinates, approached the edge of the Space Turbulence yet again.
In a bit more time, they would return to the Holy Spirit Realm.
Inside the Witch Race Territory.
Upon reaching here,
The number of Void Beasts increased noticeably.
Frightening Void Beast waves constantly manifested, charging towards the Witch Race Border.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise: "My goodness... over a month has passed, and the Void Beast waves are still erupting."
"And it’s even more terrifying than before we left!"
Han Xing frowned and said: "We haven’t received any message from Wu Ling’Er, so it shouldn’t be a big problem."
"But since we’ve seen it, let’s solve it casually."
Everyone simultaneously nodded.
Compared to before entering the Space Turbulence,
Han Xing and the group’s power had changed significantly.
To deal with these ordinary Void Beasts,
releasing divine power directly could wipe them out in large swathes.
"Buzz!"
As the five’s Divine Power Domains were unleashed,
In mere moments,
The surrounding Void Beasts were cleared away!

At the same time.

Hearing this, everyone drew in a sharp breath.
Because this sentence implied.
There might be a true Divine Spirit inside the beast!
This is too terrifying!
From understanding the world’s background,
they already knew that the Divine Spirits of this world had all left the Holy Spirit Realm and couldn’t descend easily.
And now, in the endless Void.
There unexpectedly was a Divine Spirit hiding inside the Beast of Calamity’s carcass.
What does this Divine Spirit intend to do?
Is the civilization inside his handiwork?
All this, no one knew.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong swallowed hard and said, "Bro...Brother Xing, you said that Divine Spirit noticed you."
"Did...did it not chase after us?"
Han Xing nodded with difficulty, "It seems it didn’t chase us."
"Just now, I was constantly ready for an ambush, even prepared for a life and death struggle."
"But it doesn’t seem to have any intention of coming out."
"Or perhaps, like other gods, this Divine Spirit also has restrictions, unable to come out from the beast’s body."
Everyone nodded.
In their hearts, they leaned towards the latter explanation.
After all, they had stayed on the beast’s body surface for nearly a month.
The other party showed no signs of coming out.
This indicates, it indeed has some restrictions.
Thinking of this,
everyone simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, Han Xing steered the Sky Island to advance again towards the Holy Spirit Realm territory.
But.
Before leaving,
Han Xing turned back and took a deep look at that area.
That place undeniably hides a great secret.
He currently lacks strength.
When he has an opportunity in the future,
he will definitely return here once more!
To uncover the secrets of this place, as well as the identity and purpose of that Divine Spirit.
At the same time.
Inside the beast.
A continent larger than the Witch Race Continent floated mid-air.
Upon the continent, resembling an entire world.
Countless lives reside here,
And at the sky’s firmament.
A being emanating Holy Light, dazzling like the sun, hovered mid-air.
It seemingly acts as this world’s sun, bringing light to the entire world.
At this moment.
This being murmured softly: "Escaped, did he?"
"How interesting..."
"From that young one’s appearance, it seems he’s from the Human Race?"
At this time, he cast a gentle glance at the continent below.
"A pity, if that young one had delayed by just a moment, I indeed intended to invite him in as a guest."
A moment later.
This being shook his head: "Oh well, that young one harbors secrets."
"Even I on him sense a dangerous aura..."
"I wonder which one of them is behind this."
Within the Space Turbulence.
A Sky Island around four to five square kilometers wide, wrapped in multiple layers of divine power, advanced at high speed.
The Void Beasts encountered along the way, almost upon sensing the Sky Island’s aura.
Fled in panic in no particular direction.
Han Xing and the others moved unimpeded in the Space Turbulence.
Seven days later...
Han Xing, following the coordinates, approached the edge of the Space Turbulence yet again.
In a bit more time, they would return to the Holy Spirit Realm.
Inside the Witch Race Territory.
Upon reaching here,
The number of Void Beasts increased noticeably.
Frightening Void Beast waves constantly manifested, charging towards the Witch Race Border.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise: "My goodness... over a month has passed, and the Void Beast waves are still erupting."
"And it’s even more terrifying than before we left!"
Han Xing frowned and said: "We haven’t received any message from Wu Ling’Er, so it shouldn’t be a big problem."
"But since we’ve seen it, let’s solve it casually."
Everyone simultaneously nodded.
Compared to before entering the Space Turbulence,
Han Xing and the group’s power had changed significantly.
To deal with these ordinary Void Beasts,
releasing divine power directly could wipe them out in large swathes.
"Buzz!"
As the five’s Divine Power Domains were unleashed,
In mere moments,
The surrounding Void Beasts were cleared away!

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 338: The Threat from the Path of the Giant Dragon
paragraphs: At this moment, everyone was killing their way forward.
Countless void beasts seemed to have encountered a reaper of life, one by one their bodies stiffened, then they fell into the void.
[Successfully killed void beast, three-star creature, gained experience value 12000...]
[Success...]
The prompts frantically flooded the screen.
Legendary powerhouses were extremely efficient at slaughtering these ordinary creatures.
However, they were helpless as the experience needed to level up now had become increasingly daunting.
After killing hundreds of thousands of void beasts, the experience bar hadn’t even budged.
Even for Han Xing, it had been over a month since he neared a breakthrough, yet his experience bar was still stuck at level 50, 67%.
This gave an indication.
How horrifying the experience value required was after tier five.
A dozen minutes later.
Han Xing and the others saw the light ahead.
Once they reached the place where the light was, they could return to the Witch Race border.
At this moment on the Witch Race border.
They were resisting the burst of the void beast tide.
Endless void beasts were impacting the defensive line constructed by Witch Race soldiers.
Among them, there were even three Fifth-Turn Dominator Level void beasts!
The situation of the war was extremely tense.
All Witch Race soldiers were trying their best to resist the void beast tide.
However, no matter how heroically they fought.
Under the absolute suppression of numbers, they could only barely block.
If not for the dozens of defense towers left by Han Xing providing powerful firepower.
At this moment, the defensive line formed by Witch Race soldiers would have already collapsed!
And at this time.
None could restrain the three Dominator Level void beasts!
Dominator Level void beasts charged back and forth among the army causing massive casualties.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
The bodies of groups of Witch Race soldiers exploded into bloody mist in the air.
In the blink of an eye, a large number of casualties appeared!
Beside them, several Witch Race officers leading the troops cursed angrily: "Damn! Follow me and hold on!"
These officers at most had the strength of Four-star Lord Level.
They were completely insignificant in comparison to the Fifth-Turn Dominator Level void beasts.
But there was no choice.
Here, they were already the most powerful existences.
If they didn’t step forward, they could only watch as the three Dominator void beasts continued their carnage.
As the words were spoken, seven Witch Race officers took the initiative to stand up.
Each led an Ancient Weapon Guard.
Then charged forward recklessly.
But it was obvious, their actions were akin to courting death!
At this moment.
A void beast resembling a weevil suddenly sprayed a stream of black liquid.
"Puff! Puff!"
The Magic Elephant War Chariot team behind the seven Witch Race officers was instantly pierced through eight units.
Including one officer who died tragically on the spot.
This scene caused everyone to visibly tighten their eyes!
"Damn it! I will kill you!"
A Witch Race officer shouted, "Soldiers, I will deploy all Tower of Death Light to kill these three Dominator void beasts!"
"Before then, no matter the sacrifice, you must hold on!"
The Witch Race soldiers fighting on the front lines heard this and their expressions became solemn.
Without the firepower support of these defense towers.
Their pressure would increase instantly.
The formation could be torn apart in an instant.
But now, they understood.
Their commander’s decision was the most correct.
If these three Dominator void beasts weren’t dealt with, everyone would die.
This borderland would fall.
In an instant, all Witch Race soldiers shouted resolutely.
"Yes!"
The terrifying beast tide rushed forward.
All the soldiers had a determination to die, ready to use their lives to block the footsteps of void beast invasion.
And at this moment.
In the puzzled eyes of a group of Witch Race soldiers.
Suddenly saw a Sky Island abruptly appear from the void.
And on it, stood five humans with terrifying auras, and a giant black wolf over ten meters long!
With the emergence of the Sky Island.
Wherever it passed, those void beasts with a terrifying number died in swathes.
Just a few seconds passed.
The void beasts within a range of more than ten kilometers were completely wiped out!
At this moment.
Han Xing also caught sight of the three Dominator Level void beasts brutally slaughtering in the distance.
A hint of anger appeared in his eyes.
Including those void beasts, all sensed the killing intent from this human.
For a moment, there was actually a trace of fear in their eyes.
They instinctively wanted to flee.
Yet in the next instant.
Three arrows abruptly shot out.
Then, at a terrifying speed, they directly penetrated the bodies of the three Dominator void beasts.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
These void Dominators didn’t even have time to react.
Before being blown into pieces in mid-air.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed void leaf bug: Dominator level creature, gained experience value 824 million, automatically absorbed the divine power from the opponent, divine power value +1...]
[Successfully killed...]
At this moment.
The entire battlefield became silent.
With the appearance of that man.
The void beast tide that was originally extremely daunting.
Was instantly dismantled.
At this point.
A group of Witch Race officers were the first to react.
They knelt on one knee, simultaneously saluting.
"Greetings, Saint Master Han Xing!"
The other Witch Race soldiers also collectively knelt on one knee with a swish.
"Greetings, Saint Master Han Xing!"
Han Xing nodded lightly.
Gesturing for the group of Witch Race soldiers to dispense with the formalities.
Before they could lift their heads to look.
Suddenly sensed that the atmosphere wasn’t right.
Han Xing’s brow seemed to carry a vague anger.
Han Xing asked at this moment: "Where’s Otto, call him over."
Sensing Han Xing’s displeasure, the officers shuddered in their hearts.
At this time, a middle-aged officer with a resolute face stepped forward.
He spoke carefully: "Re...Return Saint Master..."
"Lord Otto is not here."

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 338: The Threat from the Path of the Giant Dragon
paragraphs: Han Xing’s eyebrows shot up instantly, "Not here?"
His tone turned even colder.
"Didn’t I tell him to make sure to guard the border area well for me?"
"What’s the situation now?"
Noticing the anger in Han Xing’s tone.
All the officers felt a chill run down their spines!
They hadn’t anticipated that the usually gentle Saint Master Han Xing could be so terrifying when angry.
However, they also understood the reason for Han Xing’s anger.
Otto was originally the high-level combat power that Han Xing had stationed here.
It was specifically to deal with the sudden occurrences of dominator-level void beasts.
But now.
Because Otto wasn’t here.
It led to significant casualties among the Witch Race soldiers.
If Han Xing hadn’t come just now.
Then the casualties would have been even more terrifying!
It’s possible that the border area might have directly fallen.
The consequences would be unimaginable!
At this moment, the Witch Race officer hurriedly explained, "Lord Saint Master, it isn’t that Lord Otto left his post without permission."
"It’s because he was urgently assigned by the Lady Saintess to the southwestern region of the Witch Race border."
Upon hearing this,
The anger in Han Xing’s eyes gradually subsided.
He questioned in puzzlement, "Ling’Er assigned him?"
"The southwest direction, isn’t that where the Land of the Abandoned Gods is located?"
"What’s happening there?"
The Witch Race officer seemed a bit reluctant to speak.
Han Xing solemnly said, "Speak."
The Witch Race officer sighed, "Lord Saint Master, it’s not that the Land of the Abandoned Gods is having problems."
"It’s the Path of the Giant Dragon that’s having some issues."
Surprise flashed in Han Xing’s eyes, "Is it that group of giant dragons?
The Witch Race officer nodded, "Yes, recently, hasn’t there been a void chaos erupting everywhere in the Witch Race territory?"
"It has even affected the Path of the Giant Dragon area..."
"That group of giant dragons seems extremely angry, believing it was due to our Witch Race’s inadequate watchfulness, allowing their sacred Path of the Giant Dragon to be contaminated."
"Recently, a group of giant dragons came to the main city of our Witch Race territory, demanding explanations."
"They demanded we send troops to solve the void beasts’ troubles in the Witch Race territory."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing squinted his eyes.
"They want us to solve the void beasts’ troubles?"
"Has that group of giant dragons lost their minds?"
"Damn it, we didn’t cause the void chaos, why should we handle it?"
A hint of anger appeared in Han Xing’s tone.
The current Witch Race, to deal with the outbreak of void beasts, was already struggling to fend for itself.
Yet that group of giant dragons demanded they deploy troops to guard the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Isn’t this adding fuel to the fire?
The Witch Race officer solemnly said, "You’re right, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Lady Saintess also had this thought, so she didn’t agree at that time."
"However, that group of giant dragons said it was a promise previously made by Saint Master Helas, in person."
"As a condition for taking something from the Path of the Giant Dragon, the Witch Race must ensure that the sacred Path of the Giant Dragon is not violated."
Han Xing’s brows furrowed.
"Helas agreed to it?"
"This old account has unexpectedly landed on us..."
Han Xing felt at a loss for words.
"Did Wu Ling’Er agree?" Han Xing asked.
The officer shook his head, "The Lady Saintess refused."

"However, this time, the giant dragons acted directly, not only severely injuring the High Priest but also capturing over ten thousand Witch Race civilians, including over a hundred from the Human Race."
"And they threatened us to quickly resolve the issue of the void chaos."
"If any more void beasts invade the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"Then they will not only eliminate all the hostages but will also come to the Witch Race Continent to capture more civilians."
Instantly, anger surfaced in Han Xing’s eyes.
Before he could speak,
Cheng Jianyong, standing by, couldn’t help but curse, "Damn it, those giant dragons are too arrogant!"
"What do they take us for? Their servants? To be used as they please?"
No one else spoke.
Given the arrogant nature of the giant dragons, they probably did think this way.
Moreover, the strength of the giant dragons is extremely formidable; those void beasts are akin to ants in comparison to them.
They could easily crush them with a flick of their fingers.
But they are afraid of dirtying their hands and insist that the Witch Race dispatch forces to suppress them.
However, as mentioned before,
The void chaos wasn’t caused by the Witch Race.
Why should they bear the responsibility?
A hint of anger surfaced again in Han Xing’s eyes.
"When that group of giant dragons seized our Witch Race civilians, didn’t you resist?"
"What about the defense towers I left behind?"
The Witch Race officer continued to explain, "The Lady Saintess did take action."
"She also mobilized the defense towers you left to retaliate."
"But at that moment, a burst of golden light emerged from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon, which directly neutralized the attacks from the Witch Race Continent’s defense towers."
"Including the Lady Saintess, who was also directly suppressed by this golden light."
"Now, she has no choice but to lead the High Priest and Lord Otto personally stationed at the Path of the Giant Dragon..."
Moments later.
Han Xing returned to the Witch Race Continent.
His eyes showed a trace of concern.
This time, that group of giant dragons suddenly caused trouble.
Although the reasons sounded plausible, along with Helas’s previous promise,
It still gave Han Xing a sense of something unusual.
"The one who came to the Witch Race Continent to capture people should have been that Red Dragon."
"The golden light mentioned by that officer was likely the handiwork of that Golden Dragon..."
In Han Xing’s impression, the Golden Dragon was the most powerful entity on the entire Path of the Giant Dragon.
And it appeared to be more reasonable than the other dragons, not seeming entirely unreasonable.
But now, even it had acted.
This indirectly proved that this was the intention of the entire Giant Dragon Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 338: The Threat from the Path of the Giant Dragon
paragraphs: Han Xing didn’t know whether the so-called Sacred Giant Dragon Path was truly inviolable or that important.
But he knew that if he went over to demand people, he might have a conflict with the Golden Dragon.
Even now,
Han Xing still couldn’t gauge its strength.
If he confronted such a being, even Han Xing wouldn’t have much confidence.
"However..."
Han Xing suddenly murmured, "This time, the Void Turbulence also brought me many opportunities."
"If I can fully absorb it, it will be enough to bring about a massive qualitative change in my territory’s firepower!"
Right now, Han Xing possessed a large amount of precious resources.
Just mentioning them would frighten others to death!
And with these resources, he could construct more high-tier Ancient Weapons, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Additionally,
he had several other trump cards in hand.
Therefore,
he wasn’t too wary of that mysterious Golden Dragon.
Beside him, Shen Yun asked somewhat uncertainly, "Brother Xing, are we going over there this time to fight those Dragons?"
Cheng Jianyong scoffed, "What’s wrong, Xiaoyunzi, are you scared?"
"This group of Dragons attacked first, not only injuring the Legendary Powerhouses of our camp but also capturing so many people!"
"This behavior is basically a one-sided declaration of war."
"If we had the power, it wouldn’t just be about starting a war, wiping out all these Dragons would be perfectly justified!"
Shen Yun glared at him and said, "You’re thinking too simplistically."
"Those Dragons don’t seem to be mindlessly brutal; their sudden attack on us clearly reflects the will of the entire Giant Dragon Race."
"There may even be additional factors at play."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was taken aback.
He hadn’t considered as much as Shen Yun, showing a puzzled expression.
"Are you saying there’s more to this than meets the eye?"
At this point, Han Xing also said, "Xiaoyun is indeed correct."
"The situation may be more complex than we imagined."
"Moreover, the strength of this group of Dragons shouldn’t be underestimated either!"
However, Han Xing’s next words made their eyes light up simultaneously.
"But, since they’ve brought the fight to us, there’s no need for us to keep backing down!
"If this time, those Dragons don’t give us a proper explanation, then let there be war!"
As the leader of a camp, every word Han Xing spoke carried considerable weight.
And now, he also had the confidence to back it up.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm,
in the absence of Divine Spirits,
he could already be considered invincible!
But the premise is,
he can turn all the gains from this time into combat power.
So,
the first thing Han Xing did when returning to the Witch Race Continent,
was go to the vicinity of Ten Thousand Stars City, preparing to invest a large amount of resources to build the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
But before that,
he had one more action to take.
That is, to activate the Miracle Tower.
To see if he could randomly obtain the "Accelerated Building" or "Building Consumption Reduction" effects.
Both miracle effects would greatly aid Han Xing in his upcoming actions.
After sacrificing some materials,
the Miracle Tower emitted a dazzling white light.
A system message appeared.
"Sacrifice successful, randomly obtained one miracle effect, ’Building Consumption Reduction’: within 24 hours, building consumption reduced by 20%."
Hearing this prompt, Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
"It’s here!"
This was one of the miracle effects he most desired.
When constructing those territory buildings, it could save him a significant amount of resources.
Especially this time.
Han Xing planned to mass-produce the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
For these high-tier Ancient Weapons, saving 20% on each one was incredibly valuable!
Han Xing glanced at his inventory, nearly filled with 1600 slots of precious materials.
Among them, the quantity of the Philosopher’s Stone had exceeded 1.5 million, and the Shimmering Terra Stone was at 1.4 million.
Just these two gains alone surpassed four or five times the foundation of the Witch Race Treasury.
In addition,
this time he also acquired over 70,000 pieces of Calamity Divine Gold!
At this time, the wealth Han Xing possessed,
probably few people in the entire Holy Spirit Realm could match.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile, "With the material reserves in my inventory, I can create at least over three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons!"
"Now, with the blessing effect of the Miracle Tower, that means I can build over four hundred!"
"And the firepower of just one Spiritual Godslaying Cannon is enough to heavily wound a Demigod Level powerhouse!"
"Now, with over four hundred Godslaying Cannons, plus the amplification effect of the Sun Crown Stele..."
"Under a full force onslaught, perhaps, it would be enough to slay a divine being!"
After arriving at this astonishing conclusion,
Han Xing was startled by himself.
Then, he was seized with uncontrollable elation.
He had unintentionally gained the means to kill a divine being!
And with a few more trump cards in his grasp!
Han Xing felt even more confident about his next actions!
Thinking of this, Han Xing immediately couldn’t wait to click on building.
"Would you like to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*4000, Shimmering Terra Stone*4000, Shadow Divine Stone*8000, Calamity Divine Gold*8, to construct a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?"
Among the four materials, the other three need no further mention.
Han Xing’s inventory was more than sufficient.
As for the Shadow Divine Stone,
since the Witch Race frequently dealt with the Shadow Legion,
the amount of Shadow Divine Stones in the Witch Race Treasury had also reached a staggering number.
Enough for Han Xing to squander at will.
Thus, he clicked yes!
And he clicked it continuously 300 times!
"Constructing... Remaining time 34 hours 24 minutes..."
Han Xing looked at the vast area of his territory shining with Holy Light.
A smile gradually appeared on his face.
"Very well, next, I just need to wait for the successful construction of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons."
"I’ll have the strength to directly confront those Dragons head-on!"
However, even without the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons,
with Han Xing’s current personal strength, he wasn’t afraid of those Dragons anyway.
Currently, those Dragons still held a large number of Witch Race people.
Among them, there were also several hundred human Survivors.

he had several other trump cards in hand.
