chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 339: ’Watchdog,’ Han Xing’s Killing Intent
paragraphs: To avoid unnecessary delays.
Han Xing still decided to rescue these hostages as soon as possible.
Han Xing sent a message to Wu Ling’Er.
"I have returned, how are things on your side?"
At this moment.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s transmission.
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes showed a look of surprise, hurriedly asking.
"Brother Xing! You’ve already emerged from the Void Turbulence?"
Han Xing replied softly, "Yes."
"Ling’Er, with such serious events happening in the Witch Race Territory recently, why didn’t you tell me?"
Wu Ling’Er seemed to pick up on Han Xing’s somewhat displeased tone and answered apologetically.
"I’m sorry, Brother Xing."
"I heard you went into the Void Turbulence and knew it was an extremely dangerous place."
"Even Saint Master Helas normally wouldn’t dare to stay there for long."
"Besides, it was a promise made by Saint Master Helas, so I thought I should handle it myself."
Wu Ling’Er’s tone carried some guilt, along with a trace of self-reproach.
"However, I didn’t expect these giant dragons to be so intolerable, injuring our legends and capturing so many Witch Race people."
After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s explanation.
Han Xing’s expression softened somewhat.
He knew Wu Ling’Er was considering him.
The impression Han Xing gave was strong.
But his actual combat power was equivalent to a high-tier legend.
When fully unleashed, he could injure demigod-level powerhouses.
And the Void Turbulence was exceedingly dangerous.
It was normal for Wu Ling’Er not to want to disturb him.
Moreover.
The threat from the giant dragons at present.
Even if she had informed Han Xing, it probably wouldn’t have made much difference.
This situation clearly couldn’t be resolved by merely one or two high-tier legends.
The force behind the Path of the Giant Dragon was comparable to those large clans in the Holy Spirit Realm, perhaps even surpassing them.
Among them were dragons at the demigod level.
More than one!
Wu Ling’Er knew Han Xing had already helped the Witch Race significantly.
She didn’t want to add more troubles to him.
Thus, Wu Ling’Er thought to solve it in her own way.
However.
Wu Ling’Er underestimated how fast Han Xing was getting stronger.
Or perhaps.
No one in the entire Holy Spirit Realm could have expected.
Someone could advance from less than a Fifth Transformation level to legend in just a month.
And possess Godslaying power!
It’s truly terrifying!
Simply beyond comprehension!
As Wu Ling’Er said before, if Han Xing could balance territory development with personal strength.
Once he breaks through, he would be the strongest legend in history.
Han Xing certainly achieved this!
Han Xing replied, "I understand."
"Tomorrow, I will arrive at the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"Before that, you keep holding on with your people."
Despite his strength, Han Xing didn’t make any bold statements.
Releasing bold statements before controlling the situation, then causing some unforeseen incidents.
It’s an extremely foolish approach.
He prefers.
To have everything under his control, then deliver a thunderous strike to the enemy!
Now, they just need to wait for over thirty hours.
Then Han Xing will have the strength to counter those dragons.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t refuse and said quietly, "Okay, Brother Xing."
After ending the call.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
He looked far off towards the direction of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The next day...
Han Xing suddenly received a message from Wu Ling’Er.
A massive Void Beast tide was erupting on the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Among them were even legendary level Void Beasts.
"Legendary level Void Beasts? It seems Ling’Er’s side is under immense pressure now too."
Han Xing glanced at the construction time remaining for the three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons in his territory.
[Remaining construction time: 6 hours, 32 minutes...]
"6 hours... It’ll also take several hours to reach the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"By the time I get there, it should be almost complete.
"Now, it’s about time to set off."
Thinking of this, Han Xing began to act immediately.
"Rumble!"
The vast Witch Race Continent began to move suddenly at this moment.
The several billion Witch Race people living on it felt the tremors beneath their feet.
In their eyes, besides puzzlement, there was a trace of delight.
Because the one able to control the entire continent.
Was none other than their Saint Master, Lord Han Xing!
"The Saint Master is back! The Saint Master is back!"
The news of Han Xing’s return wasn’t widely publicized.
Thus, most of the Witch Race people were unaware.
At this moment, they began spreading the word eagerly.
Appearing extremely excited.
The events from a few days ago left a psychological shadow on these Witch Race people.
The sudden appearance of the dragons, a breath of dragon fire, destroyed a mountain range.
Though it didn’t cause any casualties.
It made this group of Witch Race people feel the terror of the dragons.
Afterwards.
Those dragons attacked again, easily injuring the legends within their clan.
Even forcing Wu Ling’Er, in front of billions of Witch Race people.
To lead people to guard the Path of the Giant Dragon.
It was sheer humiliation.
Previously, when Helas was around, these things never happened.
Plus, Saint Master Han Xing was not present.
Everyone could only tremble under the dragons’ coercion.
Even Lady Saintess had to compromise.
During this time.
The entire Witch Race Continent had been caught in a slump.
But now.
Han Xing’s return made them feel as though they’d found their backbone again.
"Saint Master Han Xing has returned, he will surely get justice for us!"
"That’s right, the Saint Master will rescue our people!"
However, compared to the majority of the ecstatic Witch Race people.
A portion hiding in houses or some corner looked different.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 339: ’Watchdog,’ Han Xing’s Killing Intent
paragraphs: A strange look flashed across their pale faces.
Han Xing had no idea what they were thinking.
He was seizing the time to enhance his abilities.
At this moment.
The vast Witch Race Continent was rapidly advancing.
"First, swallow these drops of Giant Beast Blood and see if I can further enhance my attributes."
Han Xing handed each of them 5 drops of Giant Beast Blood.
Everyone nodded and accepted it.
Then, Han Xing swallowed it directly.
A powerful divine force emerged within Han Xing.
Quickly surging through his whole body.
Having experienced it once, Han Xing quickly digested it.
The system notification appeared.
[Successfully consumed ’Giant Beast Blood’, Constitution +250, Divine Power Value +50.]
Han Xing nodded slightly.
Just as described by the system before.
On the second consumption, the enhancement effect was directly halved.
However, this boost was still terrifying.
Especially the 50 points of divine power value.
If enhanced using the [Demon Furnace].
It would require refining at least 5 billion souls to reach this figure.
Thus.
Han Xing continued to consume.
The third drop of Giant Beast Blood added only 100 Constitution and 50 Divine Power Value.
Afterwards, it continued to decline.
After the sixth drop, it had no effect.
The others were the same.
Five drops of Giant Beast Blood increased his Constitution by 1000 and Divine Power Value by 300 altogether.
A massive enhancement!
Han Xing glanced at his attributes.
[Name]: Han Xing · Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger · Legend
[Level]: Level 50 (71%)
[Attributes]: Power 25073+25073, Agility 31207+31207, Spirit 22314+22314, Constitution 27149+27149.
[Divine Power Value]: 1413.
Compared to when he just broke through to the Legendary Level, his attribute values increased substantially again.
And this was achieved in just one month.
Logically speaking.
After reaching the Legendary Level, becoming stronger requires more time and resources.
The span here is usually measured in years.
However.
Han Xing seemed like a limitless anomaly.
His rate of becoming stronger was increasing so rapidly, it exceeded everyone’s expectations!
And this, was the result Han Xing wanted.
He looked at the thousands of drops of Giant Beast Blood left in his backpack.
Then, Han Xing glanced at the Coal Ball beside him.
He found that the little guy had been lounging in the territory, sleeping and not very active, ever since it gorged itself on blood last time.
Han Xing shook his head.
hours later.
The vast Witch Race Continent gradually approached the Witch Race Border.
Which was where the Dragon’s Path was located.
From a distance, Han Xing could see the area shrouded in gloom.
Winds howled inside, and purplish-red lightning occasionally flashed.
The first time he reached the Dragon’s Path, Han Xing knew this area was immense.
Now, under God’s Perspective.
Han Xing had an even deeper understanding of this.
His Witch Race Continent wasn’t even one percent the size of this area.
And near the Dragon’s Path, there were Void Turbulences everywhere.
When they were in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, Wu Ling’Er mentioned.
Dragon’s Path existed in the Void itself, serving as a passageway connecting the Land of the Abandoned Gods to the outside.
It was not unusual for large Void Beast Swarms to erupt here.
Han Xing saw Wu Ling’Er, High Priest Xiao, and Otto fighting in the front.
Three Witch Race Legends altogether.
They were at the entrance of the Dragon’s Path, constantly slaying the Void Beasts emerging from the void.
Like guards protecting the dragons,
they feared a single Void Beast slipping past them and into the Dragon’s Path.
After all, those dragons had said.
If Void Beasts desecrate the sacred Dragon’s Path again, they’d crush those Witch Race civilians without hesitation.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er was battling a Legendary Void Beast alone.
With her body bursting with blue Secret Patterns, she forced that Legendary Void Beast to retreat.
But, the Legendary Void Beast was truly stubborn.
Attacks from Wu Ling’Er seemed to hit nothing but air, having no effect.
Moreover.
The Legendary Void Beast, while enduring Wu Ling’Er’s Secret Pattern Domain, charged aggressively.
It seemed to want to engage in close combat with Wu Ling’Er.
High Priest Xiao and Otto wanted to help but were immediately held back by the surging Void Beast Swarm.
Seeing this.
Han Xing furrowed his brow.
The sheer number of Void Beasts here meant they could only barely hold on thanks to their Legendary Level strength.
Moreover, Han Xing noticed.
In that gray area.
There seemed to be a few pairs of eyes watching Wu Ling’Er and the others.
As though observing their pets, filled with a playful intent.
The place was still some distance from the Dragon’s Path.
The Defense Tower’s firepower on the Witch Race Continent couldn’t reach this far.
"Brother Xing."
Cheng Jianyong was about to rush to help.
But saw Han Xing wave his hand.
Then, with a flash, he appeared on the Oracle Throne.
The next moment, Han Xing’s figure vanished from the spot.
Simultaneously, as Wu Ling’Er battled the Legendary Void Beast.
She suddenly heard a gust of wind by her ear.
"Whizz!"
An arrow, traveling at space-tearing speed, instantly hit Wu Ling’Er’s opponent.
Namely, that Legendary Void Beast.
Then, with an explosive sound.
"Poof!"
The arrow detonated within, blowing open the Legendary Void Beast’s abdomen.
Seeing this, Wu Ling’Er’s eyes lit up.
But she also knew this was a rare opportunity.
With rich combat experience, she instinctively drove the Witch Patterns, turning it into a Thunderbolt Long Saber, slicing straight down.

It seemed to want to engage in close combat with Wu Ling’Er.
High Priest Xiao and Otto wanted to help but were immediately held back by the surging Void Beast Swarm.
Seeing this.
Han Xing furrowed his brow.
The sheer number of Void Beasts here meant they could only barely hold on thanks to their Legendary Level strength.
Moreover, Han Xing noticed.
In that gray area.
There seemed to be a few pairs of eyes watching Wu Ling’Er and the others.
As though observing their pets, filled with a playful intent.
The place was still some distance from the Dragon’s Path.
The Defense Tower’s firepower on the Witch Race Continent couldn’t reach this far.
"Brother Xing."
Cheng Jianyong was about to rush to help.
But saw Han Xing wave his hand.
Then, with a flash, he appeared on the Oracle Throne.
The next moment, Han Xing’s figure vanished from the spot.
Simultaneously, as Wu Ling’Er battled the Legendary Void Beast.
She suddenly heard a gust of wind by her ear.
"Whizz!"
An arrow, traveling at space-tearing speed, instantly hit Wu Ling’Er’s opponent.
Namely, that Legendary Void Beast.
Then, with an explosive sound.
"Poof!"
The arrow detonated within, blowing open the Legendary Void Beast’s abdomen.
Seeing this, Wu Ling’Er’s eyes lit up.
But she also knew this was a rare opportunity.
With rich combat experience, she instinctively drove the Witch Patterns, turning it into a Thunderbolt Long Saber, slicing straight down.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 339: ’Watchdog,’ Han Xing’s Killing Intent
paragraphs: "Swish!"
In the next moment, the head of the legendary Void Beast was directly severed.
At this time.
Wu Ling’Er and the other two simultaneously looked towards the direction where Han Xing and the others were.
They also saw Han Xing, who had arrived first.
Joy appeared in their eyes.
"Brother Han Xing!" Wu Ling’Er exclaimed with delight!
In the next moment.
She was just about to use her speed to leave and join Han Xing?
But she heard a cold voice from behind.
"Did I allow you to leave?"
This voice carried a hint of threat, without any attempt to conceal it.
Even Han Xing, from afar, heard it clearly.
Wu Ling’Er turned her head and said: "You have no right to restrict our actions!"
Her voice was very firm.
However, the other party sneered after hearing it: "Oh, really?"
"Earlier, you all said you would fulfill Helas’s promise."
"If your departure leads to a Void Beast breaking into the Path of the Giant Dragon... then you weigh the consequences yourself!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er stopped her steps.
There was already a tinge of anger in her eyes.
However, the presence in that area seemed fearless.
"Since you agreed, you should be prepared to be a watchdog!"
Hearing this.
Not only did Wu Ling’Er and the other two’s faces turn extremely dark.
Even in Han Xing’s eyes, there was a trace of killing intent.
As legendary powerhouses among the Witch Race, they all had revered status.
But now, they were called watchdogs by those inside.
This was a blatant humiliation!
Wu Ling’Er, though extremely angry.
Yet considering that there were still her clansmen in the hands of those giant dragons, she chose to swallow her anger.
However, at this moment.
Han Xing spoke: "Ling’Er, Xiao, Otto."
"Come over."
His tone was very calm, revealing neither anger nor indifference.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s message.
The three legendary figures of the Witch Race did not hesitate and directly flew towards the Witch Race Continent.
"You Witch Race people, come back! Aren’t you going to deal with these Void Beasts?
The voice resounded again.
However, the three completely ignored the presence behind them.
In their hearts, Han Xing’s orders were above all else.
However, this scene.
Made the presence deep in the Path of the Giant Dragon feel a sense of ignored humiliation.
"Heh... it seems you don’t care about the lives of your clansmen at all."
"In that case, I will kill a group of Witch Race people first to teach you a lesson."
At this time.
The massive Witch Race Continent was slowly approaching.
On it stood Cheng Jianyong and a group of legendary powerhouses.
They also heard the threatening words from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The crowd’s faces were extremely unpleasant.
Han Xing didn’t care and slowly said, "If you want to be destroyed physically and mentally, then go ahead and try."
Deep in the Path of the Giant Dragon, there was a moment of silence.
Then, that voice chuckled lightly: "Interesting, kid, were you just threatening me?"
Han Xing still responded indifferently: "Not a threat, but a notice."
"I don’t consider trash like you, who only dares to use a group of ordinary people as shields, worthy of my concern."
Hearing this, the presence inside seemed to be utterly enraged.
It could tell that Han Xing was serious.
The disdain and contempt in his tone were genuine and heartfelt.
"It seems I’ve really been underestimated..."
"A kid who just broke through to legendary also dares to look down on me!"
"Very well, today I shall show you what a true powerhouse is!"
As the words fell.
That voice gradually revealed its form.
It was a massive earth-yellow dragon, tens of thousands of meters in size.
With its wings spread wide, it covered the sky and sun!
Terrifying dragon aura spread.
In an instant, tens of thousands of Void Beasts nearby exploded simultaneously!
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s eyes narrowed.
High-tier Legend!
This giant dragon’s displayed combat power was definitely of the high-level Legend status.
The commoners on half of the Witch Race Continent could feel the terrifying oppression!
For a moment, their legs trembled like sifting chaff, and many couldn’t help but kneel!
They finally felt the might of the Giant Dragon Race.
Any dragon that casually emerged had the combat power of a high-tier Legend.
And deep in the Path of the Giant Dragon, even more terrifying beings were hidden.
A sense of pressure suddenly appeared in everyone’s hearts.
However, as Han Xing’s aura burst forth.
In an instant, the dragon’s aura from that giant dragon was dispelled.
All the Witch Race commoners snapped back to reality from that oppressive feeling.
Then they couldn’t help but shout.
"Saint Master, mighty!"
"Saint Master! Invincible in all realms!"
The giant dragon glanced at the fanatical crowd on the Witch Race Continent.
A hint of disdain appeared in its eyes.
"The cheers of ants."
In the next moment.
It waved a single hand.
The massive dragon claw suddenly enlarged countless times, nearly covering the heads of everyone.
With tearing pressure, it suddenly descended!
Han Xing lifted his head, "It seems, you talk too much nonsense."
Then.
He casually shot an arrow.
"Whoosh!"
The arrow instantly pierced through the dragon’s claw and shot straight towards its face.
At this moment.
The earth-yellow dragon’s pupils continuously contracted.
Watching as the arrow shot towards it with space-cracking speed!
It hadn’t expected that the speed of this human’s arrow could be so fast!
It gathered all its power, concentrating it at the head, seemingly trying to block Han Xing’s arrow.
But clearly.
It was mistaken.
Han Xing’s arrow nearly effortlessly penetrated its divine power defense.
Then it hit the dragon’s cheek, and an explosion sounded.
"Boom!"
In the next moment.
The dragon claw’s shadow covering the sky disappeared.
A huge gap was blown open on the earth-yellow dragon’s face.
If, at the last moment, it hadn’t slightly tilted its head half an inch.
Then this arrow would have blown up its head!
At this moment, Han Xing’s contemptuous voice came through.
"Trash, you can’t even block my casual arrow."

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 340: Declaring War on the Giant Dragon Race!
paragraphs: "Trash, you can’t even block one of my casual arrows."
Han Xing’s faint mocking voice appeared.
The earth-colored giant dragon suddenly snapped back to reality.
Moments later, it was filled with shock and disbelief!
It actually didn’t manage to block that man’s arrow.
Not only that, from this arrow, it sensed a deadly crisis!
At this moment, the giant dragon fixated on Han Xing.
Was this human really just an initial-stage legend?
However, what it didn’t know was.
Han Xing’s attributes were already close to high-tier legend.
Especially after learning the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill, he inflicted an additional 40% damage on the Giant Dragon Race.
That’s why even his casual arrows now possessed the destructive power of a high-tier legend!
Meanwhile.
On the Witch Race Continent, hundreds of billions of civilians erupted in earth-shattering cheers once again.
They were exhilarated by Han Xing’s recent arrow!
Even Wu Ling’Er and High Priest Xiao nearby had looks of utter surprise.
"The Saint Master seems to have grown stronger again," Xiao said slowly.
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes shone with intense admiration.
"Brother Han Xing, so amazing!"
However, these scenes.
In the eyes of the earth-colored giant dragon, were blatant humiliation.
It slowly extended a dragon claw.
On it suddenly appeared a group of Witch Race people’s figures.
There were a hundred or more.
These were the civilians it had captured before.
At this moment.
They seemed to be all in a state of slumber.
Han Xing’s gaze shifted slightly, filled with killing intent as he looked at the giant dragon.
The earth-colored giant dragon bared its sharp teeth and sneered.
"Alright, human boy."
"Now, walk over here, kneel before me, and apologize."
"Maybe, I’ll be merciful enough to forgive your previous insolence."
"Otherwise, I’ll crush these Witch Race people to death on the spot."
This giant dragon knew full well Han Xing’s identity as the Witch Race Saint Master.
Yet it still demanded him to kneel in person.
This was practically rubbing Han Xing’s face in the dirt!
It didn’t take them seriously at all.
"You mother..."
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was about to curse, but Shen Yun stopped him.
Han Xing glanced at the giant dragon, then looked behind it.
He sighed and said, "If this is the attitude of the Path of the Giant Dragon, then I understand."
The commotion from their confrontation must have been sensed by the dragons inside.
But now, no other dragons appeared.
This indirectly confirmed that they condoned the actions of this earth-colored giant dragon.
The giant dragon didn’t seem to understand what Han Xing meant and mocked on its own, "Human, what do you understand?"
"Understand that you need to kneel and apologize?"
Han Xing remained silent, and slowly grasped the Demon-Defying Battle Bow in his hand.
The earth-colored giant dragon’s pupils shrank, showing an unexpected hint of fear.
Just now, Han Xing’s arrow made it feel a deadly threat.
Moreover, the opponent didn’t seem to even be going all out.
As Han Xing said, it was just a casual arrow.
If he were to give it his all.
Today, the giant dragon truly faced the risk of falling!
"Human, put down the weapon, or I’ll crush them to death!"
Saying this, the dragon’s claw began to contract.
However, this scene didn’t make Han Xing stop.
Instead, it strengthened his resolve to kill the opponent.
The dragon saw an arrow with a golden light hurtling towards it at a terrifying speed.
From this arrow.
It felt an even more terrifying threat than the previous one!
If hit, it would surely die today!
"Human, stop!"
A stern rebuke echoed from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The aura was far more formidable than this earth-colored giant dragon!
However, Han Xing remained unmoved.
The earth-colored giant dragon frantically tried to dodge.
But to no avail.
After Han Xing used Gale·Break, the dragon was doomed to die.
At this moment.
The earth-colored giant dragon could only watch helplessly as the arrow pierced its head.
In its final moments.
The dragon’s eyes showed a hint of malice.
It clenched its dragon claw tightly.
The hundreds of Witch Race civilians on it died on the spot.
"Boom!"
With an earth-shattering explosion.
The dragon’s hundred-meter-long head.
Had a massive crater blasted out of it.
The system notification arrived.

"Successfully killed the Legendary Giant Dragon: Omira, gained 2.137 billion experience value, acquired 1 Legendary Giant Dragon Soul, automatically absorbed the divine power, Divine Power Value +10..."
"Giant Dragon Race Affinity -1000..."
Hearing these notifications, Han Xing was not surprised.
However, he was taken aback by the appearance of a massive dragon soul in his backpack.
He could faintly hear the indignant roars of the earth-colored dragon from it.
Han Xing revealed a curious expression at the corner of his mouth.
When dragons are killed, their souls appear; do these souls actually retain consciousness?
"Human, you’re courting death!"
From the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon, another thunderous roar bellowed.
It appeared exceedingly angry.
"Rumblin..."
The echoes shook the surrounding space violently.
However.
Han Xing felt no fear and said calmly, "Now, can we finally talk?"
No response came from the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Moments later.
A group of immense figures suddenly appeared.
Each figure was no less than tens of thousands of meters tall.
They occupied half the sky, their presence overwhelming.
Leading them was the giant dragon enveloped in flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 340: Declaring War on the Giant Dragon Race!
paragraphs: It resembles a moving giant volcano.
Its size even exceeds hundreds of thousands of meters!
Han Xing remembers this creature, Nelos.
The last time on the Path of the Giant Dragon, it had made things difficult for him, almost taking action.
This time it struck, wounding Xiao’s giant dragon, and it was also responsible.
At this moment, Nelos also saw Han Xing on the throne.
Its eyes showed an unimaginable shock.
"Is it you?"
Han Xing scrutinized the opponent, seemingly assessing the strength of this Flame Giant Dragon.
Nelos was filled with astonishment.
Because just a year ago, it had seen Han Xing.
At that time, he was just a freshly transformed Fourth Transformation human.
Truly as weak as an ant.
Nelos could kill him with just a breath.
However, now, how long has it been?
This human ant not only broke through to the Legend but also gained the strength to kill a Legendary Giant Dragon from their race!
At this moment, Nelos was extraordinarily shocked!
"Nelos."
A dragon behind it suddenly called its name.
At this time, Nelos abruptly came to its senses from the shock.
It calmed its inner emotions and said, "So, the new Witch Race Saint Master is you."
"Truly, it’s beyond my expectations."
"This group of Witch Race people is becoming more and more cowardly, actually letting a worthless human become their Saint Master."
Upon hearing this, before Cheng Jianyong and others could speak.
Otto first shouted, "Shut up! Do not insult the great Saint Master Han Xing!"
The audience turned to look at Otto, who had spoken.
He seemed extremely agitated.
As a member of the Witch Race, there was a fervent belief towards their Saint Master.
What’s more, Han Xing’s previous actions had completely won the other party over.
Nelos sneered after hearing this, "I thought it was someone else."
"You, a Legendary of the Witch Race, so devotedly supporting a human, willing to be a dog.
"Why, when we the Giant Dragon Race demand your submission, you resist so much?"
Otto disdainfully replied, "You guys, are you even worthy to be compared with Saint Master Han Xing?"
This remark caused Nelos to laugh out of anger.
It was about to speak.
But Han Xing calmly said, "Nelos, do you always talk so much nonsense?"
"Shouldn’t we be discussing the main issue now?"
Nelos turned its head, looking at Han Xing.
Although Han Xing’s sudden rise to a Legendary Powerhouse was somewhat shocking to Nelos,
its strength was not yet enough to fear Han Xing.
Or rather, in the whole Holy Spirit Realm, there were very few beings it considered noteworthy.
With eyes burning like flames, Nelos showed a look of contempt.
"Yes, we should discuss the main issue."
The next moment,
Nelos’s whole body burst into flames, as if a massive volcano had completely erupted.
The entire sky was stained red.
"Ant, I ask you, ignoring my warning and killing our race’s giant dragon Omira, are you looking for death?"
Nelos’s voice resonated through the heavens and earth, as if the whole world echoed with its sound.
Han Xing still spoke calmly, "It killed hundreds of civilians in my camp, I avenged them by killing it, in essence, I’m still at a loss."
Nelos seemed provoked by Han Xing’s words, the flames on its body surged again.
"The lives of a bunch of ants can compare to our noble giant dragons?"
Han Xing sneered, "The so-called noble giant dragons you speak of are just items I can shoot to death with a single arrow."
"In my eyes, you’re not even worth as much as the civilians in my camp, at least they can bring me benefits."
Nelos remained silent for a long time.
The next moment.
It extended a hand.
A group of unconscious Witch Race people appeared on it.
Numbering in the thousands!
They were all the civilians Nelos caught earlier.
Under the scorching flames enveloping Nelos.
This group of Witch Race people appeared immensely pained.
But they seemed to be under some kind of Illusion Technique and couldn’t wake up.
"A bunch of lowly ants, even if killed would it truly matter? I’m curious to see how you make me pay back today!
Murderous intent gradually locked onto Nelos from Han Xing, "You can try."
"However, what I can tell you is."
"If you dare to act, then your gang of guys won’t leave here alive either."
Listening to Han Xing’s threat filled with killing intent.
The dozen or so giant dragons on the opposite side were all shocked.
This human dared to threaten a group of giant dragons!
Among them was even a demigod-level giant dragon!
Nelos seemed to have heard the biggest joke.
It sneered, "Human, do you know what you are saying?"
"You are declaring war on the Giant Dragon Race!"
Han Xing responded, "If your Giant Dragon Race consists of people like you."
"Then war it is."
This statement rendered everyone speechless.
Including those deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon, observing here, felt perplexed.
What did they just hear?
This human actually declared war on the entire Giant Dragon Race!
Is he out of his mind?
Even when Helas was alive, he wouldn’t dare utter such words!
Or rather, in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, no great power dares to declare war on the Giant Dragon Race!
"Truly, the fearless are the ignorant..."
The giant dragons looked at Han Xing with faces full of pity.
One of the dragons sighed, "This human, just broke through to Legend, and thinks he’s already invincible."
"It seems it’s time to show him, there’s always a sky beyond the sky."
As the words fell, this group of giant dragons all moved out.
And at that moment.
Han Xing directly controlled all the Defense Towers on the Witch Race Continent.
Amongst them.
There were sixteen Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.

sentences.text: It resembles a moving giant volcano.
Its size even exceeds hundreds of thousands of meters!
Han Xing remembers this creature, Nelos.
The last time on the Path of the Giant Dragon, it had made things difficult for him, almost taking action.
This time it struck, wounding Xiao’s giant dragon, and it was also responsible.
At this moment, Nelos also saw Han Xing on the throne.
Its eyes showed an unimaginable shock.
"Is it you?"
Han Xing scrutinized the opponent, seemingly assessing the strength of this Flame Giant Dragon.
Nelos was filled with astonishment.
Because just a year ago, it had seen Han Xing.
At that time, he was just a freshly transformed Fourth Transformation human.
Truly as weak as an ant.
Nelos could kill him with just a breath.
However, now, how long has it been?
This human ant not only broke through to the Legend but also gained the strength to kill a Legendary Giant Dragon from their race!
At this moment, Nelos was extraordinarily shocked!
"Nelos."
A dragon behind it suddenly called its name.
At this time, Nelos abruptly came to its senses from the shock.
It calmed its inner emotions and said, "So, the new Witch Race Saint Master is you."
"Truly, it’s beyond my expectations."
"This group of Witch Race people is becoming more and more cowardly, actually letting a worthless human become their Saint Master."
Upon hearing this, before Cheng Jianyong and others could speak.
Otto first shouted, "Shut up!
Do not insult the great Saint Master Han Xing!"
The audience turned to look at Otto, who had spoken.
He seemed extremely agitated.
As a member of the Witch Race, there was a fervent belief towards their Saint Master.
What’s more, Han Xing’s previous actions had completely won the other party over.
Nelos sneered after hearing this, "I thought it was someone else."
"You, a Legendary of the Witch Race, so devotedly supporting a human, willing to be a dog.
"Why, when we the Giant Dragon Race demand your submission, you resist so much?"
Otto disdainfully replied, "You guys, are you even worthy to be compared with Saint Master Han Xing?"
This remark caused Nelos to laugh out of anger.
It was about to speak.
But Han Xing calmly said, "Nelos, do you always talk so much nonsense?"
"Shouldn’t we be discussing the main issue now?"
Nelos turned its head, looking at Han Xing.
Although Han Xing’s sudden rise to a Legendary Powerhouse was somewhat shocking to Nelos,
its strength was not yet enough to fear Han Xing.
Or rather, in the whole Holy Spirit Realm, there were very few beings it considered noteworthy.
With eyes burning like flames, Nelos showed a look of contempt.
"Yes, we should discuss the main issue."
The next moment,
Nelos’s whole body burst into flames, as if a massive volcano had completely erupted.
The entire sky was stained red.
"Ant, I ask you, ignoring my warning and killing our race’s giant dragon Omira, are you looking for death?"
Nelos’s voice resonated through the heavens and earth, as if the whole world echoed with its sound.
Han Xing still spoke calmly, "It killed hundreds of civilians in my camp, I avenged them by killing it, in essence, I’m still at a loss."
Nelos seemed provoked by Han Xing’s words, the flames on its body surged again.
"The lives of a bunch of ants can compare to our noble giant dragons?"
Han Xing sneered, "The so-called noble giant dragons you speak of are just items I can shoot to death with a single arrow."
"In my eyes, you’re not even worth as much as the civilians in my camp, at least they can bring me benefits."
Nelos remained silent for a long time.
The next moment.
It extended a hand.
A group of unconscious Witch Race people appeared on it.
Numbering in the thousands!
They were all the civilians Nelos caught earlier.
Under the scorching flames enveloping Nelos.
This group of Witch Race people appeared immensely pained.
But they seemed to be under some kind of Illusion Technique and couldn’t wake up.
"A bunch of lowly ants, even if killed would it truly matter?
I’m curious to see how you make me pay back today!
Murderous intent gradually locked onto Nelos from Han Xing, "You can try."
"However, what I can tell you is."
"If you dare to act, then your gang of guys won’t leave here alive either."
Listening to Han Xing’s threat filled with killing intent.
The dozen or so giant dragons on the opposite side were all shocked.
This human dared to threaten a group of giant dragons!
Among them was even a demigod-level giant dragon!
Nelos seemed to have heard the biggest joke.
It sneered, "Human, do you know what you are saying?"
"You are declaring war on the Giant Dragon Race!"
Han Xing responded, "If your Giant Dragon Race consists of people like you."
"Then war it is."
This statement rendered everyone speechless.
Including those deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon, observing here, felt perplexed.
What did they just hear?
This human actually declared war on the entire Giant Dragon Race!
Is he out of his mind?
Even when Helas was alive, he wouldn’t dare utter such words!
Or rather, in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, no great power dares to declare war on the Giant Dragon Race!
"Truly, the fearless are the ignorant..."
The giant dragons looked at Han Xing with faces full of pity.
One of the dragons sighed, "This human, just broke through to Legend, and thinks he’s already invincible."
"It seems it’s time to show him, there’s always a sky beyond the sky."
As the words fell, this group of giant dragons all moved out.
And at that moment.
Han Xing directly controlled all the Defense Towers on the Witch Race Continent.
Amongst them.
There were sixteen Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 340: Declaring War on the Giant Dragon Race!
paragraphs: The barrel of the Godslaying Cannon was gathering a beam of destruction.
The charge of the group of dragons abruptly halted, including Nelos.
Before this, Nelos had already experienced the horror of these defense towers.
That time, if it weren’t for the Golden Dragon stepping in,
it, too, might have been bombarded to severe damage or even fallen in the firepower of the Witch Race Continent.
However, now, the firepower of the Witch Race Continent seemed to have grown stronger once again!
The sense of threat it brought was even more intense.
What Nelos didn’t know was,
it was initially attacked with the combined force of the defense towers across the entire Witch Race Continent, plus the power of four [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons].
But now.
The [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons] on the Witch Race Continent had reached 16!
Just this power alone could deal lethal damage to an ordinary demigod-level powerhouse!
And this was also the confidence Han Xing had.
Moreover, in a little more than an hour,
the remaining three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons would be completed.
By then, not to mention Nelos,
even if that Golden Dragon came out, Han Xing was confident it would have no return!
"Prepare for battle!"
Hearing Han Xing’s command.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er, High Priest Xiao, and Otto, all entered a battle state.
Nelos incredulously asked, "You guys are going to follow this human in his madness?"
"Going to war with our Giant Dragon Race, even with the entire Witch Race, holds no hope of victory."
"You’re going to stake an entire race to go crazy with this human?"
However.
The three of them spoke simultaneously: "Follow the will of Saint Master Han Xing!"
"Today, we declare war on the Giant Dragon Race!"
As soon as they finished speaking,
below, countless Witch Race soldiers shouted loudly.
"Fight!"
"Fight!"
"Fight!"
Only then did Nelos understand.
This wasn’t an order Han Xing imposed on them individually.
It was the will of the entire Witch Race.
They truly regarded Han Xing as their belief, willing to give everything!
This once seemingly insignificant existence before it had truly risen to become the Witch Race Saint Master by his own strength.
And he made these Witch Race people so fanatical!
Nelos shouted, "Very well, I’ll let you understand the consequences of fighting our Giant Dragon Race!
After speaking.
Nelos suddenly raised its head.
A terrifying power of flame gathered within.
"Hoo—"
It was as if the entire sky was set ablaze, the space became extremely distorted.
Simultaneously.
Han Xing had already pulled back the bowstring.
The aura of legendary skills was gathering within.
Beside him, everyone was ready for battle.
From Han Xing’s arrow, this group of dragons sensed a lethal threat.
Once the arrow was loosed, it would surely be earth-shattering!
For a moment, none of the dragons dared to advance.
Just then, Nelos suddenly shouted, "Leave this human to me."
"You go, kill the Witch Race Saintess, then slaughter the Witch Race!"
After speaking, Nelos unleashed a scorching dragon breath towards Han Xing.
And so, the war began!
"Boom!"
The terrifying flames that seemed to incinerate the heavens were just about to fall.
However, Han Xing’s skill was even faster!
"Whizz!"
An arrow with a radiant tail shot into the sky.
The next moment, a meteor shower containing the aura of destruction fell.
The other nine legendary-level dragons also acted at this moment.
"Slaughter the Witch Race!"
Terrorizing waves of energy erupted.
This was the dragons’ full-force strike.
Enough to tear heaven and earth apart!
However.
In terms of legendary combat power.
Han Xing’s side was not at all inferior.
They were no longer the weak Human Race of the past.
Now, excluding Han Xing, they also had four legendary-level powerhouses!
Legendary Mage Zhang Lianmeng, who had just been promoted, waved her magic staff.
The temperature, initially heated by Nelos’s flames, instantly dropped.
And the world became extremely frosty!
The bodies of the dragons were covered in layers of thick frost.
Their mobility was greatly reduced!
This was Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary skill — Ice Age!
Although the skill stated that it could forcefully freeze the target for five seconds,
Zhang Lianmeng was controlling ten dragons at once this time, including the demigod-level dragon Nelos.
Even with a legendary skill, she couldn’t achieve the expected effect, only slowing their actions.
But that was okay.
Because the other attacks had already begun to burst forth.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure instantly vanished, suddenly appearing mid-air.
Then, sword qi slashed out from his hand.
In an instant, thousands of sword qis were unleashed!
"Crash!"
In the void, dense green vines grew, tightly binding the group of dragons.
Simultaneously.
The attacks of Wu Ling’Er, Xiao, and the others also burst out.
The group of dragons was instantly enveloped by various terrifying attacks.
With just one encounter, they were heavily wounded!
If it weren’t for the terrifying defense and life force of the Giant Dragon Race,
several might have fallen on the spot!
The dragons’ eyes were filled with intense shock.
"How is this possible?"
"The Human Race suddenly has so many legendary powerhouses?"
Han Xing, preparing to continue attacking Nelos,
saw that it burst into flames, evaporating the frost Zhang Lianmeng had cast on it.
"Sizzle..."
Steam formed into fog, rising.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing wasn’t surprised.
Ice Age was just a legendary-level skill, capable of interfering with Nelos for a moment was already good.
"Ant! Die for me!"
Nelos opened its huge mouth, the terrifying power of flame spilling out.
At this moment,
the entire continent behind Han Xing was enveloped in a layer of white light.
The next moment, a beam of destruction aimed at Nelos.
"Buzz!"
Nelos’s pupils shrank suddenly.
It felt the terror of this strike, terrified, it hastily interrupted its world-ending dragon flame breathe!
Then, with a flap of its wings, it disappeared from where it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 341: Slaying the Giant Dragon, Holy Artifact Set Quest!
paragraphs: "Boom!"
The next second after Nelos disappeared.
The space it occupied shattered directly.
Terrifying energy fluctuations spread outward.
Even other giant dragons were caught in the attack.
"Roar!"
Several giant dragons were instantly blasted back, their bodies charred black.
At this moment.
Nelos, suddenly appearing high in the sky, had a flash of horror in its eyes.
If it hesitated for half a second more just now.
Then it might have been obliterated by that attack on the spot!
What a joke?
It is a demigod-level giant dragon!
How could it be seconds away from being killed by a defense tower?
At this moment.
Nelos once again experienced.
The terrifying attack methods this human possessed before him.
It is a force truly capable of threatening, even killing, a demigod!
And the power of the other members of the Human Race can’t be underestimated either.
In one confrontation, how could it be that the Dragon Race was defeated?
This completely overturned its understanding.
From the sky, that man’s indifferent voice echoed.
"Nelos, what are you dodging?" Han Xing’s eyes showed a look of disdain.
Nelos felt a strong sense of humiliation inside.
Mere ants!
How dare they look down on me!
At the same time.
The figures of those thousands of Witch Race commoners appeared in Nelos’s hands again.
Staring at Han Xing with murderous intent, it said, "Human boy, don’t you value them greatly?"
"Today, I’ll kill them all in front of you!"
"This is the price for your disrespect towards me!"
After speaking.
The flames in Nelos’s hands rose up.
Thousands of Witch Race commoners, while unconscious, were reduced to ashes.
This scene made the eyes of billions of Witch Race commoners on the battlefield bulge with rage.
"Damn bastard!"
"Damn it! I will kill you!"
Everyone felt a burning anger raging in their hearts.
At this moment, billions of Witch Race people shouted in unison.
"Kill it!"
"Saint Master Han Xing, kill it!"
Nelos sneered with disdain.
"A bunch of ants dare to discuss me?"
"A few more giant dragons, slaughter them all!"
After speaking.
From the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon, five enormous figures emerged.
Han Xing’s heart was already ice-cold.
"Since you’re so eager to die, then kill you!"
He moved his longbow, a ball of white light appeared in front of him.
"Roar!"
With a sky-shaking roar.
In front of him appeared a gigantic bear spirit, over a thousand meters tall, covered in white fur.
It was Han Xing’s Legendary Skill: Gangtu’s Spirit!
This legendary bear spirit, the moment it appeared, charged straight at that group of dragons!
Even though the opponents’ numbers and strength far surpassed the bear spirit.
But it was still fearless!
Following Han Xing’s command.
Zhang Lianmeng, without hesitation, launched various attacks again.
Seven legends, along with a legendary-level bear spirit.
At this moment, they faced fourteen giant dragons!
"Boom!"
As soon as both sides clashed, a sky-shattering explosion was heard.
The space kept shaking! Shattering!
In the next moment.
Cheng Jianyong and the others, including the high priest, were blasted backwards!
This wave of collision put them at a disadvantage.
After all, the gap in combat strength was too large.
Cheng Jianyong and the others, just having made a breakthrough, achieving this level was already incredibly remarkable.
At this moment.
High Priest Xiao suddenly clenched his fist, and his body, covered in red secret patterns, began to burn again.
"Slaughter my Witch Race? Wishful thinking!"
After speaking, his momentum surged once more.
Beside him, Wu Ling’Er saw this scene and her eyes filled with concern.
Through this period of understanding, she already knew.
Xiao’s self-created forbidden technique had severe side effects.
It appeared to burn the Witch Clan’s secret patterns, but in reality, it was burning his lifespan.
Every use would significantly accelerate the aging process.
But under the current circumstances, there was really no choice.
If Xiao did not unleash his power, they would definitely be defeated.
At this moment.
After Xiao entered the burning state, he regained the momentum of a demigod level!
Then, he dragged the fifteen giant dragons into battle.
Han Xing, while controlling the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon to deal with Nelos, forced it to keep dodging.
On the other hand, he shot out arrows causing damage to that group of giant dragons.
His Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill inherently had a 40% damage increase against the Dragon Race.
With each arrow, he could inflict massive injuries to these legendary-level giant dragons.
If he hit a vital point, it might even be killed on the spot!
The yellowish-brown dragon was a clear precedent!
At this moment.
Nelos felt extremely stifled.
It couldn’t find an opportunity to attack.
Those massive turrets were simply too terrifying in their destructive power!
They were almost comparable to the divine-level technology of the Dwarf Race.
But even with the resources of the Dwarf Race, the quantity of such divine-level technology wasn’t many.
How did this human manage to build so many?
At this moment.
Nelos’s thoughts churned.
How could it not see?
Han Xing’s greatest reliance was those defense towers on the Witch Race Continent.
However, this also exposed a conspicuous weakness of Han Xing’s.
That is, the hundreds of billions of commoners on the Witch Race Continent.
Initially.
Han Xing didn’t intend to bring them along either.
But because the incident happened suddenly, hundreds of billions couldn’t be evacuated quickly.
Red Dragon Nelos’s pupils immediately fixated on the commoners of the Witch Race Continent.
"Don’t you care about these ants?"
"Let’s see how you save them!"
After speaking.
Nelos transformed directly into a blazing celestial body, hurling itself towards Han Xing’s Witch Race Continent.
A terrifying sense of impact ensued.
If it hit, not only would the defense towers on the continent be destroyed.
But the hundreds of billions of Witch Race commoners would also suffer massive casualties!

At this moment.
Countless Witch Race People closed their eyes.
A man’s figure simultaneously appeared in their minds.
It was Han Xing.
There was no fear of death in their hearts.
Only a deep hatred for this red dragon!
All the Witch Race People, bearing the fear of death, shouted loudly.
"Saint Master! Don’t worry about us!"
"Kill this giant dragon, avenge us!"
Nelos’s eyes were still full of disdain.
Everyone thought.
The Witch Race Continent would be torn apart under Nelos’s strike.
But they saw a smile suddenly appear on the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
"Just waiting for this moment!"
As the words fell, Han Xing pulled back the bowstring.
Meanwhile, Nelos, transformed into a burning planet.
Was suddenly covered by a larger full moon in mid-air.
And directly froze Nelos in mid-air!
Although that full moon immediately showed countless cracks.
A Legendary Level control skill was still too weak to deal with a demigod, barely controlling for even one second.
But, for Han Xing.
One second was more than enough.
He once again drew an arrow.
The scorching Solar Power gathered within it.
At the same time.
Han Xing not only activated the special effects of his entire equipment.
But also donned that golden mask.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s momentum began to rise rapidly.
As if he broke through some shackle, reaching directly to the demigod level!
Han Xing saw it, over the red dragon Nelos’s head, that thick line.
Under the mask, Han Xing said coldly, "Perfect.
"To forge the second Holy Artifact, I’m missing a demigod level giant dragon soul."
"Today, let you become the first demigod-level ghost under my command!"
At this moment, even though Nelos was controlled, there was no fear in its eyes.
It simply could not believe that Han Xing could kill it.
Even among demigods, there are differences.
Nelos was extremely confident in its defense.
However, what it didn’t know was.
Han Xing had already achieved the feat of slaying a high-tier Demon Venerable at Tier Four.
Now, having broken through to Legend, he would only be stronger!
Under a full burst.
Even a demigod-level giant dragon must die under his strike!
"Crack! Crackle!"
The Broken Moon was about to shatter completely.
And Han Xing’s attack was already ready.
The ultimate skill — Sun-Destroying Arrow was ready to be unleashed at any moment.
At this moment.
A deep and ancient voice came from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
"Everyone, stop..."
Both sides heard this voice.
But they all directly chose to ignore it.
Even the group of giant dragons were already seeing red with bloodlust.
The slaughter continued!
At this moment, Nelos completely broke free from the Broken Moon state.
As soon as it emerged, it suddenly spread its wings wide.
A terrifying rain of fire descended from the sky.
Flames surged toward the heavens, causing large sections of space to shatter.
"Ant! You think you can kill me?"
"Die!"
Han Xing remained unfazed, a strong intent to kill appeared in his eyes.
In the next moment.
A blazing sun and a full moon shattered simultaneously!
"Boom!"
In this instant.
Nelos was immediately engulfed by these two dramatically different forces.
Its previously invulnerable flesh body began to crack in large sections.
Not only that, but it also heard a crisp shattering sound.
It was the sign of its Divine Format cracking.
In this moment, Nelos unexpectedly felt the crisis of extinction.
"What a joke?"
"I will die?
"I will die at the hands of this human?"
Its eyes were filled with disbelief.
However, the current situation indeed served as the best proof.
Its massive body was covered with countless cracks.
Its Divine Format had shattered.
Even its Divine Power could not condense again!
"Damn it!"
Nelos was full of unwillingness.
It looked with hope towards the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
It seemed that inside there still was its last glimmer of life.
At the same time.
A golden light shot out from the fog.
All the energy fluctuations in the world that encountered this golden light instantly calmed.
Or rather, were suppressed.
Including the battlefield of Wu Ling’Er and others and those fifteen giant dragons, everything halted instantly.
At this moment, Nelos knew that it was saved!
"Hawthorne Glaser, save me!"
Inside the Path of the Giant Dragon, there was an even more powerful Golden Dragon.
Everyone knew about this.
However, its sudden action exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Nonetheless.
How could Han Xing not account for this?
The reason he hadn’t activated the Witch Race Continent’s defense towers was to wait for this moment!
When the golden light rushed towards Nelos.
A strong Holy Light burst out again from the Witch Race Continent.
Then.
A towering white light pillar rushed fiercely towards that golden light.
"Buzz!"
The two pillars of light contacted in an instant, then engaged in an intense struggle.
Like two terrifying energies canceling each other out.
Even the sky was split in two!
It seemed evenly matched.
But in the next moment.
The golden light surged again!
It directly suppressed the firepower of Han Xing’s defense towers.
This scene left Cheng Jianyong and others in the distance with incredulous expressions.
It actually suppressed the attacks of so many defense towers?

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 341: Slaying the Giant Dragon, Holy Artifact Set Quest!
paragraphs: How did it do it?
Keep in mind, even strong demigods like the Shadow Monarch.
Facing this blow can only temporarily avoid its edge.
And now, that golden light, in a direct clash, suppressed the tower’s attack!
What does this represent?
It means the presence that emitted the golden light.
Might possess more terrifying power than the Shadow Monarch!
A hint of ominous premonition appeared in everyone’s hearts present.
However, this didn’t include Han Xing.
Even though he saw the golden light neutralizing the tower’s attack.
Yet.
Han Xing also observed the golden light being momentarily intercepted by the tower.
It was this brief delay.
That made it miss the best chance to rescue the red dragon Neroth!
It seemed lengthy, but in fact from when Han Xing launched the Sun-Destroying Arrow to when the golden light arrived.
Less than a second had passed.
At this moment.
Neroth watched helplessly as hope appeared, then shattered again.
Its body had already collapsed to the extreme.
A strong dissatisfaction appeared in Neroth’s eyes.
"Roar! It’s not fair!"
"It’s not fair!!!"
Neroth stared at Han Xing with eyes full not just of anger.
But also a trace of regret...
"Bang!"
In the stunned sight of everyone.
Neroth’s body suddenly exploded into fragments.
This demigod-level giant dragon was slain by Han Xing on the spot!
The world changed color, and the sun and moon lost their light!
Meanwhile.
Throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, all demigod-level strongmen felt the lines of fate above tremble slightly.
They looked up at the sky simultaneously.
Above, dark clouds gathered, thunder rolled.
These are signs of a demigod-level fall.
Dwarven kingdom.
The Dwarf King looked at the giant beside him and said, "Big Bear, it seems yet another demigod has fallen."
The Giant King’s fierce features twisted together, "I know."
"Recently, the Holy Spirit Realm has been quite tumultuous.
He glanced at the dwarf beside him, a trace of gratitude appeared in his eyes.
Fortunately, they recently signed a peace treaty.
The elf from the Elf Race muttered.
"Even invincible demigods begun to fall one after another..."
"What does this... foretell?"
"Could it be, this era is nearing its end?"
From the distant Flame Plateau, the Realm of Darkness, the Sea of Light...
Strong auras rose one after another.
They all simultaneously watched toward the direction of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Path of the Giant Dragon.
The atmosphere was oppressively terrifying.
In the sky, heavy clouds completely covered the sun.
Black ash drifted and spread across the sky.
And this was the scene caused by the death of the red dragon Neroth.
Those dragons looked at Han Xing, their gaze transformed from fear to complete horror!
What did this human do?
He killed Neroth!
A once invincible demigod-level dragon!
Throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, few dared to claim they could slay Neroth.
"Human race, you’re finished, you’ve committed a grave sin!"
"Our Giant Dragon Race won’t spare you!"
Those dragons angrily threatened.
Yet, Han Xing paid no attention.
In his heart, there was only the satisfaction of revenge!
Over half a year ago, this furious red dragon humiliated the heroic spirit of the Wild Ranger before Han Xing.
And the Wild Ranger, to speak of, was Han Xing’s master.
But back then, Han Xing lacked the strength.
He didn’t dare speak even a word before the threats of this red dragon.
Now, he finally relied on his own strength to slay this opponent!
At this moment, Han Xing only felt immense satisfaction throughout his body.
As if breaking through some shackle.
Everyone saw.
A true king’s momentum surged from Han Xing’s body!
"Emperor’s Momentum..."
"What happened to this human?"
Even from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon, a few glances were cast over.
"Is the Holy Spirit Realm about to produce another true emperor?" A voice murmured quaintly.
Compared to the dragons’ shock.
Hundreds of billions of Witch Race civilians had eyes full of fervent passion.
They clenched their fists, shouting with all their might.
"Saint Master! Invincible!!!"
"Saint Master! We pledge our lives to follow you!"
When thousands of civilians were burned alive by the red dragon, the fire of hatred in these Witch Race people’s hearts was ignited completely.
Now, as Han Xing avenges them in front of their eyes.
Making them feel not only satisfaction, but tears brimming!
In their hearts, the resolve to follow Han Xing grew even more steadfast.
Just then, a notification appeared by Han Xing’s ear.

[Successfully slew demigod-level giant dragon: Flame Dragon King Neros, gained 73.2 billion experience value, received demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul*1, automatically absorbed the opponent’s divine power, divine power value +500.]
[As you were the survivor to first slay a demigod-level creature, you earn the first kill reward: Apocalypse Rune Blueprint (Red)*1.]
Han Xing’s eyes revealed joy.
Indeed.
The first slay reward also came for killing a demigod-level giant dragon.
And it’s a rune blueprint of divine artifact level!
Keep in mind.
The attributes of epic-level rune blueprints are already terrifying, what frightening effect will this divine rune possess?
However, just as he intended to view the attributes of the rune’s blueprint.
A system notification arrived by his ear again.
[Survivor Han Xing, please note, due to your outstanding battle achievements, you’ve received an additional reward: Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace (Sacred Item)*1.]
[Sacred Artifact Set Seeking Mission: Master of Stars has now triggered.]
Sacred Artifact Equipment!
And it’s a necklace!
At this moment.
Looking at the sparkling necklace in his backpack, embedded with countless stars.
A strong shock appeared in Han Xing’s eyes!
This is the first sacred artifact-level equipment he has ever encountered!
And it’s not just any sacred item, but a sacred artifact set!
The system, upon granting him the first sacred item necklace, actually automatically triggered a sacred artifact set seeking mission.
With an excited expression.
Han Xing checked the attributes of this sacred artifact necklace.
[Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace lv60, Quality: Sacred Item, All Attributes +5000,]

[Attached Effect]: Star Soul (Skills damage increased by 40%), Star Shield (Divine Power Value +2000), Star’s Far Gaze (Legendary Effect, Maximum Attack Range increased by 500%), Star Dream (Divine-level Effect, reduces all skills cooldown by 50%), Heart of the Galaxy (Sacred Item Exclusive Effect)
[Heart of the Galaxy]: Wearing this necklace enables higher divine power control, allowing learning of ’Divine Power Explosion’, ’Divine Power Absorption’, ’Divine Power Amplification’ skills.

Note: One of the Sacred Artifact Set, can be combined with [Supreme Star Country Armor], [Demon Fog Forged Heart Lower Armor], [Decaying Dream Traveler’s Cloak], [Master of War Ghosts Wrist Guard], [Ring of the Master of Illusions] to form [Master of Stars Set].

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - 342: The Battle Begins! The Dragon Race’s Fury
paragraphs: "Damn..."
Han Xing fell into a long-lasting shock.
The Holy Artifact Level necklace’s strength exceeded his imagination.
If equipped, Han Xing’s damage would increase tremendously once more.
Even his skill cooldown times would be directly halved, including his Ultimate Skills and Demigod Level Skills!
Moreover, there was a Holy Artifact Level special effect, something he had never encountered before.
It’s imaginable how terrifying the attributes of this Holy Artifact Necklace are!
Unfortunately, it is a Level 60 equipment.
Han Xing’s current level is not high enough to equip it yet.
At this moment, a voice from the Path of the Giant Dragon pulled Han Xing’s thoughts back.
"Human Race, you’ve gone too far."
This voice contained a hint of anger.
Yet it struck all present like a lightning bolt.
At this time, Han Xing suppressed his inner excitement, putting on a cold expression once again.
"I’ve gone too far?"
"I asked beforehand, didn’t I?"
"Is attacking these Witch Race civilians the intention of the Giant Dragon Race?"
"Yet you remained silent, even when Nelos and that Earth Dragon slaughtered the civilians in my camp, no dragon stood up."
"Allowing them to act recklessly!"
"And now, I’ve only killed two dragons, and you say I’ve gone too far."
"Turns out, are all of you in the Giant Dragon Race like Nelos?"
Han Xing’s words left no room for consideration.
He directly fired a broadside, mocking all the dragons!
Deep inside the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Hundreds of dragons showed astonishment in their eyes.
Is this human somewhat too arrogant?
But after thinking for a bit, they understood.
The other party dares to kill Nelos.
What else wouldn’t he dare to do?
Moreover.
Even the Golden Dragon personally acted but couldn’t save Nelos.
Thus, it’s evident.
The other party possesses at least high-tier Demigod combat strength!
Moments later.
Deep inside the Path of the Giant Dragon.
A radiant golden figure appeared.
Led by the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser, hundreds of dragons.
And behind them.
Even more dragon shadows swirling in the mist.
Seeing that terrifying aura, Han Xing’s pupils shrank.
At this moment.
He truly felt the terrifying strength of the Giant Dragon Race.
Hundreds of dragons, each at least Legendary Power level, surpassing all major clans of the Holy Spirit Realm!
Among them, several dragons possessed strength not inferior to Nelos.
And one even more terrifying, the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser!
Beyond those physical dragons.
Behind them, thousands of dragon shadows hovered like soul bodies in the Path of the Giant Dragon region.
Han Xing remembered, Wu Ling’Er once mentioned.
The Path of the Giant Dragon is also called the Dragon Graveyard.
All deceased dragons’ souls return to the Path of the Giant Dragon.
And this implies.
The hidden strength of the Path of the Giant Dragon could be even more terrifying.
Han Xing frowned, checking his territory building interface.
[Remaining construction time 7 minutes...]
Seven more minutes.
If he could wait for just seven minutes, Han Xing would have the confidence to face this group of dragons head-on!
With 300 units of the Godslaying Cannon, a single burst could wipe out over half of this dragon group!
Of course.
If Han Xing indeed did this.
The Giant Dragon Race would completely lose their minds.
It would lead to a truly undying and relentless situation!
This is an outcome that no one wishes to see.
However.
Han Xing is not afraid at all.
The worst-case scenario is mutually assured destruction, seeing who can hold out to the end.
At this moment.
In the sky, a dragon with colorful patterns spoke.
"Humans! Stop quibbling!"
"A group of mortals, not even reaching the Second Transformation, are not worthy to be compared to a Demigod level dragon of our race?"
This dragon’s strength was overwhelming, each word causing space to tremble.
In everyone’s perception, it possessed Demigod level strength as well!
Han Xing glanced at it indifferently, "Say that again, and I’ll cut you down too, do you believe it?"
The Giant Dragon Race heard this and immediately became furious.
"Madman!"
"You’re asking for death!"
An eruption of dragon might suddenly occurred, a terrifying aura filled the world!
"Human Race! You’re too arrogant, and you will pay for insulting the Giant Dragon Race!"
The dragon with colorful patterns issued a threatening voice, "Brothers, let’s act together and kill him!"
"Boom!"
All the dragons entered a battle state.
Wu Ling’Er and Cheng Jianyong, among others, showed no fear.
Each gathered their Divine Power, ready to deliver a fatal blow at any moment.
Both sides were once again on the brink of conflict.
As the words fell, all the dragons burst forth with astonishing murderous intent.
Yet, Han Xing didn’t show any fear.
Instead, he bore a confident smile.
Though the defense tower wasn’t complete yet.
But he knew, at times like these, he couldn’t show weakness in front of the enemy.
Moreover, besides the defense tower, Han Xing had other methods.
He glanced at his backpack.
Inside, there lay his biggest trump card.
That would be the Beast’s Tail Spike.
As a true Divine-level creature, the tail spike.
It could inflict damage on true Divine Spirits.
With three uses.
Capable of taking out at least three Demigod level dragons’ lives.
Including that Golden Dragon, Hawthorne Glaser.
Yes, Han Xing has sensed it.
Hawthorne Glaser’s strength was formidable, far exceeding Nelos and the Shadow Monarch.
However, it has not reached that realm.
Divine Spirit.
Inside the Beast’s body.
Han Xing had contact with a true Divine Spirit.

sentences.text: "Damn..."
Han Xing fell into a long-lasting shock.
The Holy Artifact Level necklace’s strength exceeded his imagination.
If equipped, Han Xing’s damage would increase tremendously once more.
Even his skill cooldown times would be directly halved, including his Ultimate Skills and Demigod Level Skills!
Moreover, there was a Holy Artifact Level special effect, something he had never encountered before.
It’s imaginable how terrifying the attributes of this Holy Artifact Necklace are!
Unfortunately, it is a Level 60 equipment.
Han Xing’s current level is not high enough to equip it yet.
At this moment, a voice from the Path of the Giant Dragon pulled Han Xing’s thoughts back.
"Human Race, you’ve gone too far."
This voice contained a hint of anger.
Yet it struck all present like a lightning bolt.
At this time, Han Xing suppressed his inner excitement, putting on a cold expression once again.
"I’ve gone too far?"
"I asked beforehand, didn’t I?"
"Is attacking these Witch Race civilians the intention of the Giant Dragon Race?"
"Yet you remained silent, even when Nelos and that Earth Dragon slaughtered the civilians in my camp, no dragon stood up."
"Allowing them to act recklessly!"
"And now, I’ve only killed two dragons, and you say I’ve gone too far."
"Turns out, are all of you in the Giant Dragon Race like Nelos?"
Han Xing’s words left no room for consideration.
He directly fired a broadside, mocking all the dragons!
Deep inside the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Hundreds of dragons showed astonishment in their eyes.
Is this human somewhat too arrogant?
But after thinking for a bit, they understood.
The other party dares to kill Nelos.
What else wouldn’t he dare to do?
Moreover.
Even the Golden Dragon personally acted but couldn’t save Nelos.
Thus, it’s evident.
The other party possesses at least high-tier Demigod combat strength!
Moments later.
Deep inside the Path of the Giant Dragon.
A radiant golden figure appeared.
Led by the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser, hundreds of dragons.
And behind them.
Even more dragon shadows swirling in the mist.
Seeing that terrifying aura, Han Xing’s pupils shrank.
At this moment.
He truly felt the terrifying strength of the Giant Dragon Race.
Hundreds of dragons, each at least Legendary Power level, surpassing all major clans of the Holy Spirit Realm!
Among them, several dragons possessed strength not inferior to Nelos.
And one even more terrifying, the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser!
Beyond those physical dragons.
Behind them, thousands of dragon shadows hovered like soul bodies in the Path of the Giant Dragon region.
Han Xing remembered, Wu Ling’Er once mentioned.
The Path of the Giant Dragon is also called the Dragon Graveyard.
All deceased dragons’ souls return to the Path of the Giant Dragon.
And this implies.
The hidden strength of the Path of the Giant Dragon could be even more terrifying.
Han Xing frowned, checking his territory building interface.
[Remaining construction time 7 minutes...]
Seven more minutes.
If he could wait for just seven minutes, Han Xing would have the confidence to face this group of dragons head-on!
With 300 units of the Godslaying Cannon, a single burst could wipe out over half of this dragon group!
Of course.
If Han Xing indeed did this.
The Giant Dragon Race would completely lose their minds.
It would lead to a truly undying and relentless situation!
This is an outcome that no one wishes to see.
However.
Han Xing is not afraid at all.
The worst-case scenario is mutually assured destruction, seeing who can hold out to the end.
At this moment.
In the sky, a dragon with colorful patterns spoke.
"Humans!
Stop quibbling!"
"A group of mortals, not even reaching the Second Transformation, are not worthy to be compared to a Demigod level dragon of our race?"
This dragon’s strength was overwhelming, each word causing space to tremble.
In everyone’s perception, it possessed Demigod level strength as well!
Han Xing glanced at it indifferently, "Say that again, and I’ll cut you down too, do you believe it?"
The Giant Dragon Race heard this and immediately became furious.
"Madman!"
"You’re asking for death!"
An eruption of dragon might suddenly occurred, a terrifying aura filled the world!
"Human Race!
You’re too arrogant, and you will pay for insulting the Giant Dragon Race!"
The dragon with colorful patterns issued a threatening voice, "Brothers, let’s act together and kill him!"
"Boom!"
All the dragons entered a battle state.
Wu Ling’Er and Cheng Jianyong, among others, showed no fear.
Each gathered their Divine Power, ready to deliver a fatal blow at any moment.
Both sides were once again on the brink of conflict.
As the words fell, all the dragons burst forth with astonishing murderous intent.
Yet, Han Xing didn’t show any fear.
Instead, he bore a confident smile.
Though the defense tower wasn’t complete yet.
But he knew, at times like these, he couldn’t show weakness in front of the enemy.
Moreover, besides the defense tower, Han Xing had other methods.
He glanced at his backpack.
Inside, there lay his biggest trump card.
That would be the Beast’s Tail Spike.
As a true Divine-level creature, the tail spike.
It could inflict damage on true Divine Spirits.
With three uses.
Capable of taking out at least three Demigod level dragons’ lives.
Including that Golden Dragon, Hawthorne Glaser.
Yes, Han Xing has sensed it.
Hawthorne Glaser’s strength was formidable, far exceeding Nelos and the Shadow Monarch.
However, it has not reached that realm.
Divine Spirit.
Inside the Beast’s body.
Han Xing had contact with a true Divine Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - 342: The Battle Begins! The Dragon Race’s Fury
paragraphs: It knew very well how terrifying the Divine Spirit is.
Yet now, the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser didn’t feel such a strong sense of threat.
If a fight were to break out.
Han Xing was confident he could take it down!
Seeing the confident expression in Han Xing’s eyes.
The group of giant dragons was quite surprised.
They had never seen anyone who could remain so calm in the face of so many dragons.
One must know, even the Elf King and the Giant King.
When coming to the Path of the Giant Dragon, they must be very careful and polite to them.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
The Path of the Giant Dragon is a dominant force, and no power dares to provoke it.
However, not only was this human unafraid, he even seemed eager to try!
The group of dragons that were ready to watch Han Xing’s misfortune fell silent.
Where did this Human Race get his confidence from?
At this moment, after a moment of silence, Hawthorne Glaser suddenly spoke: "Everyone, stop."
"Don’t add any more unnecessary casualties."
The words of the Golden Dragon took all the dragons by surprise.
The patterned dragon hurriedly said, "But Dragon Lord, he killed Nelos!"
"He’s inciting war!"
Han Xing replied calmly, "You need to understand, it was Nelos who attacked first."
"In my eyes, your lives are not worth more than any civilian in my camp."
"Nelos killed my people, so I killed it, it’s as simple as that."
"If you hadn’t refrained from attacking earlier, you’d be going down to accompany it now too."
Before the patterned dragon could speak, Hawthorne Glaser interrupted, "Human Race, what you said does make sense."
"This time, Nelos was indeed at fault first."
"As a Demigod Level powerhouse, wantonly slaughtering a group of mortals."
"You killed it, which is understandable."
At these words, a look of surprise appeared in all the dragons’ eyes.
Though they knew Hawthorne Glaser’s temperament was considered gentler among the dragons.
But someone killed a Demigod Level dragon from your race?
This is a deep-seated hatred.
Even the best temper should have its limits, right?
Or is it that Hawthorne Glaser actually has something to fear?
Han Xing was also a bit surprised by Hawthorne Glaser’s response.
He was already prepared for a battle.
Yet, the other side just said, you killed it, so be it.
But since the other side had already given Han Xing a way out, he didn’t want to continue entangling with it.
Han Xing then said, "In that case, let’s end this matter here."
The dragons frowned and looked towards the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser.
As if asking, is this boy really let go?
However.
The Golden Dragon in front nodded, "Sure, let it end here."
Hearing these words, all the dragons felt extremely stifled.
They looked at the Golden Dragon in confusion, but Hawthorne Glaser did not respond at all.
Han Xing nodded.
He signaled with his eyes.
A group of Legendary Powerhouses, including Wu Ling’Er, returned to the Witch Race Continent.
Just as Han Xing was about to control the continent to leave.
He heard Hawthorne Glaser say, "Wait a moment, my human friend."
Han Xing paused in mid-air and looked back.
Hawthorne Glaser slowly said, "Before you leave, I have an imprudent request."
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
After thinking for a moment, he said slowly, "Go ahead."
Hawthorne Glaser said, "Human friend, although you’ve killed Nelos, I know its soul is still with you."
"Could you please return Nelos’s soul to us?"
At this moment.
A look of realization appeared in all the dragons’ eyes.
They seemed to understand why Hawthorne Glaser let this human go.
Han Xing furrowed his brows again.
Nelos’s Dragon Spirit.
Is one of the key materials for him to craft the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele.
How could he easily hand it over to the Golden Dragon?
Han Xing directly said, "Sorry, I refuse."
As soon as these words fell.
All the dragons were filled with rage.
Han Xing didn’t understand why these dragons were so angry.
He didn’t intend to pay any more attention.
At this time, Hawthorne Glaser spoke again, "Human friend."
"Nelos’s soul is very important to the Giant Dragon Race, I hope you can show some leniency for what happened six months ago."
Han Xing knew that what Hawthorne Glaser mentioned six months ago was when Han Xing passed through the Path of the Giant Dragon.
It was also there that Han Xing accepted the relics left by the Hunter.
The other party even brought up this matter as a favor.
It shows how important Nelos’s soul is to the Giant Dragon Race.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing still shook his head, "No."
"Fair is fair."
"Nelos’s soul is very important to you, and it’s also of great use to me."
Han Xing refused again.
It seemed to completely enrage this group of dragons.
"Ant! You’re courting death!"
"Don’t mistake my leniency for weakness!"
"If you ask me, we should go to war and let these ants know that the dignity of dragons is inviolable!"
Hundreds of Legendary Giant Dragons’ auras burst forth.
Thunder rumbled in the sky, winds rose and clouds surged!
A doomsday-like scene.
Han Xing was unfazed, further solidifying his resolve.
Hawthorne Glaser sighed, "Friend, do you really want to be so unyielding?"
"Nelos’s soul is extremely important to my race."
"If you insist on not returning it, then today we cannot let you leave easily either."
"Please, friend, reconsider seriously."
With Hawthorne Glaser’s words, all the dragons simultaneously locked onto Han Xing.
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
This golden dragon, is it trying to force him?
