chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 342: The Great Battle Begins! The Dragon Race Is Furious! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Could it be that he would go to war with them for the sake of Nelos’s soul?
Looking at the enormous red flame in his backpack.
Han Xing was full of doubt.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er approached Han Xing and whispered a few words to him.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a look of sudden realization.
He exclaimed, "So that’s how it is..."
"The Path of the Giant Dragon has such a function!"
"The souls of the dead giant dragons can preserve their consciousness and part of their combat power upon arriving at the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"With long-term recovery and conditioning, there is even hope for revival, and their strength would be further enhanced!"
"No wonder you want Nelos’s soul so badly!"
Han Xing finally understood Hawthorne Glaser’s purpose.
Although Nelos had died, returning to the Path of the Giant Dragon still allowed him to retain consciousness and even hope for resurrection.
A demigod level combat power.
Regardless of which faction, it would be impossible to easily give it up.
That’s why Hawthorne Glaser kept insisting Han Xing return Nelos’s soul to them!
Han Xing’s words were unrestrained, clearly audible to all the giant dragons and numerous formidable individuals present.
And this was also the secret of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Unexpectedly, it was disclosed publicly by this human.
At this moment.
Not only were the groups of flesh-and-blood giant dragons.
Even within the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon, the giant dragons left only with soul bodies, were furious!
Hawthorne Glaser’s tone became less amiable.
It said grimly, "Human little friend."
"It seems you really want to start a war with my Giant Dragon Race!"
As it spoke.
A brilliant golden light suddenly erupted from Hawthorne Glaser’s body.
"Boom!"
The majestic dragon aura swept forth.
But it was blocked by the kingly aura Han Xing exuded!
Han Xing remained unafraid, "Why not like this from the start?"
"When you let Nelos capture people on the Witch Race Continent, I could see you’re no good either."
"Before, you even wanted to assist Nelos against me."
"That golden light was actually aimed at me, did you think I didn’t know?"
Han Xing completely tore off the mask with the other side.
Hawthorne Glaser’s terrifying dragon aura surged, its voice cold: "So what if it’s true?"
"Allowing you to leave is already my greatest concession.
"Do not continually test my limits!"
Han Xing laughed.
"Indeed, all of you in the Giant Dragon Race are the same."
"That pride in your bones can’t be changed."
"If that’s the case, then let battle commence!"
The group of giant dragons was once again startled by Han Xing’s declaration of war.
Then a wave of derisive laughter followed.
"This guy really thinks he’s invincible after killing Nelos!"
"Fine, let them witness the true might of the Giant Dragon Race."
"Agreed, I’ve long been displeased with this human brat, remember to save him for last."
"I want him to see for himself how insignificant he is!"
The group of giant dragons collectively burst out with power.
"Kill!"
All the giant dragons mobilized, as if doomsday approached!
Simultaneously, the entire Witch Race Continent was shrouded in Holy Light.
All the defense towers activated, bombarding the group of giant dragons!
Aware of the terrifying nature of the defense towers on Han Xing’s territory.
The group of giant dragons chose to halt their attack, uniting to withstand this wave of assault.
However, at this moment.
The golden giant dragon, unlike the other dragons, did not choose to withstand the barrage from tens of thousands of defense towers.
Instead, it opened its mouth and suddenly shot out a golden beam of light!
As if shooting into an apocalyptic world, filled with a sense of sacred power.
And it headed straight for Han Xing!
However, in the eyes of others, this golden light appeared so dangerous, terrifying!
"Sss!"
In the critical moment.
High Priest Xiao instantly ignited the witch patterns on his body.
However, despite his momentum reaching the demigod level, he had no confidence in withstanding this golden light!
And Han Xing, who had just recently broken through to Legend,
Moreover, now all the defense towers were focused on the group of giant dragons.
Han Xing had no means to block the golden dragon’s attack!
Yet Han Xing remained unafraid.
Because he had heard the system’s notification.
[Your territory building: Spiritual Godslaying Cannon has been successfully constructed.]
[Your territory building...]
After a series of system messages,
Abruptly, behind Han Xing, there appeared three hundred gigantic energy cannons, each several kilometers long, covered in intricate patterns.
Han Xing laughed.
With a casual wave of his hand.
One hundred of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons burst forth with a dazzling white light.
Then.
The entire Witch Race Continent quaked slightly.
"Buzz!"
A hundred thick energy beams erupted.
Each containing the terrifying power to injure a demigod level entity.
At this moment.
The hundred energy beams combined into one.
The white energy beam clashed with the golden energy beam once more.
This time, the situation reversed.
It was clear to see that the golden beam emitted by Hawthorne Glaser was instantly overpowered from all sides.
Then, in a devastating momentum.
It blasted towards the colossal body of the golden dragon.
On the battlefield.
Both sides widened their eyes, even forgetting the actions in their hands.
Nobody expected such a scene to unfold.
Hawthorne Glaser’s attack not only failed to take effect,
"Not good!"
Hawthorne Glaser felt a wave of impending lethal danger!
The attack from a hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons was enough to instantly kill a demigod level existence!
If hit by this attack, it might perish on the spot!
However.
The brief negligence cost it the chance to escape.
In a critical moment.
Hawthorne Glaser only managed to fold its wings.
Then lowered its head to its chest, forming a golden spherical shape to withstand the defense tower’s attack.
The next moment!
The attack hit.
Hawthorne Glaser was instantly blasted away.
Like a golden planet leaving its fixed orbit.
The space along the path continuously shattered.
Until it transformed into a streak of golden light, disappearing into the horizon.
Only then did everyone come back to their senses.
"Dragon King!"
"Hawthorne Glaser!"

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 343: Slaying the Fire Dragon with One Arrow, Subduing the Dragons with Two Cannons!
paragraphs: The group of giant dragons exclaimed.
However, Hawthorne Glaser had already been blasted away by Han Xing’s cannon.
Even if not dead, he was likely heavily injured.
In a short time, he couldn’t possibly return here.
And during this time,
it was enough for Han Xing to launch several more rounds of attacks.
He could even slaughter this group of giant dragons!
You must know.
He still had two hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons in reserve!
For precisely this moment!
When that group of giant dragons saw the massive turrets on Han Xing’s territory shine with dazzling white light again,
each of their eyes filled with immense horror.
Are you kidding me!
Even the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser couldn’t withstand a single shot!
As for them, there’s even less hope of survival.
This group of giant dragons no longer held the arrogance they once had, and shouted,
"Run!"
"Quick, retreat to the Path of the Giant Dragon!"
At this moment, Han Xing’s cold voice appeared behind them.
"Too late!"
Boom!
The entire Witch Race Continent trembled.
A beam of deathly white light appeared!
The giant dragons let out terrified roars!
At that moment,
everyone stared dazedly at this scene.
The group of dragons that regarded all beings as ants, always carrying a look of disdain,
were unexpectedly scared into fleeing for their lives by their Saint Master.
Now, there was even a danger of them all perishing.
Just then,
a golden light shot from the great distance!
The Golden Dragon, using some unknown means,
suddenly appeared in front of that white light.
Boom!
When white light collided with golden light, it triggered a strong reaction.
The space within tens of thousands of miles had completely shattered.
Everyone’s vision turned white, stripped of all sight.
When everyone came back to their senses, they found themselves in a chaotic void.
Overhead,
a colossal golden dragon, over a hundred kilometers in length, covered their entire vision.
However, this Golden Dragon now appeared somewhat battered.
The once majestic golden dragon scales had turned charred black!
Although the Golden Dragon blocked the strike,
it suffered further heavy injuries.
"Stop, Human Race!" Hawthorne Glaser spoke again.
Han Xing coldly stared at the Golden Dragon, pondering something.
Everyone held their breath.
When this man didn’t speak, no one dared to make a sound.
This was true even for the group of giant dragons.
The power Han Xing had just displayed thoroughly terrified this group of giant dragons.
The surroundings became incomparably quiet.
The space that had been shattered by everyone now became a void turbulence.
In the distance, the void beasts stared fixedly in this direction.
Yet, they didn’t dare to approach.
This group of void beasts was frightened silly.
What happened?
How did such terrifying beings suddenly break the space and intrude on their lair!
And fought so intensely.
This was no longer a battle among demigods!
Didn’t they see even the giant Golden Dragon, reaching over a hundred kilometers, almost fall?
This group of void beasts may be reckless, but they weren’t foolish.
In the void,
the atmosphere between both sides was tense.
A moment later,
the Golden Dragon, dragging its heavily injured body, spoke once more: "Human Race, let’s cease fire."
"I admit, you indeed possess the world’s top-tier power."
"You may take Nelos’ soul if you want it."
Upon hearing this,
the giant dragons’ pupils suddenly contracted.
Because they had already realized,
Hawthorne Glaser had admitted defeat.
He couldn’t defeat this human.
At this moment, standing on the Oracle Throne, hovering in midair, Han Xing smiled.
He sensed the uneasy emotion of the red flame within his backpack.
Upon hearing the Golden Dragon say to relinquish Nelos’ soul,
that unrest climbed to its peak!
At this moment,
countless eyes were tensely fixed on Han Xing.
Because whether to continue fighting or stop,
hinged entirely on his words.
In the hearts of the giant dragons, they all hoped Han Xing would choose to stop.
If the fight continued,
the outcome was uncertain,
but the Giant Dragon Race would suffer unprecedented casualties.
Contrary to the anxious disquiet of the giant dragons,
Wu Ling’Er and Cheng Jianyong were full of morale!
Han Xing’s two shots completely displayed their prowess!
And showcased their confidence.
Even though the number of strong opponents might exceed theirs tenfold, even a hundredfold!
With those defense towers, they were invincible!
The Giant Dragon Race would certainly pay a heavy death toll.
Everyone was eager for more.
Han Xing surveyed the battlefield.
Suddenly said: "Everyone, come back. We’re done fighting."
Upon hearing this, everyone showed expressions of surprise.
In the current situation, the advantage was clearly with Han Xing.
Yet he said, no more fighting.
Their eyes filled with expressions of relief.
Nervous tension, relaxed at this moment.
Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest, though puzzled,
still complied immediately with Han Xing’s order.
They quickly flew to Han Xing’s side.
At the same time,
the Golden Giant Dragon gave Han Xing a deep look.
Leading the giant dragons back to the misty area.
An epic battle that could have ignited the Holy Spirit Realm,
suddenly came to a halt.
Witch Race Territory.
A vast continent floated in the sky.
Above,
hundreds of billions of Witch Race people wore victorious smiles on their faces.
Every eye had a feverish glow.
They ran through city streets, occasionally cheering.
The name repeated from their mouths was Han Xing.
Today, Han Xing’s achievements were astonishing.
He stood against the Giant Dragon Race and forced them to bow.
Even Helas in their prime hadn’t achieved this.
In fact, many bards had begun composing poetry of deeds about Han Xing’s accomplishments today.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 343: Slaying the Fire Dragon with One Arrow, Subduing the Dragon Horde with Two Cannons! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The Saint Master killed the fire dragon with one arrow.
Two cannons subdued the dragon group.
Imagine that.
What happened today will be passed down in the Witch Race, and even throughout the entire Holy Spirit Realm, for tens of millions of years.
At this moment.
Han Xing appeared at the highest point of a city, a look of contemplation in his eyes.
"In the future, I can’t do this kind of thing anymore."
"When going out to fight, let the civilians stay on the continent."
"Then isolate the defense tower and just take Ten Thousand Stars City out."
Han Xing felt a bit apprehensive in his heart.
If he were to encounter an enemy again,
like Nelos today, activating ultimate skills to destroy the Witch Race Continent,
even he could not guarantee that every time he could save everyone.
At this moment.
Several figures appeared beside Han Xing.
It was Wu Ling’Er and Zhang Lianmeng.
After becoming legends, everyone became increasingly proficient in manipulating divine power.
They had reached the point of effortlessly moving at will.
Upon seeing Han Xing,
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed with surprise, "Brother Xing, you were here all along!"
"We were wondering where you went."
Han Xing nodded slightly.
"By the way, Brother Xing, why did you agree to the golden dragon’s request for a truce just now?"
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask.
Hearing this, everyone turned their gaze to Han Xing.
This was also what they wanted to know.
It was clear earlier that they had the advantage.
Even the golden giant dragon was severely injured by Han Xing’s two shots.
However, Han Xing suddenly announced a ceasefire.
Han Xing explained at this moment, "We underestimated the power of the Giant Dragon Race, and also underestimated that golden dragon."
Everyone looked bewildered.
Han Xing knew they didn’t understand, so he explained.
"You should have noticed that the golden dragon is much stronger than an ordinary demigod, even nearly reaching the limits of a demigod."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
That golden dragon was indeed terrifying, far beyond an ordinary demigod.
Han Xing continued, "However, that’s not the most terrifying thing about the golden dragon."
"I suspect it could step forward at any moment and unleash the power of that realm."
Wu Ling’Er and the high priest appeared somewhat confused.
However, Cheng Jianyong and the others felt a chill down their spines.
"Brother Xing, do you mean that the golden dragon can actually unleash divine level strength?" Shen Yun tentatively asked.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"And I suspect that the golden dragon hasn’t just failed to enter the Divine Realm; it’s more like it fell from that realm."
"Fell?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were utterly puzzled.
However, Wu Ling’Er beside them understood.
The golden dragon inherently possessed divine level strength.
But for some reason, it constrained its power to the demigod level.
This was truly a divine level giant dragon!
At this moment, everyone caught on.
They each took a sharp breath.
Divine level giant dragon!
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, the publicly acknowledged ceiling of strength is the demigod.
But now, a divine spirit level existence is hidden among them.
"Damn! This guy hid so well?"
"Got hit by Brother Xing’s two shots and still managed not to burst!" Cheng Jianyong was utterly amazed.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"However, through the reaction of this golden dragon, I have speculated a bit."
"Which is that the hidden divine spirits in the Holy Spirit Realm may not be just one."
"They all, like this dragon, hid themselves by various means."
Everyone’s gaze sharpened.
Han Xing’s speculation must be true.
The depths of the Holy Spirit Realm were greater than they imagined.
Han Xing clapped his hands and said, "Alright, for now we don’t need to think too much."
"No matter what those guys are hiding, we must improve quickly.
"At least, have the power to contend before they are exposed!"
Everyone nodded heavily.
Then they dispersed.
Simultaneously.
Deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Under the perplexed gaze of a group of dragons, the golden dragon Hawthorne Glaser walked further in.
And then, it reached deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
It saw a colossal eyeball.
The eyeball fixed its gaze on Hawthorne Glaser, exerting an overwhelming sense of terror and oppression.
"Little golden dragon, did you just use divine spirit level power?"
Hawthorne Glaser’s body trembled, and it quickly replied, "Yes."
"What happened? Tell me everything clearly," the voice demanded again.
"Yes."
Hawthorne Glaser began to narrate calmly.
It dared not conceal anything from this voice’s requests.
After a moment.
The voice spoke with a touch of surprise.
"The Human Race... rose to power in less than two years?"
"Can the Holy Spirit Realm really produce such a prodigy?"
At that moment, Hawthorne Glaser couldn’t help but ask, "Master, in all your experiences, have you never encountered such a talented being?"
The gigantic eyeball seemed to close its eyelid.
The entire space plunged into darkness.
A moment later, it opened its eyes again and slowly said, "No."
Hawthorne Glaser’s eyes filled with intense surprise.
More than anyone, it knew how ancient this existence was.
Its presence spanned the Dark Age, the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, up until now.
Even an existence like this had never seen a being with such a rapid rise.
In its heart, it placed even greater emphasis on Han Xing’s strength.
Seemingly seeing through Hawthorne Glaser’s thoughts.
The voice slowly said, "Little golden dragon, there’s no need to be nervous."
"You must understand that towards the end of each era, some exceptionally talented individuals will emerge."

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 343: Slaying the Fire Dragon with One Arrow, Subduing the Dragon Horde with Two Cannons! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "For example, the Great Inference Divine King of the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, the Hunter of the Dark Age, the Demon Emperor of the Fallen Era..."
Hawthorne Glaser asked in confusion, "Lord, do you mean that this era is also coming to an end?"
That voice chuckled softly, "Does it feel unbelievable to you?"
"The current Holy Spirit Realm may seem peaceful, but it’s actually just an illusion."
"It is precisely because there are too many beings like us, all constantly making moves, that a subtle balance is formed."
"Once this balance is broken, the Holy Spirit Realm might face the most chaotic era in history."
"The entire world may thus be destroyed as well."
"The human you mentioned should be born of the Holy Spirit Realm to prevent all of this."
"A being akin to the Great Inference Divine King, the Hunter, and the Demon Emperor."
Hawthorne Glaser was shocked.
Before this, it had never heard this talk from the elder.
It even touched upon the ultimate secret of the Holy Spirit Realm!
However, what shocked it even more.
Was this ancient being actually comparing that human with the Great Inference Divine King and the Demon Emperor!
This made Hawthorne Glaser take it even more seriously.
Before the Golden Dragon could speak.
That voice spoke again: "Little Golden Dragon, off you go."
"Guard the Path of the Giant Dragon, perhaps when chaos descends, this place can become the last pure land."
Hawthorne Glaser’s large mouth slightly parted,
It nodded and said, "As you command, great Lord."
After the Golden Dragon left.
The big eyeball gazed in the direction of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Its gaze seemed to instantly traverse billions of miles.
At the same time.
In the Sky Island Forest, the Dwarf Realm, the Elf Realm...
In several places, gazes rose.
They seemed to, in an instant, accomplish a kind of communication.
Then, reached a consensus, as if by prior agreement.
The next day.
Han Xing appeared in the center of Ten Thousand Stars City.
He looked at the giant stele, then at the necklace in his backpack, like stars.
A thoughtful look appeared in his eyes.
"It seems that there is also a gap between Holy Artifacts.
The [Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace] compared to the [Sun Crown Stele].
It’s clear that the Sun Crown Stele is more formidable.
As a Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact, it truly lives up to the words ’Human Race exclusive.’
With it, one can even change the fate of a race.
While the Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace, no matter how strong, can only affect Han Xing personally.
"However, this necklace is also part of a set."
"I wonder, what kind of powerful effect it will have when I find the other parts."
Expectations surfaced in Han Xing’s eyes.
Unlike other Orange Sets, which show the set attributes directly.
The so-called [Master of Stars Set] can only display the attributes of pieces already obtained.
This might also be related to the special nature of the Holy Artifact.
However, what confused Han Xing a little.
Since activating the ’Holy Artifact Set Finding Mission.’
Han Xing hasn’t received any prompts.
He doesn’t know where to find the remaining Holy Artifacts.
Shaking his head, Han Xing decided to put the matter aside.
Although.
The Holy Artifact Set currently seems to have no lead.
But it doesn’t prevent him from having other means of enhancement.
That is, to forge a Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele No. 2.
This time, he went to battle with those Giant Dragons.
He didn’t suffer any losses and also gained a Legend and a Demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul.
The key material for forging the second Holy Artifact is the Demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul.
Han Xing initially thought it would take him a long time to find it.
Unexpectedly, less than two months after obtaining the blueprint.
Han Xing managed to gather all the materials.
At this moment.
Han Xing opened his backpack.
A large red flame suddenly appeared in his hand.
This flame exuded a mighty aura.
Within it, Han Xing saw a pair of familiar pupils.
Those eyes contained anger, unwillingness.
It was Red Dragon Nelos.
Han Xing let out a mocking laugh, "Oh, isn’t this who I think it is?
The red flame flickered gently.
A moment later, Han Xing heard a cold snort from within.
"Humph! Human, what do you intend to do?"
"What do I intend to do?"
Han Xing laughed, "You’ve fallen into my hands, and you still ask what I intend to do?"
He looked at the distant Demon Furnace.
"Do you want to feel the pain of soul melting?"
Nelos scoffed.
"Human, spare me your reckless boasting here."
"I advise you to release me quickly, or else Hawthorne Glaser won’t let you off."
"I tell you, Hawthorne Glaser is not just a demigod like me."
"This guy is a true Divine-level Giant Dragon, just suppressing his power."
"If you anger him, the entire Witch Race Continent will be incinerated to ashes by his dragon breath!"
Han Xing silently looked at him, "Mm, anything else?"
"What other tricks does Hawthorne Glaser have?"
"Or rather, any other secrets I should be wary of?"
Nelos snorted coldly, "The mighty power of a Divine-level Giant Dragon far surpasses a demigod!"
"They belong to a completely different level of life."
"The leap between them is even more terrifying than from the Fourth Transformation to a Legend!"
"You have no idea of the might of Divine-level creatures!"
After hearing Nelos’s threats.
Han Xing shook his head in disappointment and said, "I overestimated you."
"Turns out you don’t know more secrets about that Golden Dragon either."
"If that’s the case, what use are you?"
Nelos, hearing this, asked in alarm, "Human, what do you intend to do!?"
Han Xing smiled, "What do I intend to do?"
"Of course, to make use of you as building material and put you in."
Nelos’s heart trembled wildly upon hearing this.
But in an instant, he understood Han Xing’s intention.
He intended to make him a kind of soul spirit for a construction, akin to an Artifact Spirit.
At this moment, fear emerged in Nelos’s heart!

While the Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace, no matter how strong, can only affect Han Xing personally.
"However, this necklace is also part of a set."
"I wonder, what kind of powerful effect it will have when I find the other parts."
Expectations surfaced in Han Xing’s eyes.
Unlike other Orange Sets, which show the set attributes directly.
The so-called [Master of Stars Set] can only display the attributes of pieces already obtained.
This might also be related to the special nature of the Holy Artifact.
However, what confused Han Xing a little.
Since activating the ’Holy Artifact Set Finding Mission.’
Han Xing hasn’t received any prompts.
He doesn’t know where to find the remaining Holy Artifacts.
Shaking his head, Han Xing decided to put the matter aside.
Although.
The Holy Artifact Set currently seems to have no lead.
But it doesn’t prevent him from having other means of enhancement.
That is, to forge a Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele No.
This time, he went to battle with those Giant Dragons.
He didn’t suffer any losses and also gained a Legend and a Demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul.
The key material for forging the second Holy Artifact is the Demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul.
Han Xing initially thought it would take him a long time to find it.
Unexpectedly, less than two months after obtaining the blueprint.
Han Xing managed to gather all the materials.
At this moment.
Han Xing opened his backpack.
A large red flame suddenly appeared in his hand.
This flame exuded a mighty aura.
Within it, Han Xing saw a pair of familiar pupils.
Those eyes contained anger, unwillingness.
It was Red Dragon Nelos.
Han Xing let out a mocking laugh, "Oh, isn’t this who I think it is?
The red flame flickered gently.
A moment later, Han Xing heard a cold snort from within.
"Humph!
Human, what do you intend to do?"
"What do I intend to do?"
Han Xing laughed, "You’ve fallen into my hands, and you still ask what I intend to do?"
He looked at the distant Demon Furnace.
"Do you want to feel the pain of soul melting?"
Nelos scoffed.
"Human, spare me your reckless boasting here."
"I advise you to release me quickly, or else Hawthorne Glaser won’t let you off."
"I tell you, Hawthorne Glaser is not just a demigod like me."
"This guy is a true Divine-level Giant Dragon, just suppressing his power."
"If you anger him, the entire Witch Race Continent will be incinerated to ashes by his dragon breath!"
Han Xing silently looked at him, "Mm, anything else?"
"What other tricks does Hawthorne Glaser have?"
"Or rather, any other secrets I should be wary of?"
Nelos snorted coldly, "The mighty power of a Divine-level Giant Dragon far surpasses a demigod!"
"They belong to a completely different level of life."
"The leap between them is even more terrifying than from the Fourth Transformation to a Legend!"
"You have no idea of the might of Divine-level creatures!"
After hearing Nelos’s threats.
Han Xing shook his head in disappointment and said, "I overestimated you."
"Turns out you don’t know more secrets about that Golden Dragon either."
"If that’s the case, what use are you?"
Nelos, hearing this, asked in alarm, "Human, what do you intend to do!?"
Han Xing smiled, "What do I intend to do?"
"Of course, to make use of you as building material and put you in."
Nelos’s heart trembled wildly upon hearing this.
But in an instant, he understood Han Xing’s intention.
He intended to make him a kind of soul spirit for a construction, akin to an Artifact Spirit.
At this moment, fear emerged in Nelos’s heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 344: Evolution: Void Royal Bloodline
paragraphs: "You’re dreaming!"
Nelos said loudly, "Even the Dwarf Royal Capital isn’t confident in refining a demigod-level Giant Dragon Soul into a building!"
Han Xing listened and pondered.
It seems this giant dragon isn’t completely ignorant.
Still, it definitely doesn’t know.
Han Xing’s method of crafting these buildings doesn’t require the hands-on approach of the world’s native inhabitants.
He simply collects the materials.
The system will complete the rest of the process.
At the same time.
The system notification appeared.

[Do you wish to consume the materials: Philosopher’s Stone*50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*50,000, Shadow Divine Stone*100,000, Rhythm Black Iron*200,000, Calamity Divine Gold*500, Giant Dragon Soul (Demigod)*1...]
[Construct Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 2?]
Han Xing gave Nelos’s soul one last glance.
Then he directly pressed confirm.
The next moment.
Nelos suddenly vanished from its spot.
Then, its voice appeared among the large expanse of smoke behind the Sun Crown Stele.
"Human! What have you done?!"
At this moment, Nelos’s voice had lost its previous calmness.
It was filled with extreme terror.
It could clearly feel its soul body becoming increasingly unstable!
Han Xing laughed, "Didn’t I already say?"
"I’m crafting a stele, and you are a key material."
"Isn’t it already happening?"
Nelos heard this and trembled internally.
It finally realized!
This human was telling the truth!
Nelos’s individual consciousness was rapidly being erased.
Which means, it would completely turn into a will-less dragon soul.
Then, for all eternity, it would be sealed within this human’s territory construction!
A terror greater than death instantly filled Nelos’s heart!
"Human! Let me go!"
Han Xing turned a deaf ear.
He clapped his hands, preparing to leave.
Nelos, at this moment, fully abandoned its pride.
It said in utter shock, "Human! I beg you, let me go!"
"Don’t turn me into an artifact soul!"
"I swear by my true name to serve you forever!"
Han Xing shook his head.
The submission of a demigod-level giant dragon, though tempting.
But it’s no match for the enhancements brought by a Holy Artifact.
Moreover, it’s too late for anything now.
Watching Han Xing’s gradually receding figure.
Nelos let out a despairing cry.
Then, the voice abruptly stopped.
[Constructing Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 2, remaining time: 143 hours and 24 minutes...]
At this moment.
Deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Hawthorne Glaser suddenly opened his eyes, a golden light was overflowing from his body.
The dragon beside him asked curiously, "Dragon King, what happened?"
"Could it be that human race attacked again?"
Hawthorne Glaser shook his head and sighed.
"Nelos... is completely dead."
"What!?"
A group of dragons were immensely shocked.
Moments later, a sorrowful expression appeared in the eyes of the Golden Dragon.
"It seems we can proceed with the agreement with that woman."
"The humans in the Land of the Abandoned Gods will be chosen as sacrifices this time!"
"Han Xing, you will regret the actions you took today!"
At this time, Han Xing was unaware of the changes in the Path of the Giant Dragon.
He left the Ten Thousand Stars City Square.
Then, appeared beside his teammates.
Looking at the expressions of the group.
Han Xing nodded and said, "During this time, there’s not much to do."
"Let’s head to the border and farm Void Beasts to level up."
The group exchanged glances, then unanimously replied.
"Okay."
"No problem."
Then.
Han Xing led his team towards the Witch Race Border.
Meanwhile.
In the plains far from the Ten Thousand Stars City, dozens of high-level teleportation arrays continued to flicker with white light.
More and more Survivors arrived at the Witch Race Territory through the teleportation arrays.
Then immediately rushed to the border to join the battle.
After this period of teleportation.
The number of active, resident Survivors in the Witch Race Territory has already reached over 200 million.
With the influx of such a fierce force.
Although the number of Void Beasts at the border kept increasing, the situation became more manageable.
Moreover.
Recently, Han Xing and his team have been exclusively guarding one border area.
The Witch Race could thus allocate more troops to support other places.
Time flew by, and several months passed in a flash.
Three months later.
Witch Race Border Area.
Five people and one wolf were crazily slaughtering the rampaging Void Beast swarm.
When the last Dominator-level Void Beast was instantly killed by Han Xing’s arrow.
This area became quiet.
Compared to the other border areas, where the fires of war blazed non-stop for 24 hours.
This place appeared eerily silent.
This is because.
Their killing efficiency was too fast.
Often, as soon as that region began showing signs of spatial fracture, with the Void chaos just starting.
Five people and one wolf would have already reached there.
Then, amid the bewildered glances of the Void Beasts, they would be showered with all sorts of area attacks.
Not only that.
They would even venture into the Void Turbulence to continue their slaughter.
The birthrate of the Void Beasts couldn’t match their killing speed.
Hence.
This momentary tranquility arose.
At this time.
A white light appeared on Han Xing’s body.
[You have reached Level 55, gaining random attribute enhancement: Power+153, Agility+247, Spirit+142... Divine Power Value+50.]
"I’ve leveled up..." Han Xing said softly.
Three months.
They had slaughtered countless Void Beasts.
The majority were personally dealt with by them.
Coupled with the bonuses from the Experience Secret Elixir, the experience value they gained was massive.
But even so.
Such a large amount of experience value only increased his level by a little over 4 levels.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 344: Evolution: Void Royal Bloodline_2
paragraphs: Moreover, after reaching Level 55, the experience points required become even more terrifying.
According to Han Xing’s estimate.
If they keep grinding like this.
It’ll take a few years to even reach Level 60.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong joked, "It feels like the number of Void Beasts we’ve killed in these three months almost matches the entire world’s population."
"I wonder how many Void Beasts there actually are in the void for us to kill."
Shen Yun laughed and said, "You’re overthinking it."
"The number of Void Beasts is practically endless. At our speed, we couldn’t kill them all even in a lifetime."
"Really?" Cheng Jianyong was a bit surprised.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Xiaoyun is right about that."
"According to our calculations, the Chaotic Void is countless times larger than the Holy Spirit Realm."
"If we speak seriously, the Void is actually the most vast world."
"It’s stronger than the Abyss Realm, Alternate Space, and Holy Spirit Realm."
"Up to now, no one has heard of anyone reaching the end of the void."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, having no doubt about Han Xing’s words.
As everyone was talking.
A huge creature over twenty meters long appeared.
It was Coal Ball, which had already reached Level 50.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s eyes lit up.
They stood up and went next to Coal Ball.
Then they stroked its smooth fur.
Coal Ball also lay down obediently, letting the two girls pet it.
"Phew..."
Coal Ball let out a comfortable purr from its mouth.
During this time together, Coal Ball had accepted Han Xing’s teammates.
Especially Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
The relationship was very friendly.
Sometimes, Coal Ball would even lower itself.
Inviting the two girls to ride on its back and take them on a journey through the void.
However, when Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong tried to do the same.
Coal Ball would emit a threatening sound.
The two could only stand aside, full of envy.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, Coal Ball should have reached Level 50, right?
"Is it ready to break through to Legendary Level?"
Han Xing glanced at Coal Ball’s personal panel and nodded.
"It has."
"However, Coal Ball’s breakthrough to Legendary Level still lacks one condition."
"Today, we should be able to meet that condition."
Shen Yun’s eyes showed a look of realization.
The condition Han Xing referred to was, of course, Coal Ball’s Potential Value.
Now, it had reached over 994,000.
Just 6,000 more, and it would hit a million, meeting the Legendary Advancement requirement.
Han Xing checked Coal Ball’s state and thought, "Ever since it consumed dozens of drops of Giant Beast Blood on a beast’s corpse, Coal Ball has been in a state of digestion."
"After so long, I wonder if it can consume Giant Beast Blood again."
Han Xing knew that this kind of Divine Level beast blood.
For Coal Ball, it was like a potent elixir.
Not only could it increase its attribute values, but it could also raise its Potential Value by 10,000 points.
Thinking of this, Han Xing called Coal Ball over directly.
Moments later.
Coal Ball walked gracefully to Han Xing’s side.
Its head held high, eyes full of clarity.
Han Xing patted its forehead.
Then.
He took out a drop of Giant Beast Blood from his backpack.
Upon seeing this drop of Giant Beast Blood, Coal Ball’s eyes lit up.
It seemed extremely eager.
At this moment, Han Xing knew Coal Ball could consume this blood again.
He nodded.
Without hesitation, he tossed a drop of blood to Coal Ball.
Coal Ball opened its mouth and swallowed it, its Power of the Void suddenly bursting forth.
Then Han Xing saw.
Its Potential Value broke through the one million mark, and the plus sign lit up.
"Great, it can finally break through now."
He clicked the plus sign next to the Potential Value.
[Pet ’Coal Ball’ Potential Value has reached one million, Level 50 achieved, meeting the requirements for Legendary Advancement. Do you want to initiate the advancement?]
"Yes."
After Han Xing clicked confirm, Coal Ball showed no changes.
This caused a strange expression in his eyes.
What’s going on?
Did the advancement fail?
Just then, a system prompt appeared.
[Detected that your pet ’Coal Ball’ possesses Void Royal Bloodline, would you like to use Void Royal Essence Blood to activate its Bloodline Power?]
Hearing this prompt, Han Xing was stunned.
Though he knew Coal Ball might be Void Royalty.
He had never encountered such a creature before.
Let alone their Essence Blood.
This prompt clearly indicated.
If Coal Ball could activate its Bloodline Power, it might become even stronger.
But now, Han Xing didn’t have this Royal Essence Blood.
Yet at this moment.
Another system prompt appeared.
[Detected that your pet ’Coal Ball’ has consumed ancient Beast God Essence Blood, you can use Beast God Essence Blood instead of Void Royal Essence Blood to activate Bloodline Power.]
Hearing this prompt, Han Xing’s previously disappointed mood vanished instantly!
Wow, it turns out Beast Blood can be used instead!
This makes things a lot easier!
However, this also indirectly indicates.
Beast Blood is at least equivalent to Void Royal Essence Blood, or even something more powerful.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a suitable replacement.
Han Xing eagerly took out a large heap of Giant Beast Blood from his backpack!
He had no idea how much Essence Blood Coal Ball needed to activate its Bloodline Power.
So he took it all out.
Coal Ball opened its big mouth wide.
In front of Han Xing, the Giant Beast Blood, wrapped in Divine Power, suspended in the air.
In an instant, Coal Ball absorbed a large portion and swallowed it directly into its stomach.
This scene left Han Xing utterly amazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 344: Evolution: Void Royal Bloodline_3
paragraphs: He made a rough calculation.
Little Coal Ball had just swallowed at least 100 drops of Beast God Essence Blood, each drop containing extremely vast energy.
Converted into potential points, it’s a full million.
With so much blood energy, isn’t this little guy afraid of bursting?
And at this moment.
Little Coal Ball suddenly closed its eyes.
The whole wolf seemed to enter a peculiar state.
Everyone glanced at Han Xing.
Han Xing motioned them to step back and give Little Coal Ball enough space.
Han Xing saw that after Little Coal Ball closed its eyes.
The Power of the Void within its body began to uncontrollably overflow.
Dense cracks appeared in the surrounding space.
Just when everyone thought.
Little Coal Ball was going to turn this place into the Void.
They suddenly noticed that the surrounding void cracks had stopped.
Moreover, its figure became increasingly phantom-like.
As if it was about to completely merge into the space.
This bizarre scene left everyone bewildered.
But Han Xing knew that Little Coal Ball was undergoing a critical transformation.
They couldn’t easily interrupt it.
Moments later.
Little Coal Ball’s figure completely disappeared.
Everyone was left bewildered.
It was a genuine disappearance in every sense.
Its figure and aura completely vanished from the spot.
Even when Han Xing activated his Divine Power Domain to investigate, he found no trace of Little Coal Ball.
The other teammates also activated their Divine Power Domains.
But like Han Xing, they still found nothing.
"This is crazy! Where’s my wolf?" Han Xing was utterly shocked.
Little Coal Ball vanished right before their eyes!
Everyone felt immensely shocked.
Moments later.
Han Xing seemed to realize something.
Although they couldn’t sense any trace of Little Coal Ball here.
The mind connection between master and pet faintly made Han Xing realize that Little Coal Ball must still be here.
Thinking of this.
Han Xing took out the golden mask and put it on his face.
In the next moment.
Han Xing activated the Eye of the Divine special effect.
The Eye of the Divine could help him see through all illusions, which Han Xing discovered by chance.
Through the mask.
Han Xing vaguely saw the outline of a giant wolf, flickering in and out.
"Wow... So you’re here?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said in surprise, "Where, Brother Xing?"
"Why can’t I sense anything at all?"
Han Xing pointed ahead.
Everyone looked over but still saw nothing.
Even Shen Yun passed through the spot where Little Coal Ball disappeared and still did not encounter any object.
Everyone was utterly confused.
At this moment, Little Coal Ball seemed completely unaware.
It remained in a mysterious state.
However, after confirming Little Coal Ball was still there, Han Xing relaxed.
The group silently waited.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly realized how terrifying Little Coal Ball’s state was.
To know that the five of them were legendary powerhouses.
They could not detect Little Coal Ball disappearing before them.
Not even a trace of aura was sensed.
If not for Han Xing using the power of the divine artifact mask and through the pet bond, barely finding Little Coal Ball’s trail.
Anyone else, even an average demigod-level powerhouse, could not detect Little Coal Ball’s aura.
Not to mention the other legendaries.
Han Xing couldn’t help but click his tongue, saying, "Little Coal Ball, are you transforming toward Invisibility Stealth?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes revealed thoughtful expressions.
Invisibility Stealth, akin to human assassin and nightmare professions.
This type of profession is a dancer in the shadows.
Often able to charge out suddenly and deliver a fatal blow without warning.
Their most relied upon methods are naturally invisibility or stealth.
In other words, this is the core of their profession.
The stronger the stealth skill, the more terrifying the profession becomes.
And Little Coal Ball’s invisibility was clearly more advanced than ordinary stealth skills.
Currently, Little Coal Ball was already very strong.
Eventually, matching this stealth effect.
The threat posed by Little Coal Ball would soar directly!
Thinking of this, everyone had their eyes fervently fixed on that empty space.
Han Xing was also increasingly anticipating the changes Little Coal Ball would make after transformation.
At this time.
Little Coal Ball suddenly opened its eyes.
Simultaneously.
Han Xing saw power from all directions, endless Power of the Void pouring into its body!
Its body suddenly expanded to over thirty meters.
However, at this level, it suddenly stopped.
Little Coal Ball’s massive body began rapidly shrinking.
From over thirty meters directly reduced to twenty meters.
Then to fifteen meters.
Continuing to shrink.
It soon became less than ten meters.
However.
Han Xing discovered.
As the body shrank, Little Coal Ball’s momentum not only did not decrease.
Instead, it became deeper and restrained.
In other words, it became more refined.
Moreover.
Little Coal Ball’s body continued to shrink.
Nine meters...
Eight meters...
Seven meters...
With each decrease in size, its momentum became more dangerous.
As if a monster covered in deadly blades, ready to burst out with a deadly strike at any moment!
Finally.
When Little Coal Ball reached five meters in length.
The bodily transformation finally stopped.
In the surrounding tens of thousands of miles, the turbulent void turbulence suddenly calmed.
As if to celebrate the birth of a new King of the Void.
Black flames emerged from Little Coal Ball’s four claws, its eyes as deep as gems, full of momentum.
At this time.
The system prompt appeared.
[Your pet ’Little Coal Ball’ has completed Legendary Advancement, current level SSS-level]
[All Attributes increased by 100%.]
[Activate new skill: Dark End!]
[Extra activation of royalty-exclusive void skill—Escape into the Void.]
Finally legendary!
Han Xing felt a surge of excitement in his heart.
Now, his team had all broken through to legendary.
Including Little Coal Ball, they had a total of six legendary powerhouses!
Already a powerful force.
At this time, Han Xing opened Little Coal Ball’s attribute interface, eager to examine the two newly activated skills.

Little Coal Ball had just swallowed at least 100 drops of Beast God Essence Blood, each drop containing extremely vast energy.
Converted into potential points, it’s a full million.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 345: Escape into the Void and Dark End
paragraphs: Han Xing began to review the new skills Coal Ball had acquired.
As a significant breakthrough.
These two new skills must be extremely powerful.
Han Xing was filled with anticipation!
[Ultimate Skill—Dark End]: The bloodline power within the Void Royal Family is activated, increasing one’s damage by 500%, and allowing the use of Void Transmission without cooldown.
[Void Transmission]: Utilizing the void for movement, one can teleport to any desired location, with a maximum range of 10,000 kilometers.
Note: Dark End state lasts for 30 seconds, with a cooldown of 30 hours.
After reading the introduction of this skill, Han Xing’s pupils constricted.
As an ultimate skill, a 500% damage increase seems somewhat ordinary.
But the terrifying aspect of this skill lies in the attribute that follows.
With no cooldown for Void Transmission, it allows teleportation of up to ten thousand kilometers each time!
In other words, within these 30 seconds, Coal Ball can teleport at will, appearing anywhere anytime without limitations.
That’s truly terrifying!
Imagine.
During battle, Coal Ball suddenly teleports behind the enemy, delivering a blow.
Combined with its terrifying attack, it would undoubtedly inflict severe damage on the enemy.
Moreover, even if the attack doesn’t kill, Coal Ball can instantly teleport away and back again.
One might say, during these 30 seconds.
Coal Ball is almost invincible.
Even Han Xing might not be able to keep it.
"Such a powerful talent skill!" Han Xing exclaimed in awe.
Then, he checked another skill Coal Ball had activated.
[Escape into the Void (Passive Skill)]: An exclusive skill for the Void Royal Family, allowing the integration of the flesh body into the void.
In this state, the concealment level of the Void Royal Family’s aura increases by 500%, movement speed increases by 200%, and the dodge probability of the Body of Nothingness increases by 30%.
"Damn!"
Seeing this skill, Han Xing couldn’t hold back.
"Is it really developing towards the assassin route?"
Without a doubt, Escape into the Void, as a passive skill, is utterly terrifying.
It’s a hundred times stronger than the stealth skills of the current human Survivors in professions such as Stalker and Assassin!
Not only does it have a better concealment effect, but it can also significantly increase movement speed.
Even more crucially.
It also drastically increases the dodge probability of the Body of Nothingness.
Coal Ball already had a dodge probability of over 50%.
Now with an additional 30%, it reaches 80%!
Thus, Coal Ball’s survivability is greatly enhanced.
Even if the stealth state is detected, there’s no need to worry.
When combined with [Dark End], Coal Ball’s state would become terrifying beyond imagination!
Han Xing nodded, saying, "Excellent!"
"Now, my team includes a Hunter, a Mage, a Warrior, a Holy Knight, and Coal Ball, this assassin-type pet."
"You could say most professions are covered!"
Seeing Coal Ball’s transformation, everyone felt quite happy.
However, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were a bit disappointed.
Because although Coal Ball became stronger, its appearance underwent a complete change.
Firstly, its smooth black fur became tougher, like steel needles.
Secondly, its form occasionally turned into a phantom state.
It appeared very intimidating and deadly.
Completely different from its former naive and cute yet mighty demeanor.
So much so that the two women felt a bit scared to approach, their eyes revealing a hint of regret.
Seeing their disappointed looks, Coal Ball seemed to understand something.
It moved closer, then squatted, signaling that the two ladies could continue to pet it.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang exchanged smiles and started playing with Coal Ball again.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile.
A moment later, he suddenly said.
"Prepare yourselves, we’re heading back to the main city in a while."
"After three months of fighting Void Beasts, it’s about time for a break."
Upon hearing this, everyone agreed unanimously.
After all, they hadn’t rested in a long while.
However, before leaving, Han Xing had something else to do.
That is, using the Space Fragments dropped by the Void Beast for restoration.
When the camp mission started a few months ago. Han Xing was informed.
For every hundred million Space Fragments restored, one Fortune Value point is awarded.
And as the head of the camp, Han Xing can further receive one additional Divine Power Value boost when he restores them.
This is a pretty good effect.
Aside from attributes, another crucial factor in measuring the strength of Legendary Powerhouses is Divine Power Value.
According to conversion, 1 Divine Power Value is equivalent to a 100-point increase in four-dimensional attributes, extremely powerful.
Han Xing glanced at his backpack.
Through these months of collection.
The number of Space Fragments in his backpack had reached over 40 billion!
If all used for restoration, it would be at least a 400 Divine Power Value boost.
Then, Han Xing’s strength would advance further.
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s figure flickered, directly appearing in the Void Turbulence at the border.
Then directly clicked on restoration.
[Consume Space Fragments*43.7 billion to repair the shattered area?]
"Yes."
In the next moment, Han Xing saw it.
The border space, which appeared riddled with holes due to the Void Riot,
began rapidly recovering at this moment.
The raging Void Energy disappeared, replaced by a bright real world.
It was like a shattered mirror continuously being restored, then refreshed anew.
The space also became more stable.
Han Xing nodded silently.
In this way, the probability of a Void Riot occurring would also decrease.
Simultaneously, another system prompt appeared.
[Restoration successful, Camp Fortune Value +437, Personal Divine Power Value +437.]

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 345: Escape into the Void and Dark End
paragraphs: The pale golden aura around Han Xing rose once again.
This was a sign of divine power enhancement.
Since the last time he slew Nelos,
Han Xing discovered that his divine power gradually changed color.
From the original white to a pale gold.
So far, Han Xing hadn’t discovered any effect that this transformation brought him.
So, he just put it aside.
Not only did Han Xing feel his own improvement,
but everyone in Han Xing’s camp felt their strength rise once again.
Especially the Legendary powerhouses, they felt it most distinctly.
After all, over 400 fortune value points were equivalent to the enhancement brought by four Legends.
It was quite impressive.
"Let’s go."
With that, Han Xing controlled the Sky Island beneath his feet and headed toward the Witch Race Continent.
As for here,
even though there wouldn’t be another Void turmoil for the time being,
just in case,
the Witch Race army would come to take over in a while.
A few hours later,
the Sky Island beneath Han Xing’s feet merged with the Witch Race Continent.
Then, the five figures flashed and directly returned to Ten Thousand Stars City.
Now, as one of the important cities on the Witch Race Continent,
Ten Thousand Stars City was also a uniquely special place.
This was where Han Xing usually stayed.
Many High-Level Teleportation Arrays were built nearby.
Basically, it had become the permanent territory for the Human Race Survivors.
Due to the subtle influence of some Witch Race officials,
very few Witch Race civilians came here.
Compared to the reserved Witch Race people,
the group of Survivors from Blue Star appeared cheerful and explorative.
After arriving at the Witch Race Territory and being curious about this continent vast enough to be a world of its own,
they familiarized themselves with the environment of Ten Thousand Stars City and immediately began to understand the power structure of the Witch Race.
Then, through various transportation modes, they traveled to other Witch Race cities to blend into the local environment.
After a few months,
the figures of these humans could be seen in thousands of cities on the Witch Race Continent.
They had already integrated into Witch Race society, living there normally.
Moreover, with the outbreak of several wars recently,
humans and the Witch Race fought side by side.
War was indeed the best way to foster friendship between the two races.
Therefore, not only did the Witch Race not resist the people of Blue Star, they seemed very welcoming.
Han Xing even saw many Witch Race people and humans mingling together.
However, no one said much about it.
Everyone tacitly acknowledged it as a matter of course.
After all, there were rumors circulating about secret liaisons between Saint Master Han Xing and Saintess Wu Ling’Er!
Such gossip was the most intriguing to the commoners.
However, when it came to those two, no one dared to recklessly discuss them.
Additionally, with the series of wars leading to a drastic drop in the Witch Race population,
they truly needed to promote childbearing to restore the Witch Race’s population base swiftly.
After all, the larger the population,
the higher the chance of producing geniuses,
and the greater the probability of strong individuals emerging.
However, this was a long-term issue, one that could not be resolved overnight.
"It’s quite lively down there."
In the air, five figures stood suspended.
After Cheng Jianyong’s voice came,
everyone simultaneously looked down.
On the grass far from the Lord’s Mansion of Ten Thousand Stars City, there was a dense crowd.
They were all Blue Star Survivors gathered here,
engaging in equipment trades, recruiting teammates, and the like.
However, unlike the well-equipped facilities of Xingyu City,
most people had to set up tents or small stalls as makeshift camps.
At this moment, Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, should we build a marketplace or a Mercenary Guild around there?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head.
"It’s unnecessary to be so troublesome; we can just change the landscape and move a city over.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Moving an entire city sounded somewhat incredible.
But Han Xing, as the lord of the Witch Race Continent,
could indeed pull it off.
In the Witch Race Continent, Han Xing was akin to a creator.
However, this matter was not urgent.
Han Xing returned not only to rest for a while,
but also to see how those Legends were doing with the tasks he had assigned them.
So, Han Xing opened the highest-level Witch Race communication channel.
"I have returned. Those with time, come to Ten Thousand Stars City to meet me."
Upon hearing this news,
regardless of what they were doing or where they were,
those Witch Race Legends immediately put their tasks aside.
A day later,
out of the twelve Legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, six returned.
The other six Legends were guarding the borders, needing to maintain vigilance twenty-four hours a day.
Han Xing instructed them to guard the borders well and report any situation promptly.
At this moment,
twelve people were seated in the council chamber of Ten Thousand Stars City.
All twelve were Legends.
It had been almost half a year since the battle against the Shadow Army.
Apart from Zhang Lianmeng and others, no new Legendary powerhouses had emerged in the Witch Race.
It was the same for the Human Race.
Currently, the highest level had just been reached by Dragon Abyss Luochan and others.
They had just reached Level 45.
At this pace,
they would need at least a year or two to reach Level 50 and complete their Legendary Advancement.
But after thinking about it, it was normal.
Breaking through to Legend was not an easy task.
Before the emergence of Han Xing and his group,
it was normal to have a Legendary powerhouse appear only every ten or several decades, let alone one or two years.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 345: Escape into the Void and Dark End_3
paragraphs: In the council hall, everyone was waiting for Han Xing to speak.
After a moment, Han Xing slowly said, "Let’s discuss what I asked you to do recently, how have things been progressing?"
The Witch Race legends looked at each other.
At this time, a relatively elderly legendary powerhouse said, "Lord Saint Master, the recent development state of the Witch Race territory is quite good."
"With the addition of a large number of Human Race warriors, the border situation has greatly eased."
"Then, following your orders, we have deployed more troops to explore other Sky Islands within the Witch Race territory."
"Through exploring these Sky Islands, we have gathered a large amount of resources, which are currently all transported back to the Witch Race treasury."
Han Xing nodded.
This was indeed one of the tasks he had previously issued.
After all,
although he now owns the Witch Race Continent,
combined with resources harvested from beast corpses, one could say they are among the richest in the Holy Spirit Realm.
But even so, it doesn’t mean they can rest easy.
Sky Islands still need to be explored, and resources continually gathered.
After all, no one thinks they have too much wealth.
Han Xing also plans to continue expanding the landmass.
At this point, another Witch Race legend started to report.
"Lord Saint Master, regarding the matter of building the town shelters you mentioned before, we have also been working on it."
"But if I may be frank, with our current construction level, we can only build shelters that can withstand attacks from Four-star monsters at most."
"In the event of large-scale warfare, they would be of no use at all,"
"Moreover, the consumption is too high... Should we consider another way to settle the Witch Race civilians?"
Han Xing understood his meaning and nodded.
"It’s okay, you just go ahead and build them."
"Don’t worry about the consumption of resources."
"Although the current underground shelters are somewhat rudimentary, at least they can withstand the assaults of ordinary monsters."
"In this way, at least in large-scale wars, it will reduce some casualties."
The Witch Race legends listened and each showed a moved expression.
"Lord Saint Master is righteous!
They bowed respectfully.
Han Xing waved his hand, not paying attention.
Then, one by one, the Witch Race legends continued their reports.
Han Xing listened, nodding from time to time.
Seeing the meeting was about to come to an end,
Han Xing stood up and said,
"Alright, everyone has performed very well, continue to work hard and contribute to the development of the faction."
The Witch Race legends showed a look of excitement.
They felt increasingly satisfied with this Human Race Saint Master.
Just as everyone was preparing to leave,
High Priest Xiao suddenly spoke, "Lord Saint Master, please wait a moment, I have something to report as well."
Han Xing looked at Xiao.
Under his delicate face, there were a pair of bright eyes looking at him,
Han Xing nodded, signaling him to continue.
Xiao said, "Recently, a large Sky Island has drifted over to the third border region of the Witch Race, with an area equivalent to the combined size of four or five main cities."
"According to our surveys, this Sky Island might contain rich mineral resources."
Han Xing knew what Xiao meant by the combined area of four or five main cities.
One must know that a main city of the Witch Race is at least tens of thousands of square kilometers.
Equivalent to a province’s area on Blue Star.
Four or five main cities combined would be over a million square kilometers.
This Sky Island is indeed quite vast.
If there are mineral resources on it, the quantity would certainly reach a terrifying amount.
Han Xing immediately said, "Then what are we waiting for? Just send people to develop it."
Xiao heard this, showing some difficulty, "Lord Saint Master, that was indeed our initial thought."
"However, there is an Ice Element creature on this Sky Island with high-tier legendary combat power."
Hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily stunned, "High-tier legend?"
This was the first time he heard of a high-tier legend defending these wild Sky Islands.
"But high-tier legendary, so what?"
"Don’t tell me, with your strength, plus my territory defense tower, you can’t take down this high-tier legend?"
Han Xing looked at the High Priest.
This guy is the current strongest of the Witch Race.
Even Wu Ling’Er is no match for him.
Moreover, he has his self-created secret technique.
Using it, he can have demigod-level combat power for a short time.
Isn’t it easy to deal with a high-tier legend?
Seemingly seeing Han Xing’s thoughts,
The High Priest smiled bitterly, "That’s right, Lord Saint Master."
"With my strength, of course, I can handle it."
"But the high-tier legendary creatures on that Sky Island are a bit special. If brute force is used to kill them, the entire Sky Island might be blown up."
"In that case, we won’t obtain any resources, which is somewhat counterproductive."
Han Xing pondered for a moment and asked, "You’re saying this creature will self-destruct?"
The High Priest nodded.
"What kind of creature is it?" Han Xing continued to ask.
The High Priest replied with a somewhat peculiar expression, "Slime..."
Han Xing: "..."
Everyone: "..."
After a moment.
Han Xing’s pupils contracted, incredulous, "You mean there’s an Ice-element Slime occupying that Sky Island, and it also possesses high-tier legendary power?"
Xiao nodded.
Han Xing was instantly astonished.
One has to know, Slime is one of the lowest creatures in this world.
A kind of mindless elemental creature.
Even a Second Transformation Slime is rare.
Now, Xiao tells himself that there is a high-tier legendary-level Slime appearing in the Witch Race territory.
Han Xing felt very strange, completely unable to understand how this Slime has such power.
After a moment, Han Xing nodded, "I understand now."
"I’ll accompany you later to see what’s going on with this Slime that has high-tier legendary combat power."

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 346: Ultimate Ice Crystal Flower
paragraphs: Han Xing looked at the High Priest and said, "In a while, I’ll go with you to check the situation."
Xiao’s face lit up with joy upon hearing this.
Then respectfully said, "As you command, Lord Saint Master."
Han Xing pondered for a moment before standing up, preparing to leave.
A Witch Race Legend looked at Han Xing, hesitating to speak.
Her appearance was very mature, with a beauty mark at the corner of her eye.
Every expression carried an enchanting allure.
Han Xing remembered her.
She was precisely the sixth Priest of the Witch Race: Ciri.
Han Xing could see that she seemed to have something to say.
So he said, "Ciri, if you have something to say, just say it, no need to hold back."
Ciri heard this and also knew that Han Xing’s personality was relatively straightforward.
So she replied, "Yes, Lord Saint Master."
"There’s something I need to report to you."
"Recently, a pandemic has been breaking out in all major cities on the Witch Race Continent."
"Many compatriots have fallen ill, looking pale and feeling weak all over."
"Sometimes, they would vomit on the streets and faint."
"These symptoms have recently spread to the military."
"Many soldiers have now lost their combat capabilities and are recuperating at the rear."
Han Xing’s brows furrowed slightly.
"A pandemic? Is it serious?"
Ciri replied softly, "It’s not very serious."
"I, along with the other priests in the clan, have investigated the patients and found that apart from these symptoms, there are no other issues."
"Moreover, their minds are relatively clear when communicating with us."
Han Xing stroked his chin, as if analyzing something.
After a moment, he nodded.
"I understand."
"Focus on the status of these patients in the coming days."
"Conduct a thorough search across the Witch Race territory, find all the infected and isolate them."
"If manpower is insufficient, have the external combat troops stop expanding and redeploy some to assist you with this matter."
"Notify me immediately if there is anything unusual."
At this point, Han Xing added another sentence.
"Once I return with the High Priest from outside, take me to see these patients.
Ciri’s eyes instantly lit up upon hearing this.
She initially mentioned it casually, not expecting Han Xing to take it so seriously.
Even going as far as to halt the current expansion actions of the Witch Race.
Allocating resources and manpower specifically to address this pandemic event.
After all, before this.
Such large-scale pandemic infection events had happened before in the Witch Race.
After each war, the massive population death would lead to pandemic outbreaks.
Ciri had planned to handle this herself.
Ciri promptly agreed, "Alright, Lord Saint Master!"
"On behalf of all Witch Race people, thank you for your concern."
At the same time, a system prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Due to your outstanding performance, you have impressed the Sixth Witch Clan Priests: Ciri, Affinity Increased. Current Affinity: 78 (Trust)]
Han Xing was startled.
He turned to look at this Witch Race Legend.
Only to find the other party looking at him with a fiery gaze.
When she met Han Xing’s gaze.
Ciri quickly lowered her head.
At this moment, her face was blushing, as if a little secret in her heart had been exposed.
Feeling flustered and uneasy.
Looking at her delicate face,
At this moment, still retaining a certain lingering charm.
Han Xing didn’t dwell on it.
He directly led the group out.
Half an hour later.
On a sky island spanning thousands of square kilometers.
Stood several figures and a massive black wolf.
It was indeed Han Xing and his group.
Besides them.
On the sky island, there were many massive weapons with barrels several kilometers long and openings large enough to fit several people!
These, naturally, were Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Now, Han Xing had developed a habit.
That was to take at least a hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons whenever he went out.
This power was enough to make him invincible against divine spirits.
No demigod could withstand one shot from him.
If they could, then fire another shot.
The five people and one wolf naturally found a place to sit, silently waiting for the sky island to reach its destination.
However, beside them, there was also a figure with a somewhat nervous expression, appearing uneasy.
It was the delicate-featured, youthful-looking Xiao.
Short hair draped over his shoulders, paired with a clean priest’s robe, emanating a cool "stay away" aura at times.
However, in front of Han Xing.
This once stern High Priest, who had experienced much, seemed very tense.
Since boarding the sky island with Han Xing, Xiao hadn’t said a word.
Of course, Han Xing didn’t mind.
After traveling on the sky island for some time.
Han Xing asked, "Xiao, how much longer?"
Xiao heard this, promptly looked up with eyes as bright and clear as the stars.
He glanced at the direction in the distance, respectfully saying, "Replying to Lord Saint Master, at our current speed, we’ll reach the destination in about two hours."
Han Xing nodded and said no more.
The journey was relatively silent.
Two hours later.
From afar, everyone saw a vast Cloud Sky Island.
Merely, that Cloud Sky Island was azure blue.
It looked like a giant jelly.
"Wow, a blue Cloud Sky Island, this is the first time I’ve seen it," Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone stood up simultaneously.
They were very curious about this unique sky island.
As they slowly approached.
Everyone was surprised to find that the surrounding temperature began to rapidly drop.
As if in an instant, transitioning from scorching summer to frigid winter.
And the closer they got, the temperature kept lowering.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 346: Ultimate Ice Crystal Flower
paragraphs: The Sky Island continued advancing.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said.
"It’s snowing."
Everyone raised their heads simultaneously, seeing the sky already filled with falling snowflakes.
"Is this the influence caused by that Sky Island?"
"Or is it the monsters inside?"
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Everyone exchanged glances, then shook their heads.
Evidently, they were also unsure of the reason.
While still thousands of kilometers away from the Sky Island, the surrounding temperature had already dropped below zero.
And it continued to decrease.
At this rate, not just that Sky Island.
The nearby Sky Islands would also be affected, and the creatures inside would die from the extreme cold.
However.
For them, these legends, such low temperatures posed no effect at all.
When they were still five hundred kilometers away from the blue Sky Island.
The surrounding temperature dropped significantly again.
And as they got closer, they increasingly felt the enormity of this Sky Island.
Millions of square kilometers, the total area of four or five provinces combined.
It was indeed quite astounding.
Yet, thinking that stationed inside was a High-tier Legendary Creature.
It wasn’t surprising anymore.
The temporary Sky Island beneath Han Xing’s feet continued advancing.
After reaching a distance of four hundred kilometers, the entire Sky Island was already covered with a thin layer of frost.
The snow fell heavily, making it hard to see the road ahead.
No need for Han Xing to say much.
The rest had already extended their divine power outward.
Within a hundred kilometers, all chaotic phenomena stopped instantly.
At this point, the extreme cold released by this Sky Island could no longer affect them.
Three hundred kilometers...
Two hundred kilometers...
One hundred kilometers...
Then, they directly arrived at the giant Sky Island, within less than a kilometer range.
This was already within the alert range of the Sky Island.
Xiao turned back, softly saying, "We have arrived, Lord Saint Master."
Han Xing nodded.
His gaze focused on the Sky Island before him.
Inside, Han Xing felt an incredibly strong aura.
That aura contained intense cold.
Even penetrating their Divine Power Domain, eroding their flesh bodies.
Han Xing raised his arm, finding goosebumps already forming on his skin.
Even his bones exuded a chill.
Then, a system prompt appeared.

[You are under the ’Extreme Cold Erosion’ negative state, reducing mobility by 20%, every interval adding 1 layer of ’Extreme Cold Erosion’. (Divine power can offset or delay the deepening layers of extreme cold erosion.)]
Before Han Xing could be surprised.
He saw others glancing at him with a hint of shock.
At this moment, Han Xing understood, it wasn’t just him.
Everyone in the group was affected by that negative state.
Xiao was the first to say, "Lord Saint Master, this is the troublesome aspect I mentioned about this Sky Island before."
"It emits a frightful chill, even eroding the bodies of Legendary Powerhouses."
"Even with divine power resistance, it can’t be completely removed."
"Only by staying away from this Sky Island, and spending a lot of time, can one gradually recover."
"Previously, I endured this erosion state and explored above for a while."
"Not only did I feel my whole body stiffen, but even the use of divine power became exceptionally sluggish."
Xiao spoke, his eyes showing a hint of apprehension.
Shen Yun then said, "Small problem, as long as it’s not a Divine Level negative state, it can be easy to resolve."
After speaking.
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high.
The dazzling white light completely enveloped the six people and one wolf.
At this moment, Xiao was surprised to discover.
The cold within his body, penetrating the marrow, actually began to dissipate rapidly.
The warm, holy aura filled his entire body.
Amazed, Xiao looked at Shen Yun, "This lord, is this... Purification Technique?"
"That’s right."
Shen Yun casually replied, as if it was a trivial matter.
But Xiao’s heart was slightly moved.
He had a clearer understanding of the strength of Han Xing’s companions.
Han Xing had no idea what Xiao was thinking.
After the negative state on his body was removed, he began approaching the Sky Island again.
A system prompt appeared.
[This is an ancient Sky Island, with a mass of holy Elemental Power on it, not to be approached by ordinary people. A powerful creature is stationed inside, would you like to enter?]
"Holy Elemental Power?"
"Judging from this prompt, the reason this Sky Island and the surrounding area have turned into a snowy realm is not because of that High-tier Legend."
"But rather, the Elemental Power inside?"
Han Xing showed a face of doubt.
However.
He still clicked to enter.
At the same time.
The massive cloud dissipated.
In front of everyone, there appeared a vast glacial snowfield.
With mountains, lakes, plains...
Dressed in silver, covered in snow.
Truly like a snowy world.
"Ah—"
A chilling breeze rushed towards them.
The surrounding temperature dropped several degrees again.
Everyone unfolded their Divine Power Domains, resisting the cold erosion while observing the situation on this Sky Island.
It was entirely covered with ice and snow, desolate.
No signs of any biological activity.
But upon thinking.
Although this Sky Island was huge, if there were any creatures that could survive in such low temperatures, that would be strange.
No, maybe there truly is!
Han Xing saw.
At the top of a high mountain.
There appeared clusters of blooming flowers.
These flowers were completely transparent, like crystals,
reflecting dazzling light under the sunlight.
