Shen Yun casually replied, as if it was a trivial matter.
But Xiao’s heart was slightly moved.
He had a clearer understanding of the strength of Han Xing’s companions.
Han Xing had no idea what Xiao was thinking.
After the negative state on his body was removed, he began approaching the Sky Island again.
A system prompt appeared.
[This is an ancient Sky Island, with a mass of holy Elemental Power on it, not to be approached by ordinary people.
A powerful creature is stationed inside, would you like to enter?]
"Holy Elemental Power?"
"Judging from this prompt, the reason this Sky Island and the surrounding area have turned into a snowy realm is not because of that High-tier Legend."
"But rather, the Elemental Power inside?"
Han Xing showed a face of doubt.
However.
He still clicked to enter.
At the same time.
The massive cloud dissipated.
In front of everyone, there appeared a vast glacial snowfield.
With mountains, lakes, plains...
Dressed in silver, covered in snow.
Truly like a snowy world.
"Ah—"
A chilling breeze rushed towards them.
The surrounding temperature dropped several degrees again.
Everyone unfolded their Divine Power Domains, resisting the cold erosion while observing the situation on this Sky Island.
It was entirely covered with ice and snow, desolate.
No signs of any biological activity.
But upon thinking.
Although this Sky Island was huge, if there were any creatures that could survive in such low temperatures, that would be strange.
No, maybe there truly is!
Han Xing saw.
At the top of a high mountain.
There appeared clusters of blooming flowers.
These flowers were completely transparent, like crystals,
reflecting dazzling light under the sunlight.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 346: Ultimate Ice Crystal Flower
paragraphs: Han Xing’s divine power covered over, revealing the attributes of these flowers.

[Ultimate Ice Crystal Flower (Orange)]: A type of flower that only grows in extreme environments, can be used as a kind of alchemy material, or consumed directly. Consuming it increases ice attribute resistance by +500.
"Orange material..." Han Xing looked puzzled.
Beside him, Xiao seemed to have noticed Han Xing’s puzzlement and said, "Saint Master, this kind of ice crystal flower is one of the rare precious materials."
"It can be used to make Ice Resistance Secret Elixirs, or to create Advanced Ice Element Affinity Secret Elixirs."
"In the distant Ice and Snow Kingdom, these secret elixirs are extremely welcomed and often purchased from our tribe at a very high price."
Han Xing suddenly realized.
He took a quick glance.
On this vast Sky Island, there were quite a few of these ice crystal flowers.
Almost every mountain top had one or two flowers.
If it’s truly as Xiao said, it would be quite a valuable income.
Apart from these ice crystal flowers.
Han Xing also discovered many strange minerals on top.
These minerals were deeply buried underground and emitted incredible cold.
When Han Xing’s divine power covered over, he even felt a slight sting.
"Hiss..."
"Can it freeze divine power? What kind of stone is this?"
Beside him, Xiao once again explained: "In response to the Saint Master, this stone is called Extreme Ice Divine Stone, and it’s a material of the same level as the Philosopher’s Stone."
"Not only can it be used to forge Ice Attribute Divine Artifacts and integrate into various defense towers or other buildings, but it can also produce unexpected effects."
"However, it is even rarer and more precious than the Philosopher’s Stone."
Han Xing closed his eyes slightly.
Upon hearing Xiao say that this stuff is a material more precious than the Philosopher’s Stone.
He silently calculated the value of this Sky Island in his heart.
From the situation Han Xing randomly probed.
The underground reserve of ’Extreme Ice Divine Stone’ is extremely abundant!
If all extracted, it could yield at least several hundred thousand pieces of Extreme Ice Divine Stone!
Han Xing’s eyes widened instantly, excitedly he patted Xiao’s shoulder.
"Good, good, good, you did well!"
Xiao scratched his head, looking completely confused.
Han Xing meant.
Luckily when he found this Sky Island, he didn’t act rashly.
If it was true, as he said, that there was a high-tier legendary slime inside.
Its self-destruct after death would be enough to blow this Sky Island to pieces.
Then Han Xing would cry to death.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked puzzledly, "Brother Xing, why do we only see snow fields, but no monsters?"
"Where is that high-tier legendary slime?
Everyone also felt a bit strange.
Han Xing thought for a moment.
Directly spread divine power over for a thorough search.
The next moment.
In a deep, vast cave, a powerful wave of divine power appeared!
At the same time.
Han Xing’s movement seemed to have awakened the other side.
The entire snowy land began to tremble continuously.
"Boom!"
With a loud explosion.
A giant snowball with a diameter of more than a thousand meters burst into the air.
Han Xing’s gaze sharpened, reminding: "Here it comes."
As he spoke.
Everyone picked up their weapons, preparing for battle.
However.
The huge slime rushed into the air but didn’t attack immediately.
Instead, after scanning the strength of Han Xing and his companions.
It suddenly crashed to the ground.
"Boom!"
After a loud explosion, ice crystals splattered.
Even the frozen ground was cracked in tens of thousands of meters.
Su Xiaoyang instantly shot an arrow.
After hitting the slime’s body, it made a crisp sound.
However, even so.
The huge slime still did not rush forward.
It glared at the High Priest with two round eyes, its body swelling a circle.
Occasionally jumping up and down.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
The ground was constantly shaking from its stomping, resembling an angry little child.
"Uh... is this slime angry?" Shen Yun asked puzzledly.
Everyone also felt this way, faces turning odd.
At this moment.
The slime was still bouncing in fury.
Han Xing spread divine power over.
Soon strange voices sounded in his ears.
After system translation, Han Xing understood.
"Ah! You wicked Witch Race!"
"You couldn’t beat me, so you went to call for help!"
"Despicable, shameless, vile!"
"You scabby beastman, stinky goblin!"
Han Xing: "..."
Seeing Han Xing’s speechless expression, Cheng Jianyong asked.
"Brother Xing, what’s this slime doing?"
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "It’s cursing."
"What?"
Cheng Jianyong covered with confusion spread divine power over.
"Seems it really is, and it’s cursing quite nastily."
Unable to hold back curiosity, everyone also used divine power to probe.
Then, they all looked at the High Priest.
Xiao was dumbfounded by Han Xing and the others staring at him.
And when he tried to spread divine power over, his face turned dark.
Because he understood, that slime was cursing him.
"Who’s losing to you?"
"If I wasn’t afraid of your self-destruct, you’d have been dead long ago!"
Xiao clenched his fist, angrily said.
However, the slime still wouldn’t admit defeat.
It cursed the High Priest while spitting.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
Icy cones were spat from its mouth, scraping past everyone’s ears.
If it weren’t for feeling the high-tier legendary presence from it.
They would’ve suspected it was just a child with an IQ below three years!
Xiao wasn’t conceding beside, "You’re the Gululu Beast, your whole family are Gululu Beasts!"
"Let’s fight again if you’re not satisfied!"
Xiao rolled up his sleeves, ready to charge and fight the slime.
Han Xing stopped Xiao, and said.
"Try negotiating, see if it would consider letting this place go."
"As a condition, we’ll find it a new residence."

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 347: Slime Emperor and Beast Tamer
paragraphs: Xiao was furious at this moment.
But after hearing Han Xing’s command, he suppressed his anger.
And tried to communicate with the other party.
Upon receiving Xiao’s message,
the Slime was obviously taken aback.
Moments later, it appeared even more enraged.
It directly spat out a gigantic ice cone towards the crowd.
"Puff!"
The attack from a High-tier Legend.
Even a casual strike contained terrifying destructive power.
At this moment,
Shen Yun suddenly appeared in front of the crowd.
A thick scale abruptly appeared in front of him.
It was hundreds of meters long.
Bang! Bang!
The Slime’s ice cone attack landed on the scale without any effect.
This scale, naturally, came from a beast.
Its formidable defense could be used like a wall of shields.
The Slime was infuriated.
It leaped directly into the sky.
The entire Sky Island trembled violently.
Everyone saw.
On the ground, suddenly, tens of millions, even a billion ice cones formed!
Moreover, they were all locked onto the crowd.
If they were hit by these, they would be turned into a wasp nest almost instantly!
Upon seeing this scene,
disappointment appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"It seems that negotiations have failed."
Upon hearing this, the crowd seemed to understand something.
The failure of negotiations meant that both parties would officially go to war.
However, they did not show much fear.
The next moment,
Han Xing’s eyes, filled with murderous intent, locked onto this Ice Element Slime.
The Slime’s panel attributes appeared before him.
[Frost Slime Emperor: Five-star Legendary Level creature]
[Level]: 58th Level.
[Attributes]: Power 48521, Agility 46545, Spirit 57454, Constitution 52865.
[Divine Power Value]: 5432
[Skills]: Ice Control, Ice Divine Power Absorption, Ice Cone Domain, Ultimate Skill - Extreme Cold Hell.
Special Ability: Self-Destruct (Upon death, the Slime will detonate all its divine power, causing a massive explosion.)
The Slime also sensed the murderous intent from Han Xing and others.
Initially, it did not regard these people.
A few weaklings from the Human Race, not even one Middle-tier Legend among them.
To it, they were not worth considering at all!
But now,
as the group entered combat state,
the Slime noticeably felt,
the momentum from them was growing at a terrifying speed.
Especially the man holding the longbow.
He rapidly broke through from Initial-stage Legend to Middle-tier, and then to High-tier.
Now, he was about to break through to Demigod!
On him, the Frost Slime felt a sense of mortal crisis!
The next moment, Han Xing drew the bowstring.
An arrow containing terrifying destructive power shot out instantly.
"Whoosh!"
Seeing this, the Frost Slime directly activated the skill: Ice Control.
In an instant,
snow and ice from all directions gathered into its body.
These turned into layers upon layers of thick armor, firmly encasing the Frost Slime.
In the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of layers were stacked!
The Frost Slime’s size swelled almost tenfold!
Enveloped in this ice and snow, it felt a strong sense of security and a contemptuous look appeared in its eyes.
Because before this, many High-tier Legends had faced this move.
No matter how much effort those Legends put in, they couldn’t break its defense.
Among them was High Priest Xiao.
So, the Slime thought, this human’s arrow would definitely not pierce its Frost Armor either.
But clearly, it was wrong.
Han Xing’s arrow not only easily penetrated its icy exterior.
It also pierced its body without any hindrance.
The Slime’s round eyes widened, as if seeing something terrifying.
However, what it didn’t know was, Han Xing’s attack wasn’t over yet.
The explosive effect of the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill activated.
"Boom!"
After a deafening sound,
a huge hole was blown out of the Frost Slime’s belly.
It slumped backward like a deflated ball.
Then it directly fell to the ground, rolling thousands of meters away.
And at this time, Han Xing saw all the surrounding snow and ice converging towards the Slime.
The ball-like Slime suddenly leaped from its original spot.
Han Xing observed.
The hole in its belly had already been restored to its original state.
"Recovered? So fast."
Han Xing was somewhat amazed.
On this Sky Island,
the Frost Slime had an abnormal recovery ability!
At this moment,
the Frost Slime was thoroughly enraged by Han Xing’s arrow.
It opened its O-shaped mouth and took a deep breath.
In an instant, the wind and snow of ten thousand meters around were sucked into its mouth.
It seemed to be brewing some grand attack.
Once it unleashed it, the power would surely be terrifying!
Just as Han Xing raised his hand, preparing to interrupt it,
suddenly,
the face of the Frost Slime revealed several horrifying cracks.
"Crack! Crack!"
The ice crystals shattered.
"Puff!"
The Slime suffered a severe blow, and its charged attack was directly interrupted.
However, its response was quick.
Its rotund body leaped up the moment it hit the ground.
The surrounding snow and wind suddenly condensed, transforming into a multitude of ice cones.
The next moment,
all these ice cones were released, launching an indiscriminate attack!
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
Once the myriad of ice cones dissipated,
the Slime not only failed to achieve its objective,
but also ended up with more than a dozen additional cracks on its body!
At this moment,
the Frost Slime was utterly panicking.
It looked at its facial scars in horror, gazing blankly around.
Simultaneously, it kept launching wide-ranging attacks.
Yet regardless of its efforts,
it couldn’t even locate its enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 347: Slime Emperor and Beast Tamer_2
paragraphs: Even now, it didn’t know what was attacking it.
The Frost Slime looked as if it had seen a ghost.
Clearly, there was nothing around it.
The humans in the distance were standing still in their original spot.
Yet, its body was continuously covered in dense cracks.
As if scratched out forcefully by some creature’s claws.
The Slime was completely panicking.
Although it didn’t know what was attacking it.
Han Xing and the others knew very well.
The culprit was the Coal Ball that had already escaped into the void.
Even though, from the beginning to the end.
Including Han Xing and the rest, no one sensed Coal Ball’s presence.
But this method and mode of attack.
Other than Coal Ball, they couldn’t think of anyone else.
Beside them, the High Priest also wore an expression as if he had seen a ghost.
He, too, saw the disappearance of the Black Wolf beside Han Xing.
And knew that the predicament now facing the Frost Slime was caused by that Black Wolf.
But, isn’t this too bizarre?
Was it Invisibility Technique? Or Stealth Technique?
What kind of high-level Stealth Technique is this?
Even as a High-tier Legend, focusing all my Spirit, I couldn’t detect Coal Ball’s whereabouts!
At this moment.
The High Priest’s understanding of the power of Han Xing’s companions was refreshed once again.
Indeed, anyone associated with this Saint Master isn’t simple...
A comforting smile appeared on Han Xing’s face.
Breaking through to Legend was truly a terrifying transformation for Coal Ball.
Though it had only recently become a Legend, it was pressing down a High-tier Legend in battle.
And its opponent hadn’t even glimpsed its shadow.
Although, among High-tier Legends, the Slime was on the weaker side.
It still highlighted Coal Ball’s formidability.
The group quietly watched the scene unfold.
Minutes later, tens of thousands of cracks had appeared on the Frost Slime!
It resembled a large glass bead on the verge of shattering.
The Frost Slime finally realized it wasn’t a match for this bizarre enemy.
So, it abandoned its offensive stance.
It began covering itself with frost, stacking armor.
"Clang! Clang clang!"
The moisture in the air around solidified in an instant, turning into thick ice armor, all gathering on the Frost Slime.
In an instant, the Slime had stacked tens of thousands of layers of Frost Armor on itself.
Its size swelled from a diameter of a hundred meters to thousands of meters.
Even if Coal Ball’s attacks penetrated the ice armor to harm its body.
The Slime managed to use its terrifying regenerative ability to repair its physical injuries immediately.
"Slash! Slash slash!"
Coal Ball continued to unleash attacks with its wolf claws.
However.
After the Frost Slime ceased its attacks, it was like an ice mountain, indestructible.
Minutes later.
Even Coal Ball grew a bit tired, and uninterestedly walked back.
As a giant black wolf appeared beside Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "This Slime’s defensive capability is absurd."
"I’m afraid, even an average High-tier Legend wouldn’t be able to break through its defense."
"And coupled with that dreadful recovery ability, it’s practically an iron turtle!"
Everyone nodded in deep agreement.
The few present were Legendary Powerhouses.
Yet even they weren’t confident they could break through the Frost Slime’s thick shell.
Of course, this didn’t include Han Xing.
He stepped forward, slowly drawing his bowstring.
At this moment.
A terrifying sense of rending appeared!
Everyone saw only that, centered on Han Xing.
All the surrounding wind and snow suddenly halted!
When they looked closely.
They found that the wind and snow mid-air were torn apart by an invisible force, dissolving into nothingness.
Even the shell of the Frost Slime was covered with countless cracks.
This arrow had yet to be released.
But it gave them a strong sense of threat!
Even the Slime wrapped in Frost Armor, its pupils suddenly widened, preparing to withstand it.
However.
Rather than attack immediately, Han Xing first enveloped it with Divine Power.
"I’ll give you one last chance."
"Either sign a Lord Contract with me."
"Or die."
A moment later.
That massive ice ball sensed the message Han Xing conveyed with Divine Power.
And then, a soft voice shouted, "Human, don’t think about it!"
"I will never submit to you!"
Han Xing nodded, saying no more.
Then, he pulled the bowstring.
In an instant, over a dozen arrows shot out.
"Whiz! Whiz whiz!"
From where Han Xing shot the arrows to the Slime’s location.
The frozen ground cracked open, forming countless intersecting fissures extending for thousands of meters.
"Crash!"
Ice shards splattered, blizzards danced.
After a series of tremendous blasts.
The entire Ice and Snow Continent began to tremble violently.
Seconds later.
Everything gradually calmed down.
And where the Frost Slime once stood, a collapsed ice mountain appeared.
This was the effect of Han Xing’s attack.
Directly shooting down a nearby mountain, which then crashed down.
Then.
Six people and one wolf approached the massive collapsed ice mountain.
"Crunch!"
"Crunch!"
Han Xing led the way.
Everywhere he passed, the ice blocks cracked open instantly.
Automatically making a path for him toward the ice mountain.
This effect was caused by the external release of Divine Power.
A moment later, they had advanced about a kilometer or two.
In a sheet of ice and snow.
The group spotted a familiar figure.

sentences.text: Even now, it didn’t know what was attacking it.
The Frost Slime looked as if it had seen a ghost.
Clearly, there was nothing around it.
The humans in the distance were standing still in their original spot.
Yet, its body was continuously covered in dense cracks.
As if scratched out forcefully by some creature’s claws.
The Slime was completely panicking.
Although it didn’t know what was attacking it.
Han Xing and the others knew very well.
The culprit was the Coal Ball that had already escaped into the void.
Even though, from the beginning to the end.
Including Han Xing and the rest, no one sensed Coal Ball’s presence.
But this method and mode of attack.
Other than Coal Ball, they couldn’t think of anyone else.
Beside them, the High Priest also wore an expression as if he had seen a ghost.
He, too, saw the disappearance of the Black Wolf beside Han Xing.
And knew that the predicament now facing the Frost Slime was caused by that Black Wolf.
But, isn’t this too bizarre?
Was it Invisibility Technique?
Or Stealth Technique?
What kind of high-level Stealth Technique is this?
Even as a High-tier Legend, focusing all my Spirit, I couldn’t detect Coal Ball’s whereabouts!
At this moment.
The High Priest’s understanding of the power of Han Xing’s companions was refreshed once again.
Indeed, anyone associated with this Saint Master isn’t simple...
A comforting smile appeared on Han Xing’s face.
Breaking through to Legend was truly a terrifying transformation for Coal Ball.
Though it had only recently become a Legend, it was pressing down a High-tier Legend in battle.
And its opponent hadn’t even glimpsed its shadow.
Although, among High-tier Legends, the Slime was on the weaker side.
It still highlighted Coal Ball’s formidability.
The group quietly watched the scene unfold.
Minutes later, tens of thousands of cracks had appeared on the Frost Slime!
It resembled a large glass bead on the verge of shattering.
The Frost Slime finally realized it wasn’t a match for this bizarre enemy.
So, it abandoned its offensive stance.
It began covering itself with frost, stacking armor.
"Clang!
Clang clang!"
The moisture in the air around solidified in an instant, turning into thick ice armor, all gathering on the Frost Slime.
In an instant, the Slime had stacked tens of thousands of layers of Frost Armor on itself.
Its size swelled from a diameter of a hundred meters to thousands of meters.
Even if Coal Ball’s attacks penetrated the ice armor to harm its body.
The Slime managed to use its terrifying regenerative ability to repair its physical injuries immediately.
"Slash!
Slash slash!"
Coal Ball continued to unleash attacks with its wolf claws.
However.
After the Frost Slime ceased its attacks, it was like an ice mountain, indestructible.
Minutes later.
Even Coal Ball grew a bit tired, and uninterestedly walked back.
As a giant black wolf appeared beside Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "This Slime’s defensive capability is absurd."
"I’m afraid, even an average High-tier Legend wouldn’t be able to break through its defense."
"And coupled with that dreadful recovery ability, it’s practically an iron turtle!"
Everyone nodded in deep agreement.
The few present were Legendary Powerhouses.
Yet even they weren’t confident they could break through the Frost Slime’s thick shell.
Of course, this didn’t include Han Xing.
He stepped forward, slowly drawing his bowstring.
At this moment.
A terrifying sense of rending appeared!
Everyone saw only that, centered on Han Xing.
All the surrounding wind and snow suddenly halted!
When they looked closely.
They found that the wind and snow mid-air were torn apart by an invisible force, dissolving into nothingness.
Even the shell of the Frost Slime was covered with countless cracks.
This arrow had yet to be released.
But it gave them a strong sense of threat!
Even the Slime wrapped in Frost Armor, its pupils suddenly widened, preparing to withstand it.
However.
Rather than attack immediately, Han Xing first enveloped it with Divine Power.
"I’ll give you one last chance."
"Either sign a Lord Contract with me."
"Or die."
A moment later.
That massive ice ball sensed the message Han Xing conveyed with Divine Power.
And then, a soft voice shouted, "Human, don’t think about it!"
"I will never submit to you!"
Han Xing nodded, saying no more.
Then, he pulled the bowstring.
In an instant, over a dozen arrows shot out.
"Whiz!
Whiz whiz!"
From where Han Xing shot the arrows to the Slime’s location.
The frozen ground cracked open, forming countless intersecting fissures extending for thousands of meters.
"Crash!"
Ice shards splattered, blizzards danced.
After a series of tremendous blasts.
The entire Ice and Snow Continent began to tremble violently.
Seconds later.
Everything gradually calmed down.
And where the Frost Slime once stood, a collapsed ice mountain appeared.
This was the effect of Han Xing’s attack.
Directly shooting down a nearby mountain, which then crashed down.
Then.
Six people and one wolf approached the massive collapsed ice mountain.
"Crunch!"
"Crunch!"
Han Xing led the way.
Everywhere he passed, the ice blocks cracked open instantly.
Automatically making a path for him toward the ice mountain.
This effect was caused by the external release of Divine Power.
A moment later, they had advanced about a kilometer or two.
In a sheet of ice and snow.
The group spotted a familiar figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 347: Slime Emperor and Beast Tamer_3
paragraphs: It was precisely that Frost Slime.
However, it no longer had its previous pristine appearance.
Not only was it riddled with wounds, but even a piece of its head was missing.
It appeared utterly miserable.
At this moment.
The Frost Slime stared at everyone with its big, round eyes.
Looking pitifully at them.
Han Xing tossed out a Contract Scroll and said blandly, "Sign it."
Indeed.
Han Xing hadn’t really killed it.
When the Frost Slime saw that Han Xing broke through its Frost Armor with just a few arrows.
And inflicted severe damage on it.
To survive, it surrendered.
The cost was to sign a Lord Contract with Han Xing.
Staring at the ancient-looking scroll on the ground.
The Frost Slime’s eyes showed extreme indignation.
It glared at Xiao with hatred.
"Despicable!"
High Priest Xiao looked speechless.
Damn it, what’s it got to do with me?
It’s not like I forced you to sign the Lord Contract!
However, this Frost Slime still harbored resentment.
For Xiao’s defeat and invitation of reinforcements.
But now the circumstances were unfavorable.
The Frost Slime could only submit despite its indignation.
"Blub! Blub!"
The Frost Slime spat out two drops of icy water from its mouth, like spitting saliva.
Leaving its mark on the Contract Scroll.
Han Xing felt a cold sweat, thinking the Frost Slime was about to go back on its word.
At that moment, a system message appeared.
[Lord Contract successfully signed. High-tier Legendary Creature: Frost Slime Emperor, has joined your camp. World influence +432, Camp Fortune Value +500.]
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
He originally intended to use the Lord Contract to restrain the Frost Slime.
Unexpectedly, the system automatically considered it part of his camp, even providing 500 Fortune Value points.
This improvement was beyond his expectations.
Before joy could appear in Han Xing’s eyes.
Another system message appeared.
[Survivor Star River, please note: As the first survivor to contract a high-tier Legendary Creature in the server, unlock the achievement title: Legendary Beast Tamer.]
[Legendary Beast Tamer (Upgradeable)]: Creatures contracted with you have All Attributes increased by 10% and experience gain speed increased by 20%.
[Upgrade Progress]: 1/10 (Contract 10 Legendary Creatures to continue upgrading the title.)
Han Xing: "??"
"Whoa! I became a Beast Tamer?"
Han Xing was immensely surprised.
The [Legendary Beast Tamer] title was another unexpected gain!
With this title, Han Xing would not just think about killing when meeting Legendary Creatures in the wild.
He should try to contract more powerful beings.
Not only to increase Camp Fortune Value but also to upgrade the title progress.
"Great, great, the title of Legendary Beast Tamer is perfect for a Hunter."
"In the future, when my team grows, I won’t even have to fight."
"Just send out the contracted beasts and start a righteous brawl!"
At this moment.
After signing the Lord Contract, the ’Frost Slime Emperor’ bounced over to Han Xing.
There was no trace of hostility in its eyes anymore.
Its gaze toward Han Xing was full of affection.
Han Xing checked the Slime’s panel.
[Frost Slime Emperor]: Five-star Legend.
[Level]: 58.
[Loyalty]: 88.
Han Xing nodded.
Loyalty points, that’s decent.
It’s important to know that after signing the Lord Contract Scroll, the minimum Loyalty is 80.
It seems that his show of force was quite effective.
However, this reminded Han Xing of the Long-armed Fierce Ape.
Not only did it break the 80 Loyalty threshold, but its Loyalty was steadily decreasing.
Recently.
Its Loyalty had dropped below 20.
It also liked scheming behind the scenes.
Han Xing had complete knowledge of all its actions.
That guy was practically planning to backstab him any moment now.
If Han Xing continued to play dumb, he’d be a real idiot.
So.
He brutally beat the Long-armed Fierce Ape and forcibly sealed it.
Suppressing it deep beneath Ten Thousand Stars City.
It still hasn’t been released to this day.
Looking at the Frost Slime in front of him.
Han Xing suddenly said.
"Since you’ve joined my camp, you should have your own name."
"From now on, I’ll call you Xiaobing."
Hearing this name, everyone had a cold sweat.
As expected, it’s still the familiar style.
As usual, a naming disaster.
However, the Frost Slime quite liked the name.
It happily bounced, seeming very joyful.
Nearby, Coal Ball glanced at it disdainfully.
"Xiaobing, control the chill on this Sky Island and raise the temperature a bit."
Han Xing said, "Soon, I have people coming to mine here; don’t freeze my soldiers to death."
Upon hearing this, the Frost Slime blinked its large eyes up and down.
Then shook its head.
Han Xing frowned: "What do you mean? You don’t want to control it?"
This Slime’s refusal of his first command made Han Xing’s heart sink.
Noticing its master’s displeasure.
The Frost Slime immediately panicked.
It widened its eyes and started releasing Divine Power,
hastily explaining the situation to Han Xing.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was taken aback, "You mean you can’t control the temperature on this Sky Island?"
"Instead, something up there continually emits chilling air?"
The Slime bounced once again.
Seeming very happy that Han Xing understood its words.
At this moment, Han Xing heard the Slime’s childish voice again.
"M...Master..."
"That thing releases an extremely cold aura, and this aura contains a peculiar power."
"Even I, by absorbing the power from that thing, gained consciousness and then obtained the power to control frost."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s Divine Power surged instantly.
As if out of control, enveloping the entire Sky Island.
"Crash!"
Several distant mountains collapsed again.
Everyone watched in astonishment at this scene.
Seemingly unaware, that the Slime had told Han Xing something.
That made him lose his composure like that.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 348: Supreme Hidden Profession!
paragraphs: Center of the Ice and Snow Continent.
A deep valley.
Six people, a wolf, and a Slime are walking toward the center of the valley.
"Brother Xing, is this the place mentioned by that Slime?" Shen Yun asked.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"I can feel that the temperature here is getting lower and lower. This should be where the Divine Artifact is located!"
Upon hearing this, a fervent expression simultaneously appeared in everyone’s eyes.
According to Han Xing’s explanation.
They all realized what a shocking thing the Slime had revealed!
Turns out, at the center of this Ice and Snow Continent, there exists a very powerful Divine Artifact.
It constantly emits an astonishing chill.
Freezing the area within tens of thousands of miles.
Moreover, this Divine Artifact occasionally emits strands of pure divine power.
It was by absorbing this divine power that the Frost Slime attained High-tier Legend status.
After Han Xing finished explaining these things.
Everyone was stunned for a long time.
They all knew that becoming a Legend is a very difficult achievement.
Let alone a High-tier Legend!
Yet, by only absorbing the divine power that occasionally leaks out, the Frost Slime Emperor became such a High-tier Legend.
From this, it can be seen how extraordinary this Divine Artifact is!
That’s why Han Xing was so excited at the time.
He almost lost control over his divine power.
Others were also shocked for quite a while before coming back to their senses.
Then.
They were impatient and quickly obtained the location of the Divine Artifact from the Slime’s mouth, then rushed over at full speed.
Just as Han Xing said.
Upon reaching here, the temperature dropped even further.
The negative status of [Extreme Cold Erosion] kept appearing.
A layer of frost covered everyone’s bodies.
Shen Yun kept using the Purification Technique, barely able to maintain the status.
"Gurgle..."
The Slime made a bouncing sound.
A snow-covered cave entrance appeared ahead.
"Xiaobing, is this the place?"
Han Xing’s voice echoed from behind.
The Frost Slime responded with a divine power fluctuation, "Yes... it is, master."
"I jumped out from here."
"This ice cave... is very deep, very cold, takes a long time to climb..."
Han Xing displayed a thoughtful expression.
This ice cave indeed seems quite peculiar.
His divine power reached the entrance and was instantly enveloped by a strong chill.
He had no idea about the situation inside.
Even the Frost Slime said it’s very cold inside, indicating the temperatures beyond imagination.
To be safe, Han Xing decided to first summon Bear Spirit Gangtu to explore inside.
As Han Xing raised his bow and arrow.
A slightly phantom-like Violent Bear appeared before everyone.
Upon receiving Han Xing’s command.
Bear Spirit Gangtu hesitantly dove into the cave.
"Rumble!"
The ice and snow covering the entrance were instantly shattered.
Revealing a cave with a diameter exceeding two hundred meters.
Being a Legendary Creature, Bear Spirit Gangtu had an extremely fast burst speed.
It dashed forward rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, it charged several kilometers ahead.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a weakening in his connection with Bear Spirit.
It was as if there was a delay.
Han Xing frowned.
It was the first time he had encountered such a situation.
Bear Spirit Gangtu continued to progress deep into the frozen area.
When it reached nearly ten thousand meters.
A sudden system notification appeared.
[Your summoned creature: Bear Spirit Gangtu has died...]
Han Xing’s expression froze.
His mood sank to rock bottom in an instant.
He had no idea what happened in the ice cave.
Bear Spirit Gangtu died shortly after being summoned.
This had never happened before.
Bear Spirit Gangtu inherited 150% of Han Xing’s attributes, possessing at least Middle-tier Legend power.
Yet, it died suddenly, without a sound of battle.
This realization sent a chill down Han Xing’s spine.
"It seems, there is considerable danger within this ice cave."
After explaining Bear Spirit Gangtu’s situation.
Everyone’s faces registered shock.
"My God... even a Middle-tier Legend died upon entering."
"What exactly is inside?"
Cheng Jianyong’s expression was puzzled, and the others also had a mixture of apprehension and tension.
At this moment, Shen Yun analyzed: "I remember, the Slime said it emerged from inside."
"Then, does it know what’s in the ice cave?"
Upon hearing this, eyes turned toward the Slime.
But it was found staring blankly at Han Xing.
"I... I don’t know..."
"When I first gained consciousness, I found myself inside the ice cave."
"I stayed there for a long time, didn’t encounter any danger..." The Slime communicated with divine power to Han Xing.
After hearing its explanation.
Han Xing nodded.
Clearly, the Slime itself didn’t know why Bear Spirit had an accident.
Either the dangers in this pit wouldn’t harm the Slime.
Or the danger in this pit emerged later.
But regardless of which reason, neither is a good sign for them.
Yet, simply giving up would leave them unwilling.
After all, this continent holds rich Extreme Ice Divine Stone mineral resources.
If they don’t resolve the source of the chilling emanation, Han Xing cannot send people for mining.
Which would mean losing a significant amount of resources.
As if understanding Han Xing’s thoughts.
Suddenly, Shen Yun said: "Brother Xing, let’s go inside and take a look."
"The Bear Spirit didn’t die immediately after entering, which means the danger is deeper inside the ice cave."

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 348: Supreme Hidden Profession!
paragraphs: "With our strength, we should try exploring."
"Even if we encounter danger, we’ll retreat immediately."
Upon hearing Shen Yun’s suggestion,
everyone pondered for a moment, then looked towards Han Xing and nodded.
Han Xing contemplated seriously for a moment.
Then said, "Okay, let’s go in and take a look."
"If it’s not feasible, we’ll retreat right away."
Everyone’s faces showed a smile.
Although, we don’t know what’s inside yet.
But the long-standing tacit understanding lets them trust each other.
No matter what danger they encounter, they can overcome it together.
Next, six people and a wolf, plus a slime, began to enter this giant ice cave.
The slime still led the way at the front.
Then everyone followed behind.
As soon as they entered the frozen area,
their bodies were instantly covered by a layer of frost.
System alerts appeared.
[You’ve been invaded by Extreme Cold Qi, current negative state stacked up to 5 layers.]
Han Xing frowned slightly.
Just upon entering, he was stacked with 5 layers of ’Extreme Cold Erosion.’
How many layers would it stack if they went further in?
Is this the danger inside the frozen area?
After advancing about five or six kilometers,
Han Xing and the others finally knew what the danger inside was.
It was an extremely terrifying cold air, capable of freezing everything!
Everyone simultaneously heard the system alert of ’Extreme Cold Erosion’ negative state stacking up to 10 layers.
"So... so cold..." Cheng Jianyong said shivering, as if he had been completely numbed by the cold.
The others were also not feeling well.
Their bodies were frozen stiff, even their blood felt intensely cold.
Shen Yun continuously released the Purification Technique at the side.
However, the relentless chill here was enough to freeze ordinary legendary powerhouses.
It could be said to be a dead end for living beings.
Even the Purification Technique struggled to keep up with the stacking speed of ’Extreme Cold Erosion.’
Han Xing immediately said, "Release Divine Power Domain to resist the erosion of the cold current."
Everyone complied upon hearing this.
However, they discovered that their divine power was instantly frozen upon release.
The intense pain swept through their bodies!
"Oh, is it this outrageous?" Cheng Jianyong asked incredulously.
The others also inhaled sharply.
Even divine power being frozen was something they never encountered before.
At this rate, they could only stop here!
And at this moment,
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high, its tip radiating bright white light.
The intense Holy Light instantly illuminated the entire ice cave.
Its warm aura instantly dispelled the chill from their bodies, from the inside out!
It was his Church Secret Technique—Holy Light Shines.
"Brother Xing, Holy Light Shines can still last a while, let’s move forward," Shen Yun said while holding the Holy Hammer.
Han Xing nodded upon hearing this.
Then, they proceeded deeper into the frozen area.
They advanced for about two more kilometers.
They all felt completely frozen stiff.
Shen Yun’s Sun duration ended as well.
Everyone felt an intense chill throughout their bodies.
"We’ve reached the limit. Going further, we might end up frozen to death like that Bear Spirit," Han Xing said helplessly.
Cheng Jianyong echoed, "Indeed, this should be the limit."
"We should head back."
Everyone’s faces showed a bit of helplessness.
The terror of this ice cave had truly exceeded their expectations.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at the Frost Slime ahead.
Only to find that it was also frozen stiff in place.
Han Xing said speechlessly, "What the heck, aren’t you a Frost Slime?"
"Even you can be frozen stiff?"
A moment later, Han Xing heard a voice of grievance in his ear.
"Master... this isn’t a simple chill, but a force targeting the legendary.
"This situation never happened before..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing slightly furrowed his brow.
It seems they came at the wrong time.
Though reluctant, they had no choice but to temporarily give up.
They would return to explore when their strength is greater in the future.
Just as everyone was about to turn back,
a faint divine power fluctuation was felt inside.
This fluctuation was unlike that cold air.
After it swept across them, it didn’t cause any unusual effects.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others heard a system alert simultaneously.
[Target detected, verifying identity...]
[Race: Human Race (Confirmed), Power: Legend (Confirmed), lifting extreme cold restriction...]
Upon hearing this alert, everyone’s eyes lit up.
They distinctly felt that the cold air from deep within the ice cave had stopped.
Everyone sighed in relief as their almost-frozen bodies came back to life.
The five of them exchanged glances and simultaneously revealed a smile.
Beside them, the High Priest was confused.
He wasn’t from the Human Race and didn’t hear Han Xing’s system alert.
But he also felt the disappearance of the frightful chill in the ice cave.
"It seems... there’s always a way out!"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Sounds like this is a place of opportunity specially left for us Humans."
"Let’s go in!"
With those words,
Han Xing led the way, heading deeper into the frozen area.
Everyone followed closely behind.
After about ten minutes,
they advanced over ten thousand meters.
Finally,
they reached the deepest part of the ice cave.
Here, a huge icy cavern suddenly appeared.
The space inside was extremely vast.
The ice-formed walls appeared incredibly smooth.
At the top of the cavern, Han Xing saw several glowing ’Extreme Ice Divine Stones.’

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 348: Supreme Hidden Profession!
paragraphs: Just like the previous explorations, this place contains rich mineral resources.
At the same time.
They also saw the source of the chilling sensation.
In the center of the cave.
There was a dazzling rhombic crystal, floating in mid-air.
Currently emitting a brilliant light.
Han Xing recognized the thing, and blurted out instantly.
"Divine Format!"
Hearing this, everyone’s pupils widened.
"What?"
Even High Priest Xiao nearby couldn’t help but exclaim: "It’s really a Divine Format!"
"Oh my god! I didn’t expect that there would be such a precious thing inside this Sky Island!"
The High Priest was so excited for the first time, even his divine power was somewhat out of control.
"Could this be the arrangement of fate?"
"Saint Master Helas has just fallen, and the Witch Race doesn’t have a Demigod Level powerhouse."
"At this moment, a Sky Island hiding a Divine Format floats over!"
"Truly, blessed by the celestial mandate!"
After speaking, he gave Han Xing a deep look.
In Xiao’s heart, it seemed Han Xing was the one destined by the heavens.
However, what Xiao didn’t know was.
This Divine Format was not the opportunity for the Witch Race.
But it belonged to the Human Race.
If it weren’t for Han Xing and his team inadvertently discovering it.
Even if Xiao found this Sky Island, he would be blocked by the terrifying cold within the Frozen and have nothing to do with this Divine Format.
With a sense of excitement.
The six people and one wolf approached this dazzling crystal together.
At this moment, the Divine Format was emitting multicolored light.
The rhombic appearance, like the most perfect object in the world.
A item attribute appeared before Han Xing.
[Elemental God King’s Seven Attribute Divine Format: Ice]: Special item. (Can achieve different use effects through different usage methods.)

[Effect 1]: Legendary Professional, through absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, can greatly enhance one’s divine power value, the increase range is 5000~10000. (After absorption, the Divine Format shatters.)

[Effect 2]: Mage Profession, after reaching Level 60, can automatically advance to Hidden Profession: Ice and Snow Mage God using this Divine Format. (Using the Divine Format for promotion does not reduce level.)

[Effect 3]: After collecting the remaining six Elemental Divine Formats, can advance to Supreme Hidden Profession: Elemental Divine King. (The other six Elemental Divine Formats are: Fire, Thunder, Light, Dark, Earth, Wind.)
After reading the attributes of this Divine Format.
Everyone took a deep breath.
The function of this Divine Format is truly terrifying.
Just absorbing it directly can increase divine power value by over 5000 points!
You should know, Han Xing just broke through Legendary, and his divine power value only recently surpassed 2000.
In other words, it directly increases his divine power value more than twice!
The increase in strength is quite frightening.
Besides this most direct effect.
This Divine Format is also related to two Mage hidden profession advancement paths.
Among them, there is a Supreme Hidden Profession.
Han Xing did not know what the so-called Supreme Hidden Profession is.
But just needing to break through with 7 different Elemental Divine Formats, this reverse-heaven difficulty can showcase.
How terrifying this profession can be.
Everyone simultaneously looked at Zhang Lianmeng.
Without a doubt.
This thing was prepared for Zhang Lianmeng.
An opportunity item all Mages dream about!
Watching everyone’s gaze, Zhang Lianmeng appeared a bit at a loss.
She tentatively glanced at the High Priest beside her.
At this moment, everyone reacted.
Indeed.
Aside from Zhang Lianmeng, High Priest Xiao also belonged to the Mage Series Professional.
Or rather, most of the Legendary Powerhouses of the Witch Race are Mages.
Seeing everyone’s firm gazes.
Xiao forced a smile and shook his head: "Folks, no need to look at me."
"My strongest means is burning Witch Patterns, which can also grant me Demigod level strength for a short time."
"Therefore, this Divine Format doesn’t suit me, even if it allowed me to break through to Demigod, it wouldn’t give much improvement."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
He also knew, although most of the Witch Race are Mages.
Their profession system differs from the Human Race.
It’s not cultivating Energy and Magic.
But cultivating Witch Patterns.
Including some Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques, all require Witch Patterns to initiate.
And this is the reason why Han Xing did not learn Forbidden Techniques.
At this time, Han Xing’s voice came.
"Lian’Er, put it away, first store it in the backpack."
"See if there’s a chance in the future to find the other Elemental Divine Formats."
"Hmm."
Zhang Lianmeng nodded gently.
Without hesitation, she directly stored it in the backpack.
Just as the Divine Format was stowed, an alert sounded in Han Xing’s ear.
[Detected you have explored all areas of this Sky Island, it is now in an unowned state, would you like to merge?]
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
Then, a large number of resource alerts appeared.
Including large veins of ’Extreme Ice Divine Stone’ and over a thousand ’Ultimate Ice Crystal Flower’.
These resources allow the Witch Race to expand again, but need to be mined.
However, the most precious item on this Sky Island has been pocketed by them.
Finding the Divine Format, Han Xing also felt delighted.
He patted the High Priest’s shoulder and said: "Done well."
"Next time there’s such a good place, contact me first."
High Priest Xiao showed a face full of helplessness.
But could only respectfully comply.
Then, everyone walked out of the ice cave together.
After Zhang Lianmeng stored the Divine Format, the raging blizzard finally stopped.
The temperature slowly warmed up.
Though it was still very cold.
At least, ordinary people could now be active on it.
This way, mining work could continue onward.
Han Xing was satisfied looking at this colossal Ice and Snow Continent.
This Sky Island exploration declared a complete end.
Next, he would bring this Ice and Snow Continent back to the Witch Race Main City.
The enormous white Sky Island began rapid forward movement.
Hours later.
The Ice and Snow Sky Island brought back by Han Xing reached its destination.
In the eyes of a group of astonished Witch Race Soldiers.
They witnessed this Ice and Snow Sky Island instantly merge with Witch Race Continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 349: Strange Anomalies!
paragraphs: "Rumble!"
A violent sound came.
As if the space station had completed its docking operation.
This massive Ice and Snow Sky Island was integrated into the Witch Race Continent.
At this moment, Han Xing instructed, "Xiaobing, you usually stay in that ice cave, don’t come out unless necessary."
"If you encounter an enemy, eliminate them immediately!"
The Slime, hearing this, happily bounced up and down.
It truly liked staying in its birthplace.
Han Xing nodded.
The purpose of his actions was obviously to add some defensive power to the Witch Race Continent.
To use it as a trump card.
In case of any danger.
The battle power of a High-tier Legend is not to be underestimated.
After doing this.
Han Xing turned around and said, "I need to attend to some matters."
"If you’re fine, go and rest for a bit."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, upon hearing this, nodded one after another.
Then the five of them vanished from the spot.
At this moment, Han Xing took out a Communication Jade and contacted the Six Witch Clan Priests, Ciri.
"Have the patients been gathered?" Han Xing asked directly.
Moments later.
A message came back from Ciri.
"Reporting to Lord Saint Master, it’s already underway."
"But because of the large number of patients, it may... still take some time."
Her tone seemed a bit anxious.
"Too many patients?"
Hearing this, Han Xing frowned.
Ever since he left the Witch Race Continent to handle the Slime Sky Island matter.
At least a day had passed back and forth.
With the efficiency of these Legendary Powerhouses, they still hadn’t completed the gathering.
This indicated that the number of Witch Race People infected by the epidemic was beyond Han Xing’s expectations.
"Is there an estimated number?" Han Xing asked.
"Yes, roughly over 8 billion people..."
"But it might be even more...
Ciri’s tone was somewhat uneasy, accompanied by a hint of worry.
Hearing this number, a trace of surprise appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"So many?"
Ciri, upon hearing this, immediately said excitedly.
"I’m... I’m sorry, Lord Saint Master!"
"It’s my dereliction of duty, I underestimated the infection speed of this epidemic."
"Through our investigation, we found a large number of infected in every corner of thousands of cities on the Witch Race Continent!"
"These infected usually like to hide in dark places and rarely appear."
"If it weren’t for your reminder and emphasis, we might have let this epidemic rampage further."
"Please blame me, Lord Saint Master, I’m willing to bear all consequences!"
Han Xing frowned.
He hadn’t expected the epidemic to develop to such a severe state.
Moments later, Han Xing said, "I understand, I’ll head over now."
With those words, Han Xing’s figure flickered and disappeared from his original location.
Meanwhile.
The entire Witch Race Continent underwent a massive cleaning operation.
On the streets of every town, there were numerous Witch Race Soldiers patrolling back and forth.
They conducted house-to-house inspections, leaving no corner unchecked.
"Open the door! Come out quickly!"
After knocking on doors without receiving a response, the soldiers would often break in directly.
The doors of these Witch Race civilians were kicked open.
"Bang! Bang bang!"
"Clang! Clang!"
The sound of rummaging through furniture echoed.
In a wooden cabinet, a figure was dragged out.
"Ah!!! Don’t take me!! Don’t take me!"
"I’m not infected! I’m not an infected!"
"Let me go!!"
A thin woman, clutching the baby in her arms, cried out hoarsely.
However, the soldiers’ eyes at the door were filled with a strange gaze.
Because her body was already covered in large-scale festering wounds, with countless bizarre eyeballs wriggling on them.
These eyeballs stared fixedly at the soldiers at the door.
What was even more eerie was the baby in the woman’s arms.
The baby’s body had turned black and purple, completely stiff.
It was a stillborn baby!
The soldiers took a deep breath and couldn’t help but curse.
"Damn! How did this epidemic burst out without a sound?"
"If not for the Saint Master’s order, we wouldn’t have known it had reached such a severe stage."
Other soldiers shook their heads.
"It doesn’t seem like an epidemic to me, more like a curse."
"What epidemic could turn people into this horrible state?"
Hearing this, a look of shock appeared in everyone’s eyes.
"A curse? Could some entity be targeting our Witch Race?"
"With Saint Master Han Xing around, which one would be so bold?"
A group of Witch Race Soldiers speculated in their hearts.
"Ugh... let’s take this lady away first."
"We need to move quickly, there must be many more infected like this in the city."
"By the way, remember to take a High Level Curse Antidote before contacting these infected."
"Once infected, drinking this antidote has little effect."
The Witch Race Soldiers nodded one after another and then captured the female infected.
Everything was executed in an orderly manner.
Meanwhile.
More pale-faced, pus-blood flowing infected individuals were dragged out from dark corners.
Some were under beds, some in wardrobes.
Including various windows, basements, sewers, even toilets...
Anywhere filthy and dark.
Could hide the shadows of these infected.
They were like rats hiding in the dark.
Now, after the soldiers’ search.
None could hide.
The entire Witch Race Continent was thrown into chaos.
On the streets.
Those Witch Race people who had not been infected closed their doors and stayed inside.
The Witch Race Soldiers escorted a large number of infected people.

"It doesn’t seem like an epidemic to me, more like a curse."
"What epidemic could turn people into this horrible state?"
Hearing this, a look of shock appeared in everyone’s eyes.
"A curse?
Could some entity be targeting our Witch Race?"
"With Saint Master Han Xing around, which one would be so bold?"
A group of Witch Race Soldiers speculated in their hearts.
"Ugh... let’s take this lady away first."
"We need to move quickly, there must be many more infected like this in the city."
"By the way, remember to take a High Level Curse Antidote before contacting these infected."
"Once infected, drinking this antidote has little effect."
The Witch Race Soldiers nodded one after another and then captured the female infected.
Everything was executed in an orderly manner.
Meanwhile.
More pale-faced, pus-blood flowing infected individuals were dragged out from dark corners.
Some were under beds, some in wardrobes.
Including various windows, basements, sewers, even toilets...
Anywhere filthy and dark.
Could hide the shadows of these infected.
They were like rats hiding in the dark.
Now, after the soldiers’ search.
None could hide.
The entire Witch Race Continent was thrown into chaos.
On the streets.
Those Witch Race people who had not been infected closed their doors and stayed inside.
The Witch Race Soldiers escorted a large number of infected people.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 349: Strange Anomalies!
paragraphs: Then gather at the original underground shelter as a temporary control point.
At this moment.
In a vast main city of the Witch Race.
The figure of Han Xing appeared.
In front stood three figures.
Wu Ling’Er, Ciri, and Commander Kathy.
This was the original third main city.
However, today the main city was met with chaotic scenes.
A large number of the infected were pulled out and then herded into the underground shelter.
Looking at the chaos before him, Han Xing frowned.
The three people in front of him simultaneously knelt on one knee and said in unison.
"Please forgive us, Lord Saint Master!"
The appearance of such a situation in the main city.
As managers, they certainly had an unshirkable responsibility.
However, Han Xing did not want to pursue this matter.
He just wanted to quickly check on the condition of these infected individuals.
"Let’s go, to the shelter."
As soon as he finished speaking.
The four figures disappeared from the spot.
Then, they directly appeared inside the Witch Race’s underground city shelter.
It was called a shelter, but it was actually a huge underground town.
Inside were various facilities that were quite well-equipped.
Residential houses, resource warehouses, weapon-forging workshops, culture bases, etc...
Even in the event of war, relying on the resources inside.
They could hold out for a long time.
However, now this place had detained a large number of infected.
There was a large group of Witch Race soldiers guarding the entrance to the shelter.
Upon seeing Han Xing and the others coming, a look of shock appeared in the soldiers’ eyes.
"Lord Saint Master!" the group of Witch Race soldiers shouted fervently.
Han Xing nodded, "Take us inside."
"Yes!"
With that, Han Xing and the others appeared in the underground city.
Han Xing surveyed with his divine power and immediately noticed something unusual about the group of infected.
He glanced at Ciri.
"Is this the plague you mentioned?"
Ciri shook her head helplessly, "I’m sorry, Lord Saint Master."
"This isn’t a plague, but a curse."
"They hid it very well..."
Ciri answered truthfully.
Han Xing waved his hand.
At this time.
A shaky figure suddenly appeared on the empty street.
It was an infected person.
The pupils of the nearby Witch Race soldiers contracted instantly.
They hadn’t seen when this infected person came out.
"Stop!"
"Hurry back to your quarters!"
The group of Witch Race soldiers shouted.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s figure flashed and appeared in front of the infected person.
It was a young male with a refined appearance.
However, he seemed very weak.
Large-scale ulcerations appeared on his arms and face, with various strange eyes wriggling on them.
This was a sign that the curse had entered the body and was gradually worsening.
"What’s your name?" Han Xing asked.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, the young man’s face showed an obsessed smile.
Yellow saliva dripped from the corners of his mouth, and his entire body emitted a foul odor.
"Eat... eat meat..."
Han Xing frowned slightly, "Eat meat?"
After hearing this, the young man once again showed a bizarre smile at the corners of his mouth.
"I want... to eat your meat..."
The nearby Witch Race soldiers immediately shouted in anger upon hearing this.
"How dare you!"
"Do not be disrespectful to Lord Saint Master!"
Han Xing waved his hand.
He did not care.
At this moment, Ciri spoke worriedly from the side, "Lord Saint Master, the infected are currently in this state."
"Sometimes lucid, sometimes chaotic."
"We’ve used the best curse-removal secret elixirs from the clan, but still have not had much effect."
"Now, the Twelve Priests and Thirteen Priests are already searching for a method to remove the curse."
Han Xing nodded, "Have you tried using divine power to cleanse the curse from them?"
Ciri froze.
Even Wu Ling’Er beside her was in a state of confusion.
Speaking of which, they hadn’t tried it this way before.
However, Han Xing knew.
These legendary powerhouses had divine power that could resist and even remove the effects of curses.
This is also why.
Once reaching the legendary level, they were rarely entangled by such curses.
Han Xing asked no more questions.
Instead, he attempted to cover the infected person’s body with divine power.
The next moment.
Han Xing felt a sinister and foul odor approaching.
This odor even began to invade his divine power!
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
In front of Han Xing, a plume of corrosive smoke appeared.
"Hmm?"
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
The situation before him was indeed quite bizarre.
It’s important to know that divine power is a special kind of energy without a physical presence.
But now, it was actually being corroded by the aura emanating from this infected person.
And in Han Xing’s perception.
This infected person was merely a mortal who hadn’t even undergone the first transformation.
"Let’s try again."
With that, a faint golden light appeared on Han Xing’s body once more.
As he began to focus.
The sinister aura from the infected person was instantly dispelled.
Intense white smoke erupted from his body.
Just when everyone thought Han Xing’s divine power was showing its effect,
a bizarre scene unfolded.
The young man’s face suddenly contorted into a painful, twisted smile.
He looked at Han Xing, making a sound like a blower from his throat.
"Hah... hah..."
"Lord... of the Human Race!"
"Hand over the object..."
"Or you will not rest in peace!"
After speaking, the infected person extended his rotting hands, seemingly attempting to grab Han Xing.
"Stop!"
Those Witch Race soldiers immediately drew their weapons, preparing to rush over.
However, there was little turmoil in Han Xing’s heart at this moment.
He could sense that the infected person’s state was extremely unstable.
Han Xing slightly raised his hand.
Just as he was about to seal the other person.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 349: Strange Anomalies!
paragraphs: The infected person’s face twisted into an ugly expression.
Then, his body began to swell, becoming like an inflated balloon.
The next moment, he exploded!
"Bang!"
After the explosion.
Countless droplets of blood scattered, and various intestines and internal organs flew in all directions.
These fragments of body tissue, once they fell to the ground, continued to squirm.
From above, one could see a mass of teeth and eyeballs.
Those eyeballs were all staring intently at Han Xing.
Conveying a sinister and eerie meaning.
"Saint Master!!!"
The nearby Witch Race soldiers exclaimed and rushed toward Han Xing.
That scene just now was too terrifying, causing everyone to feel a chill down their spine.
However, Han Xing waved his hand, indicating they need not come over.
The moment the infected person exploded.
Han Xing had already deployed his Divine Power Domain, blocking those fragments outside.
Therefore, not a single bit of the infectious flesh touched Han Xing’s body.
Yet.
A trace of coldness had already surfaced in Han Xing’s eyes.
He seemed to be gradually understanding something.
This curse wasn’t directed at the Witch Race.
But was aimed at himself.
"Interesting..."
"Do you want something from me?"
"What is it?"
"And who has set their sights on me?"
While Han Xing was pondering these questions.
Suddenly, a series of door-breaking sounds came from beside him.
The group of infected, whose actions had been restricted, simultaneously pushed open the shelter doors.
Then stepped onto the street.
Their limbs were stiff as they turned their heads, staring in the same direction.
At this moment, Han Xing only felt himself surrounded by countless eyes.
The Witch Race soldiers shouted angrily.
"What are all of you doing?"
"Get back there and stay put!"
Yet.
The several hundred thousand infected who stepped onto the street were entirely unmoved.
In unison, they spoke.
"Witch! Race! Saint! Master!"
"Hand over the object!"
"Or you shall die without a grave!"
Their voices shook the entire underground city.
The Witch Race soldiers were shocked and angry, "Do not be disrespectful to the Saint Master!"
Upon hearing these words, tens of thousands of infected eyes simultaneously turned to them.
The next moment.
From the infected, a green liquid simultaneously sprayed out, transforming into Poison Arrows, attacking the Witch Race soldiers.
The soldiers’ eyes revealed a frightened expression.
"Damn it, what do you guys want to do?"
Han Xing frowned and said: "Showing aggression in my presence?"
With that, his faint golden divine power burst forth instantly!
The Poison Arrows emitted a sizzling sound the moment they encountered Han Xing’s divine power.
Like encountering their nemesis.
And then they directly dissipated in mid-air.
Simultaneously.
Seeing the attack fail, the infected displayed the same symptoms as the previous infected.
Their bodies suddenly swelled like balloons, seemingly ready to explode at any moment!
Even Han Xing hadn’t anticipated this scene in front of him.
That antagonist was planning to use these hundreds of thousands of lives to send him a warning!
Han Xing directly expanded his Divine Power Domain to its maximum!
Enveloping the entire city within his domain.
Then, a terrifying aura released from Han Xing’s body.
The nearby Witch Race soldiers felt as if a peerless Divine Weapon was revealing its brilliance!
All the infected were instantly suppressed by Han Xing!
However, to Han Xing’s surprise.
Despite acting in the first second of their swelling.
This group of infected’s self-destruct speed was evidently faster.
"Splash! Splash splash splash!"
In the field, at least half of the infected exploded into meat sludge!
In a split second, the streets of the entire underground shelter turned into a mess of red and green.
Blood stained the ground completely red.
Han Xing remained silent for a long time.
"Saint Master..."
"Brother Xing..."
Wu Ling’Er and Ciri’s voices came from behind.
Han Xing slowly turned his head.
His face showed a cold expression.
A strong intention to kill had already emerged in Han Xing’s heart.
"Very well, I will remember this warning."
But Han Xing was unaware that this was just the beginning.
At that moment.
Ciri and Wu Ling’Er’s expressions simultaneously changed dramatically.
They hurried over to report: "Saint Master! There’s an outbreak of infected chaos outside!"
"All infected have become extremely agitated, and they are frantically attacking other Witch Race civilians!"
Han Xing’s eyes turned even colder.
Although he didn’t know which person was targeting him.
It’s evident they didn’t want him to have peace.
Or perhaps they wanted to force him to hand over something the opponent desired through these means.
Han Xing waved his hand.
All infected on the ground were stamped with a layer of Divine Power Seal.
Though just a simple layer of seal, it would require at least Legendary Powerhouses to break it.
Until Han Xing resolved the infection, he could only use this method to cope.
With that, Han Xing directly ordered: "Let’s go, we need to go out and control all the infected."
He, along with Ciri and Wu Ling’Er, are Legendary Powerhouses.
Under these circumstances, they could be of great help.
The three walked toward the exit together.
Yet, there was still one person who remained in place.
Han Xing slightly furrowed his brows, looking at the figure behind him.
"Kathy, what are you doing?"
The figure standing still was the Commander of the Third Main City, Kathy.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s voice.
Ciri and Wu Ling’Er simultaneously halted their steps.
They also noticed that Kathy’s state seemed somewhat abnormal.
"Kathy?" Wu Ling’Er asked softly.
Seeing she didn’t answer.
Wu Ling’Er instinctively wanted to step forward, to check on her condition.
Han Xing reached out to stop her.
He stared at Kathy.
Moments later, the tall woman abruptly lifted her head.
Then, she revealed a bizarre smile to Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 350: Threats and Audacious Deeds!
paragraphs: Kathy gave Han Xing a strange smile.
Under her delicate features, her complexion was incredibly pale.
Not only that.
On her forehead and face, a pale eyeball appeared.
All of these eyeballs were staring intently at Han Xing!
Ciri and Wu Ling’Er both held their breath.
At this moment, Han Xing’s gaze completely transformed into a killing intent.
He originally thought this curse would only spread among civilians.
Now it seems, he was mistaken.
The power of the curse far exceeded his imagination.
Not only targeting those in the Third and Fourth Transformations of the profession.
Now, it’s even set its sights on the people around him.
As a commander, Kathy possessed Four-star Lord Level strength.
If even she got infected.
That means throughout the Witch Race Territory.
Apart from these legendary powerhouses, no one can escape this fate.
At this moment, Infected Cassie let out a sharp laugh.
"Hee hee... hee hee hee..."
"Master of the Human Race, are you surprised?"
"Are you angry?"
"But, it’s useless~"
Han Xing exhaled and said slowly, "Do you know? You’re courting death."
His tone was very calm.
But only those familiar with Han Xing knew.
At this moment, he truly harbored a killing intent.
However, the Infected Cassie across from him was unmoved.
"Hee hee hee..."
"Master of the Human Race, you seem so confident in yourself."
"Do you think that just because you’ve repelled the Dark Shadow, you’re invincible?"
"My power far exceeds your imagination!"
Han Xing laughed, "Is that so?"
"If you truly possess such great power, then why hide so much?"
The opposite side seemed to know Han Xing was testing it.
The Infected Cassie chuckled lightly, "Testing me?
"Hee hee..."
"But, there’s no harm in giving you some information."
"Master of the Human Race, do you know... what’s above a demigod?"
Hearing these words, Han Xing finally understood.
He knew what was targeting him.
It was very likely a true divine spirit.
Seeking something from himself.
Wu Ling’Er and Ciri beside him also understood now.
"Above a demigod..."
Wu Ling’Er murmured softly, then suddenly her pupils constricted!
She realized that the Witch Race had actually come under the scrutiny of a divine spirit!
A true divine spirit!
Seeing the shocked expressions on everyone’s faces, Infected Cassie appeared extremely satisfied.
However, this excluded Han Xing.
If it was a few months ago.
Upon hearing that a divine spirit was targeting him.
He might have actually been afraid.
But now, he had at least two means capable of posing a lethal threat to a divine spirit.
One was the over three hundred in his territory.
The other was the Divine Beast Poison Spike in his backpack.
But he didn’t show this.
To deal with a divine spirit, Han Xing still needed more information.
At this moment, Han Xing restrained the killing intent in his heart and asked, "Tell me, what is it you want?"
Infected Cassie seemed to perceive Han Xing’s submission.
Finally, she revealed her purpose.
"I can feel it, you have the power aura of that lineage on you."
"The Divine Format of the Hunter, it should be with you, right?"
An expression of realization appeared on Han Xing’s face.
He finally understood what this creature wanted.
The Hunter’s Divine Format!
The more Han Xing understood this world, the more he could feel the Hunter’s power.
The Wild Ranger Spirit, just a trace of awareness the Hunter left behind, held at least demigod-level combat power.
Moreover.
To be able to slay a divine level fierce beast like Beasts, the Hunter himself must also possess divine-level power.
Most likely, not just any ordinary divine level.
His Divine Format naturally drew covetous eyes from certain existences in this world.
He inherited the Wild Ranger profession.
Therefore, it was easy for those existences to deduce that the Hunter’s Divine Format was with him.
Han Xing did not deny it.
"It’s with me, is this what you want?"
Upon hearing this, a look of delight appeared on Infected Cassie’s face.
"Yes! Give it to me!"
"As long as you give me the Hunter’s Divine Format, not only will I lift the curse on these Witch Race people."
"I will also grant you infinite divine power!"
Hearing these words, Han Xing knew the other side was painting him a big picture.
But he did not show it, kept a stern face, and continued asking, "As long as I give you the Divine Format, you’re certain the curse on them will be lifted?"
"Of course, my power is beyond your imagination."
Han Xing fell into a state of thought, seemingly considering the other’s proposal.
"To be honest, I do not know what use you have for the Hunter’s Divine Format."
"To my knowledge, all demigod-level powerhouses possess a Divine Format."
"Why do you particularly want the Hunter’s?"
Upon hearing this, a cold smile appeared on Infected Cassie’s face.
"Heh... you don’t need to know."
"You only need to know, if you don’t hand over the Divine Format to me."
"Then, the entire Witch Race, including the Human Race, will be consumed by the curse and die within a month!"
Before Han Xing could speak, Infected Cassie continued.
"Don’t think I’m trying to scare you."
"You should have seen the strength of my curse."
"Not only this woman, but nearly half of the people on the entire continent have been infected by my curse."
"As soon as I wish, their curses will all erupt in an instant!"
Han Xing frowned deeply.
He didn’t think this creature was joking.
The other side truly possessed this capability.
After a moment, it seemed like Han Xing compromised, saying slowly, "Alright, I can hand over the Hunter’s Divine Format."
"But, how do I give it to you?"
Infected Cassie looked at Han Xing seriously.
It seemed she hadn’t expected him to agree so easily.
