All of these eyeballs were staring intently at Han Xing!
Ciri and Wu Ling’Er both held their breath.
At this moment, Han Xing’s gaze completely transformed into a killing intent.
He originally thought this curse would only spread among civilians.
Now it seems, he was mistaken.
The power of the curse far exceeded his imagination.
Not only targeting those in the Third and Fourth Transformations of the profession.
Now, it’s even set its sights on the people around him.
As a commander, Kathy possessed Four-star Lord Level strength.
If even she got infected.
That means throughout the Witch Race Territory.
Apart from these legendary powerhouses, no one can escape this fate.
At this moment, Infected Cassie let out a sharp laugh.
"Hee hee... hee hee hee..."
"Master of the Human Race, are you surprised?"
"Are you angry?"
"But, it’s useless~"
Han Xing exhaled and said slowly, "Do you know?
You’re courting death."
His tone was very calm.
But only those familiar with Han Xing knew.
At this moment, he truly harbored a killing intent.
However, the Infected Cassie across from him was unmoved.
"Hee hee hee..."
"Master of the Human Race, you seem so confident in yourself."
"Do you think that just because you’ve repelled the Dark Shadow, you’re invincible?"
"My power far exceeds your imagination!"
Han Xing laughed, "Is that so?"
"If you truly possess such great power, then why hide so much?"
The opposite side seemed to know Han Xing was testing it.
The Infected Cassie chuckled lightly, "Testing me?
"Hee hee..."
"But, there’s no harm in giving you some information."
"Master of the Human Race, do you know... what’s above a demigod?"
Hearing these words, Han Xing finally understood.
He knew what was targeting him.
It was very likely a true divine spirit.
Seeking something from himself.
Wu Ling’Er and Ciri beside him also understood now.
"Above a demigod..."
Wu Ling’Er murmured softly, then suddenly her pupils constricted!
She realized that the Witch Race had actually come under the scrutiny of a divine spirit!
A true divine spirit!
Seeing the shocked expressions on everyone’s faces, Infected Cassie appeared extremely satisfied.
However, this excluded Han Xing.
If it was a few months ago.
Upon hearing that a divine spirit was targeting him.
He might have actually been afraid.
But now, he had at least two means capable of posing a lethal threat to a divine spirit.
One was the over three hundred in his territory.
The other was the Divine Beast Poison Spike in his backpack.
But he didn’t show this.
To deal with a divine spirit, Han Xing still needed more information.
At this moment, Han Xing restrained the killing intent in his heart and asked, "Tell me, what is it you want?"
Infected Cassie seemed to perceive Han Xing’s submission.
Finally, she revealed her purpose.
"I can feel it, you have the power aura of that lineage on you."
"The Divine Format of the Hunter, it should be with you, right?"
An expression of realization appeared on Han Xing’s face.
He finally understood what this creature wanted.
The Hunter’s Divine Format!
The more Han Xing understood this world, the more he could feel the Hunter’s power.
The Wild Ranger Spirit, just a trace of awareness the Hunter left behind, held at least demigod-level combat power.
Moreover.
To be able to slay a divine level fierce beast like Beasts, the Hunter himself must also possess divine-level power.
Most likely, not just any ordinary divine level.
His Divine Format naturally drew covetous eyes from certain existences in this world.
He inherited the Wild Ranger profession.
Therefore, it was easy for those existences to deduce that the Hunter’s Divine Format was with him.
Han Xing did not deny it.
"It’s with me, is this what you want?"
Upon hearing this, a look of delight appeared on Infected Cassie’s face.
"Yes!
Give it to me!"
"As long as you give me the Hunter’s Divine Format, not only will I lift the curse on these Witch Race people."
"I will also grant you infinite divine power!"
Hearing these words, Han Xing knew the other side was painting him a big picture.
But he did not show it, kept a stern face, and continued asking, "As long as I give you the Divine Format, you’re certain the curse on them will be lifted?"
"Of course, my power is beyond your imagination."
Han Xing fell into a state of thought, seemingly considering the other’s proposal.
"To be honest, I do not know what use you have for the Hunter’s Divine Format."
"To my knowledge, all demigod-level powerhouses possess a Divine Format."
"Why do you particularly want the Hunter’s?"
Upon hearing this, a cold smile appeared on Infected Cassie’s face.
"Heh... you don’t need to know."
"You only need to know, if you don’t hand over the Divine Format to me."
"Then, the entire Witch Race, including the Human Race, will be consumed by the curse and die within a month!"
Before Han Xing could speak, Infected Cassie continued.
"Don’t think I’m trying to scare you."
"You should have seen the strength of my curse."
"Not only this woman, but nearly half of the people on the entire continent have been infected by my curse."
"As soon as I wish, their curses will all erupt in an instant!"
Han Xing frowned deeply.
He didn’t think this creature was joking.
The other side truly possessed this capability.
After a moment, it seemed like Han Xing compromised, saying slowly, "Alright, I can hand over the Hunter’s Divine Format."
"But, how do I give it to you?"
Infected Cassie looked at Han Xing seriously.
It seemed she hadn’t expected him to agree so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 350: Threats and Daring Beyond Measure!
paragraphs: A moment later, Infected Cassie chuckled darkly again: "Hehehe..."
"Master of the Human Race, don’t think I don’t know you’re testing me."
"However, it’s useless."
"Because in the Holy Spirit Realm, there is no power that can deal with me, hehe..."
"I’m giving you one week..."
"After a week, have the items ready and hand them to any one of my Cursed Servants."
"Otherwise, hundreds of billions of living creatures of the Witch Race, including all you legends, will all be buried with me!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly spoke.
"Hand it to your Cursed Servants? And not come to take it yourself?"
The coldness on his face suddenly dissipated, and then he chuckled softly.
"So that’s it, it seems you can’t just casually come and go either."
"Just like those guys, the Holy Spirit Realm has severe restrictions on you."
Infected Cassie’s expression changed instantly, as if her deepest secret had been exposed.
But she quickly reacted and said with a soft laugh.
"Master of the Human Race, you’re too naive."
"Existences like us cannot be restricted by any power!"
However, Han Xing just shook his head.
"Alright, I understand now."
"One week, right."
"Now, you can shut up."
With that said.
Han Xing unleashed his Divine Power directly.
Instantly suppressing Infected Cassie.
Looking at the stunned Wu Ling’Er and Ciri beside him.
Han Xing said, "Seal her up!"
"Let’s go outside."
The two women nodded.
Then, the three of them left the underground shelter together.
Above the Witch Race Main City.
Han Xing quickly ordered the Legendary Powerhouses in the main city to use Divine Power to seal these infected individuals.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also received the news.
One after another, they came rushing from Ten Thousand Stars City.
Beginning to participate in the suppression operation across the entire Witch Race Continent.
On this day, millions of Witch Race Soldiers returned from various places, incarcerating each infected individual into underground shelters.
In the sky.
The figures of those Legendary Powerhouses quickly flashed between cities.
A day later...
In the council hall of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Han Xing, along with four others, and Wu Ling’Er and High Priest Xiao.
A total of seven people sat in their respective positions.
At this moment.
Shen Yun spoke with a worried face: "Brother Xing, is the situation a bit troublesome now?"
"Yesterday in one day, we found over 10 billion infected and isolated them all together."
"But among the crowd, signs of curse outbreaks still keep appearing."
"It seems the number of infected must far exceed this number!"
"The one threatening you is very likely telling the truth!"
Upon hearing this, everyone felt the situation becoming increasingly troublesome.
Han Xing nodded and suddenly asked.
"Do you think I should hand over the items to keep the peace,"
"or should I think of another way?"
In the council hall were the most important members of Han Xing’s faction.
Also, people he could trust.
After listening, everyone began to ponder.
Undoubtedly, in the current situation, the first choice seemed better.
After all, being targeted by a true Divine Spirit spells doom for any race.
However, at this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly spoke up: "Hand over nothing!"
"That guy has no dignity as a Divine Spirit, using any means necessary to achieve its goal."
"Even if Brother Xing gives it the items, there’s no guarantee it won’t make other demands."
Everyone looked at Cheng Jianyong in surprise.
Seemingly astonished that he would say something so sensible.
High Priest Xiao spoke worriedly from the side: "But if we don’t hand it over, it will target our people."
"This curse seems to be the same as the one in the Beastman Kingdom."
"With the power of our entire race, we haven’t found a way to counter it."
"Moreover, I noticed this curse affects not only ordinary people but signs of infection have appeared even among those above Legendary Level..."
This statement sent a slight shock through everyone present.
This curse leaves no trace.
You have no idea if you’ve already been infected with the curse.
"Saint Master, it only gave us a week."
"What do you think we should do now?"
The High Priest tentatively asked.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and then said slowly: "I agree with Cheng Jianyong, even handing over the items doesn’t guarantee it won’t make further demands."
"The Beastman Kingdom and Sky Island Forest are precedents."
"So now, we need to think of a permanent solution."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others’ eyes lit up.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, are you thinking of finding that guy and then..."
He made a gesture, and everyone understood his meaning.
Han Xing nodded.
"That’s right, I want to slay the god!"
Rumble!
As soon as these words were spoken, the sky above the Holy Spirit Realm suddenly roared with a clear thunderbolt!
Both Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest beside her felt immense shock in their hearts!
They completely understood.
Han Xing’s so-called permanent solution was actually targeting that Divine Spirit.
From the beginning, he never intended to compromise!
Instead, he chose to stand firm to the end!
At this moment, the two of them felt a strong sense of astonishment.
The audacity of this new Saint Master expanded their understanding once again!
They looked at the other team members, seemingly wanting them to persuade Han Xing.
However, at this time, Shen Yun suddenly said.
"Brother Xing, if we’re going to target that guy, shouldn’t we locate its position first?"
"It only gave us one week, is that enough time?"

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 350: Threats and Daring Beyond Measure!
paragraphs: High Priest Xiao was taken aback.
Now it’s about stopping the Saint Master’s dangerous idea.
Why are you all analyzing it?
However, no one paid attention to the worried expression on the High Priest’s face.
Han Xing continued, "It’s okay, I already have a clue."
"This guy, since it can spread the curse in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"This means its true form is definitely also in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Through some clues, I’ve roughly identified the source of the curse’s spread."
"It should be those legendary powerhouses who came to help a few months ago."
The Beastman Kingdom and Sky Island Forest have suffered from this curse for years."
"This indicates that the guy is either hiding in the Sky Island Forest or in the Beastman Kingdom."
"And what we need to do is find its hiding place and deliver a thunderous strike!"
Murderous intent appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Completely unfazed by the fact that the opponent is a true Divine Spirit.
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to remember something and softly said, "Brother Xing, I remember that last time those tree spirits mentioned the curse in Sky Island Forest was severe?"
"Could it be that it’s hiding in Sky Island Forest?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s possible."
"But we can’t overlook the Beastman Kingdom either."
"That tree spirit seemed to have said before that the king of the Beastman Kingdom might be infected by the curse."
"And to infect a Demigod Level powerhouse without being noticed is not a simple task."
"Therefore, both places have a great probability!"
Cheng Jianyong said, "So Brother Xing, are we directly taking all the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons and sweeping through?"
Before Han Xing could respond.
Shen Yun shook his head and said, "Not appropriate, although Spiritual Godslaying Cannons can hurt Divine Spirits, we’re not sure about the existence having other means."
"To deal with it, we need a comprehensive plan."
The group continued to add their opinions one by one.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang nearby, who also occasionally interjected.
Yet, this scene had an intense and unreal feeling to the eyes of the High Priest.
Mind you, they were just a group of newly ascended legendary Human Race members!
Any random Demigod, they had to face carefully.
However, it was this seemingly weak Human Race.
Who were actually discussing how to confront a Divine Spirit.
Moreover, they were seriously formulating a detailed plan!
Wu Ling’Er and Xiao exchanged glances.
They both saw a hint of fear and shock in each other’s eyes!
If this action fails.
Not only they, but possibly the entire Witch Race would fall into an eternal abyss!
But they chose to trust that man without any reason.
After all.
The miracles that man brought time and time again had already captivated everyone in the Witch Race.
Moments later, Han Xing spoke.
"Alright, let’s pause the discussion on the plan for now."
"Dealing with a Divine Spirit is not a simple matter."
"We must try our best to search for information about the Divine Spirit and the methods they may possess."
"Only by knowing oneself and the enemy can we ensure the greatest chance of victory."
"Ensure the action is foolproof."
Everyone nodded in unison.
Then, clenching their fists, their faces flushed with excitement, they all walked out of the council hall together.
On this day.
It’s estimated that no one in the Holy Spirit Realm would have thought.
Faced with the threat of a Divine Spirit.
This group not only didn’t choose to compromise but started a series of Godslaying plans!
At the same time.
Outside the Witch Race Territory.
In a distant, ancient kingdom.
In a damp, dark Divine Hall, knelt a familiar figure.
The appearance of this figure looked very familiar.
It was Zhou Huang who left the Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, Zhou Huang looked extremely miserable.
His body was full of injuries, and symptoms appeared in some places similar to those of the infected.
But the Boundless who came out with him was nowhere to be seen.
Currently.
Zhou Huang knelt in a Divine Hall full of various human tissue.
Slightly touching the ground yields thick blood plasma.
While despair filled Zhou Huang’s heart, he began to gradually feel numb.
At this time, a voice sounded by Zhou Huang’s ear.
"This generation’s Child of Destiny of the Human Race..."
"Do you think that kid will come?"
Zhou Huang slowly lifted his head, his eyes full of confusion.
"This time, it’s not just the Witch Race People I’ve spread the curse on."
"I’ve also infected the Human Race in the Witch Race Territory with my Power."
"Do you think he’ll choose to hand over the Divine Format or choose to confront me?"
Zhou Huang was shocked upon hearing this.
He anxiously questioned, "So you never intended to fulfill your promise?"
"Hehe... Promise?"
"Have you forgotten my identity?"
Zhou Huang’s eyelid twitched.
Ever since knowing this guy’s identity, Zhou Huang became increasingly desperate.
He also knew that the opponent not only wouldn’t keep promises but would recklessly toy with such vows.
"Through this observation period and your intelligence, I have roughly understood that kid’s character."
"This generation’s Master of the Human Race seems to be someone who won’t easily submit."
"But it doesn’t matter, whether he wants to submit or not, the result will be the same."
"I’ve already laid down various methods nearby."
"And these methods are all enough to threaten a Divine Spirit."
"If he falls into the trap, what should I do to deal with him?"
The horror in Zhou Huang’s eyes intensified.
He didn’t expect that during the time he was unaware, this being had already done so many things.
Regardless of whether Han Xing comes or not, he will fall into this guy’s trap.
A strong sense of crisis appeared in Zhou Huang’s heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 351: Godslaying Operation Begins!
paragraphs: Zhou Huang was incredibly anxious!
Although he and Han Xing were rivals in the Human Race.
Zhou Huang also knew that Han Xing might never have considered him a rival.
Even falling to this state was just Zhou Huang’s wishful thinking.
Moreover, he was also a member of the Human Race.
At this moment, Zhou Huang desperately wanted to warn Han Xing.
He must not come to find this guy!
There is a trap here!
However.
Ever since Zhou Huang was captured and brought to this Divine Hall, he had lost all contact with the outside world.
Even the communication function had stopped working.
This guy’s power was too strong, already capable of affecting the survivors’ systems.
Even if he wanted to make contact, he would have to escape from this Divine Hall first.
Zhou Huang’s mind raced with thoughts.
Moments later, he lifted his head, revealing a weary expression.
Zhou Huang shook his head and said, "As far as I know him, he probably won’t come."
"Oh?" The voice sounded quite surprised.
"Didn’t you say this guy was competing with you for the position of Master of the Human Race and even pushed you down?"
"Would such a person surrender so easily?"
Zhou Huang thought for a moment and then bitterly smiled, "You might have misunderstood."
"This guy doesn’t have the so-called kingly aura; on the contrary, he’s a bit cunning..."
"In my impression, he is an extremely cautious person."
"He rarely makes a move without absolute certainty."
Hearing this, the voice was even more surprised.
"You mean, you were pushed down from the position of Master of the Human Race by someone like that?"
Zhou Huang nodded without feeling embarrassed.
"Useless."
The voice continued, "It seems I’ll have to use some other methods."
"If that kid really doesn’t come and doesn’t care about the lives of those Witch Race People and the Humans, then it will be troublesome."
"Apparently, I still have to take action myself."
Zhou Huang frowned and asked, "What else do you plan to do?"
"Didn’t you give him a week to consider? The time isn’t up yet!"
The voice chuckled lightly, "What will I do?"
"Do I need to tell you?
Zhou Huang remained silent.
At this time, the voice continued, "What if I tell you I am now going to the Land of the Abandoned Gods to turn all those Humans into my slaves."
"What do you think of that?"
Zhou Huang’s pupils suddenly shrank, "Why?"
"Aren’t you only after his Divine Format?"
"Attacking Humans won’t make him surrender; it might completely ignite his rebellious spirit!"
"By then, you won’t get anything!"
Zhou Huang was extremely agitated.
And at that moment, there was a crisp snap sound.
"Snap!"
The next moment, blood spurted from Zhou Huang’s entire body!
The Power of Curse exploded instantly.
"Ah!"
A scream erupted from Zhou Huang’s mouth.
For a fleeting moment, eyeballs appeared inside his open mouth.
At this moment, Zhou Huang seemed to be in extreme pain, and the Human Emperor’s Sword in his backpack trembled slightly.
It was even unable to restrain itself from wanting to fly out and slay the enemy.
Yet ultimately, Zhou Huang held back.
"A slight punishment. Next time, if you dare speak to me like that again, you will accompany those infected."
That voice left this sentence hovering lightly in the air.
Just as it was about to leave, it suddenly exclaimed in surprise.
"Huh? It seems there’s no need for me to go to the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"This kid really is plotting against me."
"Interesting!"
At this moment, Zhou Huang’s heart trembled once more.
From what he had learned during this time, he already knew.
Beings of this level often had some means of foreseeing danger.
It was likely that when Han Xing was plotting against it, this terrifying being had already sensed it.
Zhou Huang suddenly became urgent.
"No, I have to find a way to get this message to Han Xing."
"Tell him he absolutely should not come to confront this guy.
On the Witch Race Continent.
Several figures concealed themselves and then stood in mid-air.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er pulled out several bottles of black potion from her bosom and handed them to Han Xing.
"Saint Master, these are one of the potions you requested."
"According to your instructions, I gathered all the Secret Medicine Grandmasters of the Witch Race and made this potion overnight."
"And these items..."
Wu Ling’Er pulled out several more items from her bosom and handed them one by one to Han Xing.
Han Xing looked at the system prompts flashing across continuously and nodded.
"We need to set out. During this time, keep all information sealed to ensure everything is foolproof."
"Until you receive a message from me, you must pretend we are still on the Witch Race Continent."
Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest beside her both nodded.
They also understood the importance of this operation.
Then.
Han Xing secretly mobilized a core territory Sky Island from near Ten Thousand Stars City.
On it, there were as many as three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
And some other territorial buildings.
These were all previously erected near Ten Thousand Stars City, and usually, only Han Xing could activate them.
Currently, on the Witch Race Continent, there are still dozens of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
So the disappearance of these turrets wouldn’t draw attention from others.
Upon saying this, Han Xing then appeared directly on the Sky Island.
And then used Divine Power to cloak it, turning the Sky Island invisible.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others also boarded the Sky Island.
The five gazed forward resolutely.
This time, they were about to undertake a great mission.
A mission significant enough to shake the entire Holy Spirit Realm!
Watching their departing figures.
Wu Ling’Er softly spoke from behind.
"Saint... Brother Han Xing..."
Han Xing turned around, "What is it?"
Wu Ling’Er hesitated, and after a moment, as if summoning her courage, she spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 351: Godslaying Operation Begins!
paragraphs: "Can Ling’Er go with you?"
"I’m about to break through to high-tier Legend, I won’t be a burden to you."
"By then, I can also help you fight together."
At this point, there was even a hint of a request in her tone.
After listening, Han Xing had a smile on his face.
He appeared beside Wu Ling’Er, then patted her head and said.
"Ling’Er, you know, this time, adding a few more Legends won’t make much of a difference."
"Even adding a few more demigods won’t help."
"On the contrary, if you stay on the Witch Race Continent, you can immediately suppress a curse outbreak, which is more helpful to me."
Listening to Han Xing’s comforting words.
Wu Ling’Er also knew that her request was somewhat willful.
But in her heart, she wanted more to accompany Han Xing and face the danger together.
Looking at the teammates beside Han Xing.
Wu Ling’Er pondered for a moment, then softly replied.
"Mm, I’ll wait for you to come back."
After speaking.
Wu Ling’Er seemed afraid she would continue to hesitate, quickly turned and left.
Including the High Priest nearby, whose figure also disappeared from the spot.
At this moment, the smile on Han Xing’s face gradually disappeared.
He went to his team members and said.
"Let’s set off."
On this day.
A Sky Island in stealth mode silently left the Witch Race Continent.
And headed straight for the Witch Race border area.
Several hours later...
Han Xing and the others had already arrived at the Witch Race border.
This place was once the battlefield between the Witch Race and the Shadow Legion.
Also, one of the main passages leading out for the Witch Race.
After several months, there were still many soldiers guarding here.
They were clearing out Void Beasts and suppressing Void disturbance.
Han Xing’s Sky Island was under divine power shielding, their arrival didn’t attract anyone’s attention.
The defense towers, too, remained inactive under Han Xing’s highest authority.
Then.
The group silently passed through the border.
The Sky Island slowly entered a region of Void Turbulence.
They advanced through the dark void for a while.
An hour later.
A light appeared in front of everyone.
"We’re almost out of the Witch Race territory."
Han Xing’s voice came.
Everyone involuntarily lifted their heads, staring at the source of the light.
After reaching the light, they appeared in a new area.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have left the Witch Race territory, World Influence +103, new map unlocked...]
Looking at the unnamed area displayed on the map.
Han Xing nodded.
This region didn’t belong to any faction and thus had no name.
Gazing into the distance.
Han Xing was deep in thought.
In front of him, a choice appeared.
Going about 500,000 kilometers to the left, they would reach the Sky Island Forest’s territory.
Going about 800,000-plus kilometers to the right, they would reach the Beastman Kingdom’s territory.
Deciding where to go first was very important.
After some discussion.
Han Xing made a decision and spoke.
"Our first stop, we’ll go to the Sky Island Forest first."
Hearing this, everyone was a bit surprised.
Han Xing explained: "Although we all know, the likelihood of that guy being in the Beastman Kingdom is greater."
"But, currently, our impression of that divine spirit is only about spreading curses."
"We know nothing about its other means."
"So, if the one in the Sky Island Forest truly wants to deal with that guy."
"Considering they’ve dealt with curses for so many years, they must know more about that divine spirit."
"We can gather some information in the Sky Island Forest, then discuss a more detailed strategy."
Everyone nodded, agreeing that Han Xing’s reasoning made sense.
Of course.
This approach also carried certain risks.
If, by any chance, the one in the Sky Island Forest had already been controlled by the opponent.
Then Han Xing and the others’ actions would be like alerting the enemy.
Or even, if the divine spirit was in the Sky Island Forest.
Han Xing and the team going now would directly confront it.
It would be equivalent to starting a battle.
But as previously mentioned.
No matter what they do, there will be risks.
Or rather, when they initially chose to confront the divine spirit, they already knew it wouldn’t be an easy task.
And they have already made corresponding preparations.
After speaking.
Han Xing controlled the Sky Island, heading straight toward the Sky Island Forest.
Hours later.
All of a sudden, everyone saw.
Ahead appeared a large number of Sky Islands filled with greenery.
Covered with various plants.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have entered the Sky Island Forest, new map unlocked, World Influence +109, Legendary Points +5.]
"So this is the Sky Island Forest?" Cheng Jianyong said in surprise.
Shen Yun nodded, "Indeed, it’s quite different from the Witch Race territory and the Sky Islands in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
They noticed that the style of the Sky Islands here had changed significantly.
They weren’t covered by clouds.
But instead, presented directly in front of everyone.
Compared to the modern style of the Witch Race.
The Sky Island Forest, as its name implies.
Is truly a forest built on islands.
Covered with towering trees reaching thousands, even tens of thousands of meters tall!
Amidst the forest, traces of wildlife activities could be seen.
At this time, Shen Yun looked at Han Xing’s back and said, "Brother Xing, do you feel it?"
"There are many powerful presences in these forests?"
Upon hearing this, everyone also extended their divine power outward.
Then, they too sensed those presences.
It seemed to come from those towering ancient trees.
At least at the Four-star Leader Level in strength.
Including the presence of Lord and Dominator Level creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 351: Godslaying Operation, Commence!_3
paragraphs: Everyone was slightly shocked.
This was just the first Sky Island they discovered upon arriving at the Sky Island Forest.
The number and quality of powerful beings on it far exceeded those of the Witch Race.
If you compared it to the entire Sky Island Forest region, the number of powerful beings is simply unimaginable.
To avoid unnecessary trouble.
Han Xing chose to bypass this Sky Island and delve into the Sky Island Forest territory from another direction.
As they continued forward for thousands of kilometers.
They encountered dozens more Sky Island forests along the way.
Just like the first Sky Island forest they encountered outside.
The presence and ratio of powerful beings on it was very high.
On their journey, they encountered at least a thousand tree spirits with Fourth-turn Lord-level power.
The strength of the Sky Island Forest far exceeded their expectations.
At least, it was much stronger than the Witch Race.
"So many Fourth-Turn Leaders and Lords, how do these guys do it?"
Cheng Jianyong felt extremely perplexed.
Everyone also thought this ratio was a bit too high.
After observing carefully, Han Xing suddenly said, "I seem to know their way of becoming stronger."
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze to Han Xing.
Han Xing pointed to a Sky Island in front of them, saying, "Look, are the plants on it maintaining the same frequency, performing breathing actions?"
Everyone sensed it carefully.
A consistent breathing rhythm came to their ears.
They were slightly shocked internally.
In their senses.
It seemed that all the plants on the Sky Island were a single entity.
The energy they gathered through breathing was all concentrated in the forest, on the minority of plants there.
Cheng Jianyong expressed his amazement beside them, "Wow... so that’s how these tree spirits cultivate?"
"An entire forest nourishes a few plants."
"Even those little saplings, and even some weeds can absorb energy."
"No wonder their proportion of powerful beings is so high!"
He seemed to think of something, suddenly saying, "Brother Xing, do you think we can acquire the cultivation methods of these plants."
"Then bring it back to the Witch Race, let those ordinary people learn this cultivation technique to help us cultivate?"
Truth be told, Cheng Jianyong’s thoughts were quite lively.
Immediately linking it to this matter.
However, Shen Yun rolled his eyes, saying, "Kid, have you been reading too many fantasy novels?"
"Can’t believe you thought of that!"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then shook his head, saying, "It should be impossible."
"This should be one of the talents belonging to the Tree Spirit Race."
"Just like the Witch Patterns of the Witch Race, other races cannot imitate them."
Everyone, hearing this, also thought Han Xing made sense.
"What a pity." Cheng Jianyong shook his head with some regret.
At this moment, Coal Ball seemed to have discovered something.
It walked to the front of everyone, sniffing the air with its nose.
Before Han Xing could react.
Coal Ball’s figure had already vanished from sight, vanishing into the Void.
"Where did Coal Ball go?"
Under the confused gazes of everyone.
They suddenly saw a commotion occurring at the center of the Sky Island forest ahead.
A towering ancient tree, reaching tens of thousands of meters high, seemed to suddenly awaken from a dormant state.
On its trunk, two eyes slowly opened.
After scanning its surroundings and still not sensing anything unusual.
It returned to its dormant state.
Moments later.
Coal Ball’s figure suddenly appeared beside Han Xing.
It seemed to be boastingly excited, coming towards Han Xing.
At this time, everyone knew.
The commotion of that ancient tree might be related to Coal Ball.
Only because Coal Ball’s stealth technique was too advanced, the other party couldn’t detect it at all.
Han Xing patted its head, smiling, "Little Coal Ball, being naughty again?"
"We have things to do now, next time..."
Before Han Xing finished speaking.
He suddenly saw Coal Ball spew out a bright red fruit from its mouth.
The fruit emitted a strong life aura.
Just appearing made Han Xing feel refreshed.
"This is..." Han Xing questioned in surprise.
Coal Ball directly spat the fruit into Han Xing’s hand.
A system prompt appeared.
[Acquired Life Fruit (Four-star Dominator Level) *1.]
[Effect]: Upon consumption, permanently increases 1000 points of maximum Life Value limit (Remaining consumption times: 100)
Seeing the fruit’s effect, Han Xing’s heart suddenly jolted.
This was actually an item that increases the maximum Life Value limit!
The Survivor’s personal panel didn’t possess the Life Value attribute.
But through exploration during this period, Han Xing roughly deduced a formula.
That being 1 point of Constitution roughly equaled a 10-point Life Value bonus.
ps: The Constitution attribute not only increases Life Value, but also enhances Flesh Body Defense, endurance, bodily recovery speed, and other attributes.
A trace of amazement appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
This fruit can increase the maximum Life Value limit by 1000 points per fruit, equivalent to a 100-point Constitution bonus!
And the critical point is, it can be consumed 100 times!
In other words, through this fruit, one can directly increase the Life Value limit by 100,000 points.
Equivalent to a benefit of 10,000 Constitution points!
And this is only a Four-Star Dominator-level Life Fruit.
Above this, there must be Legend, High-tier Legend, and even Demigod Life Fruits!
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the Sky Island below, as if discovering a treasure land!
Coal Ball emitted a soft cry, as if asking for praise.
Han Xing patted its head, "Well done, Coal Ball."
Having received his master’s praise, Coal Ball seemed very happy.
At that moment, everyone else also saw the ’Life Fruit’ effect.
Then, Shen Yun looked at the Sky Island below, saying, "Didn’t expect Life Fruit to have such effects."
"I see, that big tree still hangs dozens of Life Fruits!"
"Shall we go pick all of them now?"
Upon these words, everyone looked at that Sky Island.
As if within this Primitive Forest, there were various precious opportunities contained.
